title: Operationeel Verantwoordelijke Carrosserie
description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Neem de operationele leiding van een sterk familiebedrijf en bouw mee aan de volgende groeifase.

Voor onze partner, een gevestigd carrosseriebedrijf in de regio Bornem, zoeken we een Operationeel Verantwoordelijke die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en mee wil bouwen aan de toekomst. Het bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in het herstellen, afwerken en aanpassen van vrachtwagens, trailers, bestelwagens en andere bedrijfsvoertuigen. Je komt terecht in een sterk familiebedrijf met een stevige reputatie, een ervaren team en een duidelijke ambitie om verder te groeien.

Dit is geen klassieke managementfunctie vanop afstand. We zoeken iemand die midden in de operatie staat, mensen aanstuurt, klanten verder helpt en tegelijk kansen ziet om de organisatie elke dag beter te maken


Als Operationeel Verantwoordelijke ben jij de spil van de dagelijkse werking. Je zorgt dat de werkplaats draait, het team weet wat er moet gebeuren en klanten op een correcte en efficiënte manier geholpen worden. Je combineert operationele leiding, klantencontact, administratie en procesverbetering:

  • Je organiseert en bewaakt de dagelijkse planning en werkvoorbereiding en stuurt het team op de werkvloer aan.
  • Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor klanten en leveranciers, behandelt aanvragen en offertes en zorgt voor een correcte opvolging.
  • Je zorgt dat onderdelen, materialen, werkkaarten en bestelbonnen tijdig en correct geregeld zijn.
  • Je bewaakt de administratieve flow en facturatie: wat op de werkvloer gebeurt, moet ook administratief feilloos opgevolgd worden.
  • Je denkt continu mee over efficiëntie, structuur en verbetering en neemt zelf initiatief om processen en systemen te optimaliseren.

Je bent daarbij zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer en houdt voeling met wat er leeft in het team. Je wacht niet af tot een probleem bij jou terechtkomt, maar ziet wat nodig is en handelt.
Op termijn neem je de volledige operationele verantwoordelijkheid over en word je de vaste spilfiguur van de onderneming.

We zoeken een ondernemend en ervaren profiel dat graag een operationele werking runt. Iemand die energie krijgt van mensen, klanten en processen, maar ook begrijpt dat een goede operatie staat of valt met een sterke opvolging en administratie.

  • 5+ jaar werkervaring en aantoonbare ervaring in het aansturen van mensen.
  • Ondernemend en operationeel sterk: je neemt initiatief, ziet opportuniteiten en maakt dingen beter.
  • Sterke people skills: je kunt verschillende types mensen aansturen, motiveren en bijsturen.
  • Technische affiniteit:  Je hebt ervaring in automotive, carrosserie, vrachtwagens, transport of een gelijkaardige omgeving.
  • Kalm, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht: als ondernemer weet je dat een goede administratie, planning en opvolging even belangrijk zijn als wat er op de werkvloer gebeurt.

Je hoeft zelf geen mecanicien of carrosseriebouwer te zijn. Je moet wel voeling hebben met de werkvloer en de ambitie hebben om de dagelijkse operatie écht in handen te nemen.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

  • Daily aseptic and manual production processes
  • Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) Spiking
  • Media refreshing
  • Cell culture
  • Freezing therapeutic products
  • Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance
  • Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
  • Supporting transitions between production zones
  • Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

What does our client expect from you?

  • A strong sense of responsibility and a passion for making a difference in the lives of patients.
  • Clear communication with your colleagues and supervisor.
  • You love structure and order, are very accurate, and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.
  • Experience in pharma or biotech is not required as we provide complete training.
  • You have a high school diploma (A2) or equivalent through experience. The mindset for quality and accuracy takes precedence over diploma and background.
  • You have good PC skills:
    Be able to add attachment to an email
    Be able to send / accept / modify teams invite
    Create document, save under PDF, ...

title: Production Supervisor
description:
Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.


They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members


Jobomschrijving

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

  • Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
  • Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
  • Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
  • Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
  • Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
  • Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for: 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
  • Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
  • Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
  • Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.


Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

  • Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
  • Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
  • Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
  • Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
  • Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
  • Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
  • Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
  • Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
  • Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
  • Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

  • At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
  • Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
  • A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
  • Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
  • Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
  • Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
  • English is a plus
  • Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
  • No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

title: Senior Management Assistant - Law firm (M/F/X)
description:
Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.


Jobomschrijving

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
  • Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
  • Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
  • Supporting billing and expense management activities.
  • Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
  • Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
  • Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
  • Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
  • Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
  • Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
  • Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

  • Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
  • Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
  • Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

title: Freelance Ticketing Manager - People Management
description:
Our client is an international organisation active in the events and live entertainment industry, with operations across Europe and a global headquarters in the United States. The Belgian team supports clients with ticketing, event delivery and field IT, working within a broader EMEA operational structure.


Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Ticketing Manager your responsibilities are:

  • Lead and structure a team of 6-7 event programmers in Belgium ;
  • Act as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders ;
  • Oversee programming and configuration of client ticketing platforms ;
  • Manage event setup including pricing, sales windows, dates, seat maps and inventory ;
  • Monitor team KPIs, performance and service quality ;
  • Analyse operational issues and identify long-term solutions and improvements ;
  • Support the team in decision-making, prioritisation and reaching clear outcomes ;
  • Contribute to the ongoing restructuring and development of the Belgian operation ;

A successful Freelance Ticketing Manager should have:

  • Proven experience in people management and team leadership, ideally in a complex or changing environment ;
  • High emotional intelligence, with the ability to understand different personalities, motivations and team dynamics ;
  • Strong coaching and communication skills, combined with the ability to provide clear direction ;
  • Experienced in stabilising teams, managing change and rebuilding engagement ;
  • Calm, approachable and confident when dealing with challenging situations ;
  • Strong stakeholder and client management capabilities ;
  • KPI-driven and performance-oriented, with a structured approach to operational management ;
  • Experience with ticketing systems, event technology or technical platforms is a strong plus ;
  • Fluent in English ;

title: Customer Service and Project Coordinator
description:
Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.


Jobomschrijving

  • Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
  • Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
  • Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
  • Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
  • Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
  • Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
  • Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
  • Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

title: Learning & Customer Excellence Trainer (M/V/X)
description:
Our client is a globally recognised industrial organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, operational excellence and customer-centricity. With an international footprint and a collaborative culture, the company invests heavily in employee development and continuous learning.
Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.


Jobomschrijving

  • Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.
  • Design, create and continuously improve training materials, manuals, guides and digital learning content.
  • Deliver engaging training sessions for both new hires and existing employees.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements where needed.
  • Maintain training records and monitor employee learning progress.
  • Provide individual coaching and ongoing support to customer service professionals.
  • Support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across the organisation.
  • Research and introduce modern training methodologies and best practices.
  • Contribute to various projects related to employee development and organisational learning.
  • Travel occasionally to other company sites to facilitate training sessions.

  • Master's degree in Business, Education, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Previous experience as a Trainer, Learning & Development Specialist, Facilitator or similar role.
  • Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to adapt training approaches to different audiences and topics.
  • Experience developing learning content and training programmes.
  • Familiarity with e-learning platforms and digital learning tools is an advantage.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and engage others.
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative environment.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally when required

title: Employé Administratif h/f/x
description:
Security wereld in België en Nederland. 


Jobomschrijving

Reporting and service data management:
•    Provide timely and accurate reporting based on service tickets.
•    Search, verify and consolidate the relevant information contained in tickets.
•    Prepare SLA reports, KPI reports, dashboards and clear management information.
•    Ensure the quality, completeness, consistency and currency of reporting data.
Reporting process improvement and automation:
•    Improve and automate the current reporting processes, which are still partly manual.
•    Use advanced Microsoft Excel functionalities to optimize data processing and reporting.
•    Identify automation opportunities using Power Automate and, where relevant, VBA.
•    Maintain dashboards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Service Delivery support:
•    Support the Services Delivery team with administrative and analytical tasks.
•    Translate operational data into accurate and understandable information for internal stakeholders and management.
•    Organize and prioritize tasks independently, while respecting reporting deadlines and quality requirements.
•    Take on other related tasks when required, while reporting remains the priority of the role.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
•    Timely delivery of SLA and management reports.
•    Accuracy and quality of reporting data.
•    Level of automation achieved in reporting processes.
•    Availability and currency of dashboards.
•    Internal customer satisfaction regarding reporting.
•    Number and quality of identified improvement initiatives.
 


Education, Knowledge & Work Experience:

•    Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis.
•    Experience with KPI development, SLA reporting and data quality management is an asset.
•    Knowledge of ITIL processes and experience with CMDB environments are assets.
•    Experience with Power Automate, VBA, Grafana or similar tools is an asset.
Required skills:
•    Strong analytical mindset and administrative accuracy.
•    Structured way of working and excellent attention to detail.
•    Ability to work independently and to prioritize tasks.
•    Results-oriented and quality-focused approach.
•    Excellent written communication skills.
•    Ability to translate data into clear management information.
•    Proactive attitude and focus on continuous improvement.
Languages:
•    Very good knowledge of Dutch, as communication is mainly internal.
•    Good knowledge of French and English is an asset.

title: Senior Contract Administration Specialist
description:
Our client is a global technology company providing digital solutions and data-driven services that help organizations optimize their operations, improve efficiency, and strengthen collaboration across complex supply chains. Operating in an international and fast-paced environment, the company focuses on innovation, customer success, and continuous process improvement to support business performance and growth.


Jobomschrijving

  • Manage the full contract renewal lifecycle, including renewals, amendments, terminations, pricing updates, and complex customer contract requests.
  • Prepare and support sales quotations while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with commercial objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Product, and Deal Desk teams to maintain accurate forecasts, protect revenue, and ensure smooth customer renewals.
  • Analyze contract, customer, and financial data to identify risks, improve data quality, and provide insights on renewal performance.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for renewals operations, supporting colleagues with complex contract scenarios and process-related questions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline quote-to-cash processes, enhance operational efficiency, and improve the customer experience.

The successful candidate is a detail-oriented and analytical professional with experience in contract management, renewals, sales operations, or a related business support function. They are highly organized, customer-focused, and comfortable working cross-functionally, with the ability to manage complex contract scenarios, analyze data, drive process improvements, and deliver results in a fast-paced international environment.

title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
Michael Page Belgium is based in Brussels, Ghent & Antwerpen. All our offices need talents !


Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes, from job brief to candidate selection.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their hiring needs and requirements.
  • Source and attract candidates using various channels and tools.
  • Conduct interviews and assess candidates' suitability for roles.
  • Provide clients with expert advice on market trends and recruitment strategies.
  • Maintain accurate records of recruitment activities and client interactions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
  • Deliver excellent service to ensure client satisfaction and loyalty.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

  • A background or interest in human resources or recruitment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks effectively and meet deadlines.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach to work.
  • Fluency in French OR Dutch.

title: Service Technieker
description:
Cirqui ontstond onder de vleugels van P&V Group, als de serviceafdeling van P&V Panels. We voelden dat er in de markt een grote nood is aan onderhoudsdiensten voor elektrische borden. En dat bij een andere doelgroep dan die van een installatiebedrijf. Daarom gaan we nu zelfstandig aan de slag binnen P&V Group. Met gespecialiseerde oplossingen die ervoor zorgen dat uw bedrijf blijft draaien. En met de expertise en slagkracht van de grootste total solutions provider voor elektrische borden in de BeneluxWerken als service technieker bij Cirqui, de service-afdeling van de P&V Group, dat is werken op verschillende locaties binnen industrie en infra. Jij zorgt mee voor de bedrijfszekerheid bij deze klanten. Dit is een job met veel variatie en zelfstandigheid. Je krijgt van ons het beste materiaal om mee te werken en komt terecht in een hecht team. 


Jobomschrijving

De installed base van onze klanten is jouw werkterrein. Als service technieker voer je onderhoud en/of upgrades uit op elektrische borden:Onderhoud: visuele inspectie, componenten vervangen, audits…Revamp: renovatie van de borden.Upgrade: complete ombouw en extra functionaliteiten toevoegen. Je uitvalsbasis is ons gebouw in Heusden-Zolder of Kortrijk*. De werken zelf gebeuren altijd on site bij de klant: productiebedrijven, industrie, ziekenhuizen…*afhankelijk van je standplaats. We zoeken voor beide sites nog een servicetechnieker. 

Je hebt minstens een BSO of TSO-diploma in een elektrotechnische richting : elektriciteit, elektromechanica, elektrotechniek,...Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring in een soortgelijke job, deze job is niet geschikt voor schoolverlatersJe bent flexibel en houdt van uitdagingen : elke dag, elk project en elke klant is andersJe bent een stressbestendige problem solver. Je krijgt on site soms te maken met onverwachte factoren en hebt voor sommige projecten een strakke timingJe werkt graag in teamverband maar kan ook zelfstandig te werk gaan Je bent klantvriendelijkJe werkt nauwgezet en volgens de veiligheidsregelsJe hebt geen 9 to 5 mentaliteit. Elk project is anders : soms ben je vroeger klaar, een andere keer kunnen de werken uitlopen

title: Freelance Inventory Planner
description:
Our client is an international company active in the medical devices sector, with a strong focus on dialysis solutions, representing the majority of its revenue.

The organization operates a global supply chain, with most products manufactured in Asia and additional production sites in Europe (Germany and Spain). The European headquarters manages distribution across EMEA, working closely with multiple 3PL warehouse partners.


Jobomschrijving

  • Manage and optimize inventory levels across multiple European warehouses.
  • Monitor stock levels, overstock, shortages and expiry risks, ensuring availability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as the main point of cobntact for 3PL partners, coordinating inbound and outbound flows.
  • Collaborate closely with demand planning teams to align forecasts and anticipate supply risks.
  • Support the opening of new warehouses (Spain, Italy) and ensure alignment with internal processes.
  • Ensure inventory accuracy, including stock reconciliation and cycle counts.
  • Follow up daily operations to guarantee product availability and service levels.
  • Contribute to process improvements and standardization across EMEA supply chain operations.

A successful Freelance Inventory Planner should have:

  • Proven experience as Inventory Planner, Supply Planner or similar role.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to manage complex inventory flows.
  • Experience working with 3PL logistics providers and warehouse operations.
  • Ability to quickly adapt and build relationships with stakeholders in an international environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills (data analysis, templates, reporting).
  • Fluent in English, Italian or Spanish are a plus

title: Compliance Officer -  Brussels
description:
Our client is a respected organization within the financial services sector. As a medium-sized company, they are committed to delivering excellence in compliance and regulatory adherence.


Jobomschrijving

As a Compliance Officer your responsibilities are:

  • Monitor and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Develop, implement, and update compliance policies and procedures.
  • Conduct regular audits and risk assessments.
  • Provide guidance and training to internal teams on compliance matters.
  • Prepare and submit compliance reports to regulatory authorities.
  • Investigate and resolve compliance issues or breaches.
  • Collaborate with the Risk & Compliance department to develop risk mitigation strategies.
  • Stay updated on regulatory changes and recommend necessary adjustments.

A successful Compliance Officer should have:

  • A degree in law, finance, business administration, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in compliance within the financial services industry.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks and risk management practices.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Capacity to work independently and collaboratively within the Risk & Compliance department.

title: Risk Associate - Insurance - Brussels
description:
Our client is a globally recognised insurance and reinsurance company, known for bringing together expertise and innovation to manage complex risks.

For their European entity based in Brussels, they are currently looking for a Risk Associate.


Jobomschrijving

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the risk management framework (second line of defence)
  • Monitor and assess operational (non-financial) risks in line with the company's risk appetite
  • Actively contribute to RCSA processes and risk reporting
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify, assess and manage risks, providing constructive challenge
  • Ensure policies and risk frameworks are properly implemented across EEA branches
  • Take ownership of risk domains, including monitoring and oversight
  • Support the preparation of risk reports for senior management and the CRO
  • Contribute to the annual risk plan
  • Promote a strong risk culture across the organisation
  • Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Audit and Business teams
  • Provide ad hoc support to the CRO and Operational Risk Manager

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics or Business
  • 3-5 years of experience in Operational Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Audit or similar within Financial Services/Insurance
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus
  • Experience in a second line of defence function is a strong asset
  • Good understanding of ERM frameworks, risk appetite and internal controls
  • Hands-on experience with RCSA, incident management and risk reporting
  • Exposure to Belgian or EU regulatory environments
  • Knowledge of operational resilience, third-party risk (DORA) or information security is a plus
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure and present complex information
  • Autonomous, well-organised and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Strong communication skills and ability to challenge stakeholders constructively
  • Team player with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset

title: IT Support (L2)
description:
Our client is a leading international professional services organization known for its high standards, fast-paced environment, and strong commitment to internal service excellence. With a European footprint, the company relies on well-structured IT teams collaborating across multiple offices.


Jobomschrijving

  • Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for end-user environments (Windows, M365, IT equipment).
  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, and peripherals.
  • Manage incidents through a ticketing system and ensure proper resolution or escalation.
  • Support network, telephony (VoIP), and mobile (iOS) issues.
  • Assist with collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom, Webex) and meeting room technologies.
  • Document solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with European IT teams on projects and deployments.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and occasional out-of-hours work for rollouts or events.

  • Degree in IT or equivalent experience.
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in IT support, ideally within a professional services environment.
  • Strong technical skills (Windows 11, M365, networking, Citrix, VoIP).
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong communication and customer service mindset.
  • Ability to work under pressure and interact with stakeholders at all levels.
  • IT certifications (e.g., A+, Microsoft) are a plus.

title: Leidinggevende horeca
description:
Heb jij leidinggevende kwaliteiten en krijg je energie van het aansturen van een team?

title: AI Capability and Integration Analyst
description:
Our client is an international BtoB organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services.

To support this strategic ambition, they are looking for an AI Integration Analyst who will play a central role in identifying, implementing, and driving the adoption of AI-powered solutions throughout the organization.


Jobomschrijving

As AI Integration Analyst, you will act as the link between business teams, project management, IT stakeholders, and international AI communities.

Your mission will be to accelerate the practical adoption of AI by identifying high-value opportunities, supporting implementation projects, delivering training and workshops, and helping employees integrate AI tools into their day-to-day activities: AI Opportunity Identification & Business Engagement

  • Support departments in identifying productivity and efficiency gains through AI.



AI Implementation & Project Support

  • Coordinate and follow up on AI implementation projects across different business functions.
  • Work closely with project managers, data analysts, IT teams, and external partners.
  • Monitor project progress, adoption levels, and business outcomes.
  • Ensure AI initiatives are aligned with governance, compliance, and security requirements.



Training, Adoption & Change Management

  • Develop and deliver AI training sessions, awareness programs, and workshops.
  • Promote best practices for the use of AI technologies throughout the organization.
  • Drive user adoption through communication, coaching, and continuous support.
  • Contribute to the development of the organization's overall AI capabilities and maturity.



International Collaboration

  • Collaborate with colleagues and AI specialists from international entities.
  • Share knowledge, use cases, and implementation experiences.
  • Support the rollout of international AI initiatives at a local level.
  • Act as an ambassador for AI-driven transformation within the business.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in AI implementation, digital transformation, innovation, business analysis, project management, process improvement, or technology consulting.
  • Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging AI technologies.
  • Experience working within the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure AI, or similar technologies).
  • Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience supporting change management, training initiatives, and technology adoption.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on technical or programming experience is considered an asset but is not required.
  • Good command of Dutch and excellent English communication skills. French would be an advantage but is not required.

description:
Onze klant gelegen in Sint-Truiden is gespecialiseerd in HVAC-montage en technieken. Ze zijn niet een doorsnee chauffagist, maar staan voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. Wat ga je doen:

• Als commercieel medewerker verhuur ben je de held(in) die potentiële huurders met open armen ontvangt (figuurlijk dan, hè!).

• Je bent een ster in het verkopen van dromen - je vertelt vol passie over de accommodaties, de omgeving en alle leuke dingen die Oostduinkerke te bieden heeft.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

  • Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
  • Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
  • Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
  • Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
  • Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
  • Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
  • Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
  • Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
  • Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

title: Contextbegeleider Thuisbegeleidingsdienst (BJB) Onbepaalde duur
description:
Vzw Radar is een organisatie binnen de integrale jeugdhulp gevestigd te Ternat. In onze hulp- en dienstverlening richten we ons op minderjarigen, jongvolwassenen en hun gezin. We bieden ambulante ondersteuning en begeleiding op maat voor gezinnen waar kinderen / jongeren opgroeien in een verontrustende opvoedingssituatie. De focus van onze begeleiding ligt vooral op de veiligheid van de kinderen en het herstellen van de opvoedingsvaardigheden en de draagkracht van de ouders.
Vanuit onze organisatie zijn we op zoek naar een voltijdse (100% VTE of 38u) contextbegeleider (m/v).

Wat doe je als contextbegeleider?

• Je staat in voor de begeleiding en opvolging van een 8- tal gezinnen. Deze begeleiding gebeurt voornamelijk via huisbezoeken in de regio Brussel-Halle-Vilvoorde.

• Je kan procesmatig werken met ouders, kinderen en hun context.

• Je ondersteunt ouders in het opnemen van hun ouderrol en het versterken van hun draagkracht en opvoedingsvaardigheden.

• Je gelooft in kracht- en netwerkgerichtwerken met gezinnen binnen verontrustende opvoedingssituaties, je bent matuur en veerkrachtig ook in crisissituaties.

• Je werkt contextueel en handelt vanuit meerzijdige partijdigheid.

• Je hebt kennis van hechtingsdynamieken en kan van hieruit anticiperen op de opvoedingsnoden van de kinderen.

• Je werkt aanklampend en schrikt er niet van terug om moeilijke thema’s te benoemen.

Minimum diploma hoger onderwijs korte type A1 in een menswetenschappelijke richting.
• Bereidheid tot avondwerk, volgens de noden van het cliëntsysteem.
• Talenkennis: FRANS (goede kennis), NEDERLANDS (zeer goed).
• Werkervaring: ervaring of bereidheid tot leren.
• In het bezit zijn van een rijbewijs B en een wagen.
• Getuigschrift goed gedrag en zeden - model 2.

Jobgerelateerde competenties
• Kennis van de integrale jeugdhulp en van de sociale kaart van Brussel-Halle-Vilvoorde.
• Omgaan met verontrustende situaties.
• Inzicht in relatiepatronen en gezinsdynamieken.
• Kennis met betrekking tot de ontwikkeling van kinderen, jongeren.
• Kennis van thema’s zoals beroepsgeheim, rechtspositie jongeren, rechten van ouders, privacyrechten.
• Kennis van relevante hulpverleningsmethodieken met betrekking tot werken met gezinnen, ouders/jongeren/kinderen.
• Goede organisatorische vaardigheden, een planmatige aanpak.
• Goede en duidelijke communicatie, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
• Bereid om divers-sensitief te werken.
• Meertaligheid is een pluspunt.

Persoonsgebonden competenties
• Samenwerken binnen een hecht team
• Zelfstandig werken
• Sociaal vaardig zijn
• Beschikken over voldoende persoonlijke maturiteit en veerkracht
• Kunnen omgaan met stress
• Zich kunnen aanpassen aan veranderende omstandigheden (flexibiliteit)
• Leervermogen hebben

title: Allround medewerker Horeca/Fastfood
description:
Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap als leidinggevende? Zoek je een job met veel doorgroeimogelijkheden, een hecht team en de zekerheid van een stabiele werkgever? Dan hebben wij dé kans voor jou!

In deze functie stuur je het team aan tijdens jouw shift. Je zorgt dat alles soepel loopt: van een vlotte service tot tevreden klanten. Samen met je collega’s bouw je mee aan een positieve werksfeer én aan jouw toekomst. Je krijgt volop kansen om door te groeien richting hogere managementrollen.

Waarom is dit dé job voor jou?

  • Je zet je leidinggevende skills in én bouwt ze verder uit.
  • Je werkt in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat.
  • Je krijgt begeleiding en kansen om door te groeien.

Als shiftmanager start je in de functie van 'gewone' medewerker voor ongeveer een maand, om de flow te leren kennen, daarna start je aan jouw opleidingstraject als shiftmanager. Ongeveer een half jaar een examen in NL later ben je klaar om jouw rol op te nemen.

Als shiftmanager stuur jij samen met een collega shiftmanager een team van 25 mensen aan. Jullie krijgen de planning een maand op voorhand door.

Doorheen de dag lossen jullie problemen op in het team of met klanten. Belangrijk dus om communicatief sterk in jouw schoenen te staan.

Je werkt in vaste uurblokken die zich situeren tussen 8u 's morgens en 01.00u 's avonds.

  • Je bent communicatief zeer sterk en weet hoe je een team moet aansturen. People management ligt jou.
  • Je bent flexibel in werktijden, zowel in avondwerk als weekendwerk.
  • Je bent klaar om te groeien, zowel als persoon als in functie.

title: Teamleader Horeca
description:
Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van een bruisende werkvloer waar geen dag hetzelfde is?
Hou je ervan om een team te motiveren, structuur te brengen én tegelijk de handen uit de mouwen te steken? 
Dan zoeken wij jou!
In dit fastfoodrestaurant zorg je dat alles vlot verloopt, van bestelling tot die perfect afgeruimde tafel.
Naast het afleveren van die heerlijke burger en frietjes, bezorg je de klanten ook steeds een brede glimlach. 
En neem je ook nog eens volgend takenpakket met plezier voor je rekening:

  • Aansturen van je team en zorgen voor een positieve, resultaatgerichte sfeer
  • Kwaliteit van service en klantbeleving bewaken
  • Overzicht houden over planning, voorraad en dagelijkse werking
  • Je ondersteunt waar nodig, zowel op de vloer als achter de schermen

Als meewerkend teamlead bezit je volgende talenten:

  • Ervaring in de horeca is een must, ervaring in een leidinggevende rol is een plus
  • Stressbestendigheid en je blijft koel bij drukke momenten
  • Je ziet werk en bent flexibel in je takenpakket
  • Positiviteit is jouw 'middle name'
  • Verantwoordelijkheid
  • Je bent beschikbaar om te werken in shifts en 7/7

title: Expediteur Agriculture & Food
description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading logistics service providers operating worldwide. We offer tailor-made solutions along the entire supply chain for companies from a wide diversity of industries. From multimodal transports to perfect warehousing, from smooth customs clearance to innovative value-added services: We always keep our pulse on the times and are at our customers' side.

Als Expediteur bij het departement Agriculture & Food neem je de volledige verantwoordelijkheid over het A-Z beheer van internationale dossiers binnen je eigen klantenportefeuille. Dankzij jouw ervaring ben je een echte sparringpartner voor klanten en collega's en zorg je voor een vlotte, correcte en rendabele afhandeling van zowel import- als exportzendingen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Volledig dossierbeheer van A tot Z
    • Coördinatie en opvolging van import- en exportzendingen met focus op de productgroep Agriculture & Food.
    • Bewaken van deadlines, kosten en kwaliteit van dienstverlening.
  • Operationele & administratieve afhandeling
    • Correcte verwerking van transport- en douanedocumenten.
    • Nauwe opvolging van facturatie, tarieven en eventuele claims.
  • Communicatie & coördinatie
    • Centrale schakel tussen klanten, rederijen, transporteurs, douanediensten, magazijnen en interne afdelingen.
    • Proactief anticiperen op afwijkingen en bijsturen waar nodig.
  • Klantbeheer & advies
    • Eerste aanspreekpunt voor je klantenportefeuille.
    • Adviseren rond transportoplossingen, regelgeving en optimalisaties.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als expediteur import en/of export binnen de logistieke sector.
  • Grondige kennis van internationale transportstromen; kennis van douaneformaliteiten en -documentatie is een sterke troef.
  • Je werkt autonoom, neemt ownership over je dossiers en behoudt overzicht in complexe situaties.
  • Sterke communicator die professioneel en oplossingsgericht schakelt met diverse stakeholders.
  • Je beschouwt problemen als uitdagingen en voelt je thuis in een dynamische, afwisselende werkomgeving.
  • Goede kennis Nederlands, Engels en Frans.

title: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.


Jobomschrijving

  • Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
  • Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
  • Collective dismissals
  • Employment regulations and policies
  • Cross-border employment issues
  • Service agreements
  • Employment litigation
  • Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
  • Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
  • Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
  • Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

  • Qualified Belgian lawyer.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
  • Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
  • Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
  • Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
  • Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
  • Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
  • International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

title: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

  • Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
  • Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
  • Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
  • Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
  • Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
  • Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish

  • You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
  • You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
  • Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
  • A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

title: Verzorgende thuiszorg - regio Leuven (voltijds)
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn en huishouden.

Als verzorgende thuiszorg (zorgkundige)  geef je zorg en ondersteuning aan klanten in hun thuisomgeving. Samen met collega's ben je verantwoordelijk voor klanten in de regio.

  • Lichaamsverzorging van de klant.
  • Boodschappen doen en maaltijden bereiden (koken, broodmaaltijd, enz.).
  • Enkele huishoudelijke taken uitvoeren (strijken, wassen).
  • Luisteren naar en ondersteunen van de klant, met aandacht voor psychosociale noden en zelfredzaamheid.
  • Diploma als zorgkundige / verzorgende of gelijkwaardig (zie www.familiehulp.be/diploma).
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact en communiceert vlot.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor privacy zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
  • Bereidheid om avond- en weekendwerk in beurtrol te doen.
  • Eigen vervoer (auto bij voorkeur).

title: German-Speaking Customer Support Advisor | Telecommunications (m,w,d) anywhere in Bulgaria (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start : 14/9

Training online. One week to spend in Varna  after the training for the nesting phase. Afterwards anywhere in Bulgaria!

We are partnering with a leading international customer experience provider to recruit German-speaking Customer Support Advisors for a telecommunications project in Bulgaria.

This is a remote position within Bulgaria, combining customer service, technical troubleshooting, and light sales. You’ll support German-speaking customers with their mobile services, billing questions, and technical issues while identifying opportunities to recommend suitable additional products.

Important: While the role is remote, candidates must be available to complete 1 week of on-site nesting in Varna after the initial remote training period. The role operates Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with rotating shifts between 09:00 and 19:00.

Your Role

- Support German-speaking customers via phone and email
- Resolve technical, billing, and general service enquiries
- Handle complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution
- Troubleshoot customer issues and escalate more complex cases when necessary
- Accurately document customer interactions and relevant information
- Identify opportunities to recommend and cross-sell suitable products and services
- Deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience while meeting performance standards

Your Qualifications

- German C1
- English B1 or above
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Customer-focused and comfortable handling complaints
- Interest in troubleshooting and technical support
- Previous customer service or contact centre experience is an advantage, but not required
- Based in Bulgaria or willing to relocate

The Offer

- Remote working model within Bulgaria, with only 1 week of mandatory on-site nesting in Varna
- Indefinite employment contract
- Competitive salary plus performance bonus
- Uncapped sales bonus, averaging approximately €200/month
- Relocation package for eligible EU citizens, including transportation reimbursement and a €260/month accommodation allowance for the first 3 months
- Meal allowance
- Private health insurance
- Multisport and/or Coolfit card
- Access to an online learning platform
- Monday to Friday schedule – weekends off
- Comprehensive training and long-term career development opportunities

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%

title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: German-Speaking Customer Support Advisor | Telecommunications (m,w,d) anywhere in Bulgaria (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start : 14/9

Training online. One week to spend in Varna  after the training for the nesting phase. Afterwards anywhere in Bulgaria!

We are partnering with a leading international customer experience provider to recruit German-speaking Customer Support Advisors for a telecommunications project in Bulgaria.

This is a remote position within Bulgaria, combining customer service, technical troubleshooting, and light sales. You’ll support German-speaking customers with their mobile services, billing questions, and technical issues while identifying opportunities to recommend suitable additional products.

Important: While the role is remote, candidates must be available to complete 1 week of on-site nesting in Varna after the initial remote training period. The role operates Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with rotating shifts between 09:00 and 19:00.

- Support German-speaking customers via phone and email
- Resolve technical, billing, and general service enquiries
- Handle complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution
- Troubleshoot customer issues and escalate more complex cases when necessary
- Accurately document customer interactions and relevant information
- Identify opportunities to recommend and cross-sell suitable products and services
- Deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience while meeting performance standards

Your Qualifications

- German C1
- English B1 or above
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Customer-focused and comfortable handling complaints
- Interest in troubleshooting and technical support
- Previous customer service or contact centre experience is an advantage, but not required
- Based in Bulgaria or willing to relocate

The Offer

- Remote working model within Bulgaria, with only 1 week of mandatory on-site nesting in Varna
- Indefinite employment contract
- Competitive salary plus performance bonus
- Uncapped sales bonus, averaging approximately €200/month
- Relocation package for eligible EU citizens, including transportation reimbursement and a €260/month accommodation allowance for the first 3 months
- Meal allowance
- Private health insurance
- Multisport and/or Coolfit card
- Access to an online learning platform
- Monday to Friday schedule – weekends off
- Comprehensive training and long-term career development opportunities

title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta učitelja/učiteljice razredne nastave na talijanskom jeziku u produženom boravku na neodređeno i puno radno vrijeme – 2 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice, uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. description:

- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja. Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
