title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ? title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)
description:
Description de tâches:


Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg:

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.
Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg


We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.


What you will be working on:

Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.


What we look for:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.


What you will get:

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

description:
Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Experience with SQL
• Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
• Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
• Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Wir schaffen nachhaltige Lebenswelten, die begeistern. Wer in eine stabile und nachhaltige Zukunft investieren will, kommt an realen Werten nicht vorbei. Bei der Commerz Real, einem Unternehmen der Commerzbank Gruppe, stehen diese bereits seit 50 Jahren im Mittelpunkt. Ob Immobilien, Solarparks, Leitungsnetze oder Produktionsanlagen: Wir konzentrieren uns auf attraktive Sachwertinvestments, die wir mit rund 780 Mitarbeitenden im In- und Ausland für unsere Kund*innen optimal strukturieren.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Du begleitest das Team bei der Strukturierung und dem Erwerb von Immobilien, nachhaltigen Infrastrukturprojekten sowie Equity oder Private Debt Investmentprodukten
- Du erstellst Reportings von Fonds und SPVs nach LUX GAAP oder IFRS
- Als Ansprechpartner übernimmst du die Koordination und Steuerung von externen und internen Dienstleistern (z.B. Wirtschaftsprüfer, Rechts- und Steuerberater, Zentralverwalter, Buchhalter)
- Du überprüfst Steuererklärungen und Steueranmeldungen
- Du verantwortest das Liquiditätsmanagement in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Finanzdienstleistungsteam
- Du arbeitest bei der laufenden Verbesserung der Qualität und Effizienz im Bereich Finance mit und Du bist aktiv eingebunden in unsere Projekte betreffend Technologie und Prozessoptimierung

Profil:

- Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Accounting (je nach Erfahrung und Kenntnissen erfolgt die Eingruppierung auf eine Junior- oder Senior- Position)
- Du kennst die einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze)
- Du bist geübt im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere MS Excel und MS PowerPoint
- Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke sowie sicheres Auftreten aus
- Deine Zielstrebigkeit, Eigeninitiative sowie Dein unternehmerisches Denken machen Dich zum idealen Kandidat

Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)

title: Plongeuse / Plongeur (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Assurer la plonge et le nettoyage des ustensiles et matériel de cuisine et de la salle.
Veiller au bon fonctionnement du poste de plonge, au rangement et à l'entretien.
Avoir le sens du détail pour la propreté et le respect du matériel et des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité.
La personne devra manipuler du matériel volumineux, mais surtout de la vaisselle et de petites pièces fragiles.

Vous assurerez également le polissage régulier des couverts en argent et contribuerez au maintien des plus hauts standards de propreté et de présentation de notre établissement. Nous recherchons une personne minutieuse, organisée, respectueuse du matériel et capable de manipuler une vaisselle de grande valeur avec le plus grand soin.
Travail en station debout prolongée, environnement de travail humide, manipulation de matériel parfois lourd, rythme soutenu pendant les heures de travail.

Doit être en possession d'une voiture privée.

Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé:

Travailler en station debout prolongée, environnement de travail humide, manipulation de matériel parfois lourd, rythme soutenu pendant les heures de travail.
Horaires samedi et dimanche inclus.

title: Policy Administration Officer - CDD 12 months (m/f)
description:
Policy Administration Officer - CDD 12 months

Partner & Client Services - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role – Are you ready for a challenge?

As Policy Administration Officer, you will support the end-to-end management of client payment requests and ensure a high-quality service to clients, partners, and internal teams. You will play a key role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in day-to-day operational activities. Your attention to detail and client-centric approach will help maintain our high standards of service and compliance.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Manage client money-out requests from receipt to payment,
(acknowledgement, documentation collection, system input, etc.),
• Conduct due diligence reviews in line with corporate standard to ensure AML/KYC reviews and updates where required,
• Comply with procedures, controls, industry rules and regulations,
• Monitor ongoing transactions until completion and payment,
• Respond to client and partner queries via email and other channels swiftly and accurately to help achieve customer satisfaction as well as service standards,
• Prepare, scan, send confirmation letters and other necessary communication,
• Perform servicing and maintenance tasks on policies,
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate processing,
• Assist colleagues with daily tasks and contribute to continuous process improvement,
• Meet Service Level Agreements and deadlines,
• Uphold quality standards.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our Policy Administration Officer?

• University Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Management or any other relevant field and/or relevant experience in Client Services/ Policy Administration in the insurance sector,
• Previous experience in life insurance, banking, financial services, or operations is an asset,
• Fluency in English. Any other European language is an asset,
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy,
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills,
• Knowledge of AML / KYC requirements preferred,
• Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks,
• Team-player with a proactive and flexible mindset,
• Proficient in Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

Utmost Luxembourg S.A. is aware of its obligations under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and is committed to processing your data securely and transparently.

Our Recruitment Privacy Notice is in line with GDPR and provides more information with regards to the types of data that we collect and hold on you as a job applicant, including for the performance of Background Checks.  It also sets out how we use that information, how long we keep it for and other relevant information about your data. For full details please click here Recruitment Privacy Statement

title: Chef de Rang (m/f)
description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

Autres avantages:  Parking, Repas.

description:
Description de tâches:


Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg:

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.
Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg


We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.


What you will be working on:

Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.


What we look for:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.


What you will get:

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;
• Participate in ICT and security projects;
• Adopting a growth mind-set, promoting a culture of security;
• Excellent team player with proactive and autonomous work ethics;
• Strong analytical skills with attention to details;
• Awareness of professional ethics, risk and compliance;
• Fluent in English

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

Job Description

Join a global financial services firm where your work helps strengthen trust in the financial system and supports how we serve clients worldwide. You will collaborate with partners across operations, technology, and compliance to deliver clear, well-evidenced outcomes in a fast-moving regulatory environment. You will build relationships, shape governance routines, and help ensure critical deliverables are tracked and closed with discipline.

As an AML Governance & Oversight Associate, 1st Line of Defense within our Outsourcing, Operations, and Technology organization, you will help coordinate the governance cadence that keeps anti-money laundering actions, regulatory and audit deliverables, and escalation items controlled, evidenced, and closed on time—working closely with first and second line partners across the firm.

Job responsibilities

• Support the AML 1LoD Lead as the business/operations interface to 2LoD/GFCC by coordinating inputs, aligning expectations, and surfacing key decisions, risks, and dependencies for action/escalation.
• Maintain the single source of truth for AML matters, including the JPMSE AML Areas of Concern and the Issue/Action Register, ensuring clear ownership, target dates, dependencies, and documented closure evidence/status.
• Identify, triage, and track emerging AML risks/issues (1LoD lens), prepare concise escalation summaries, and monitor escalations through to closure in line with agreed governance.
• Support the coordination and quality-check regulatory RFIs end-to-end (intake, scoping, stakeholder outreach, drafting coordination, and evidence collation) and produce final response packs for AML 1LoD Lead review and sign-off.
• Support AML audit activity (internal and external) as the 1LoD engagement support point of contact, including the PwC AML AFS Audit (JPMSE): manage auditor communications, RFI trackers, and walkthrough logistics; coordinate evidence requests/compilation; and drive action tracking to closure to ensure consistent messaging, evidence discipline, and timely stakeholder follow-up.
• Coordinate the AMLA data questionnaire by managing inputs, challenge/validation, tracking, evidence collation, and final pack preparation for sign-off.
• Support AML New Product Assessment activities by coordinating required inputs, tracking actions, and preparing evidence/assessment materials for AML 1LoD Lead review.
• Support regulatory strategy and change monitoring by tracking regulatory change and industry developments impacting JPMSE; maintaining a regulatory change/watch-items tracker (aligned with 2LoD) with actions, owners, and dates; and reporting progress on a regular cadence.
• Provide programme/project governance support (plans, RAID logs, milestones, governance updates), with particular focus on the EU AML Reform Program for Outsourcing.
• Run the quarterly BAU cycle for AML Outsourcing Framework maintenance (including the Outsourcing Register) and coordinate regulatory notifications for new outsourcing.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

• Demonstrable experience operating within a 1LoD control environment, issue management, governance forums, escalation, evidence discipline, and sustainable remediation.
• Experience in AML and/or wider Financial Crime topics (e.g., AML governance, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, fraud) and how these translate into business/operations requirements.
• Experience coordinating responses to regulatory requests and/or audits (RFIs, evidence packs, walkthrough coordination), with strong attention to defensibility and consistency of messaging.
• Ability to manage data quality in a controlled way (data sourcing understanding, reconciliations/checks, exception tracking, root cause themes, and prevention), ideally for regulatory submissions/questionnaires.
• Able to influence and drive outcomes across Business, Operations, Technology and 2LoD partners (including GFCC), including confident follow-up and escalation where required.
• Proven ability to run multiple workstreams concurrently, maintain trackers and governance cadence, and drive actions to closure under tight timelines and competing priorities.
• Strong written and verbal skills, produces concise, senior-ready updates and materials that are audit/regulator appropriate.
• Excellent Microsoft office skills, Excel ,Power Point and Word.
• Practical knowledge of Automation Tools such as Alteryx and Tableau

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

• German language proficiency (written and spoken) preferred

More specifically, you will join the Operations division which includes the maintenance and operation of the technical installations, managed by a team of four people.

Your role:

Expected services:

Continuously ensuring proper functioning of facilities, good condition of workplaces and user satisfaction. All areas inside campuses are included, particularly laboratories where the infrastructures are linked to sensitive activities with high technological and regulatory requirements. The work environment includes the following: energy production and distribution, HVAC, fluid and gas distribution, sanitary installations, electrical installations. As a maintenance officer in charge of those installations, you ensure their availability, compliance with health and safety regulations and efficient energy use while always being user comfort oriented.
Preventive maintenance of the technical installations covered by this position is outsourced to external providers. For troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on these same installations, the University performs the work both internally and externally depending on their complexity. Given that the University outsources the maintenance of its technical installations, the maintenance levels expected for this position are 1 and 2 (according to French standard NF X60-000 - 2016).

Responsibilities:

• Regular inspections of installations, use of the internal service request processing platform and the CMMS software
• Use of facilities monitoring software, data interpretation
• Support and follow-up of interventions by external service providers, ensuring their execution according to the planned schedule and scope of intervention, e.g., maintenance on the main technical installations: HVAC, electricity, carpentry, periodical inspections, various scale work
• Contribute to solving non-compliance observations made by regulation bodies
• Verification of intervention reports and delivery slips
• Carry out inventory monitoring and ensure proper level of stocks
• Requesting price quotes from external service providers, issuing purchase orders
• Regular reporting to management, provide proposals and recommendations for improvements

Scope of activities:

The work will be performed at one or more of the University's sites. The usual working hours are from 7am to 4pm, Monday to Friday. description:
Data Management Lead | SEB, Luxembourg

Luxembourg
Wealth & Asset Management – Private Wealth Management & Family Office /
Technology & Data / On-site

Shape the future of data at SEB! Lead Data Governance and drive BCBS239 compliance for our international Private Wealth Management & Family Office business, making a significant impact across Luxembourg, Norway, and Finland.

At SEB, we recognize that the world of finance is evolving at an extraordinary speed. That's why we're committed to driving towards a more sustainable future for everyone — people, businesses, and society. Since we welcomed our first customer in 1856, we have been a catalyst for positive change by providing reliable advice and capital to people with ideas for the future. If you are ready to make your mark on our industry and positively shape the world, you will thrive at SEB.

About the role

As Data Management Lead for PWM&FO based in Luxembourg, you will establish Data Governance and implement Data Management practices across Luxembourg, Norway, and Finland, aligned with SEB's policy.

You will assign data owners, educate the organization and ensure sound data management across all customer segments, products, and distribution channels, adhering to SEB's framework.

You will represent PWM&FO in data area councils and other relevant data related fora. You will also lead the BCBS239 regulation project in Luxembourg and secure compliance and define a Data Product roadmap for the sites in scope.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

• Proven experience in establishing Data Governance and implementing Data Management practices in a financial setting.
• Solid expertise in regulatory compliance, specifically with BCBS239, and leading related projects.
• Familiarity with concepts such as Data Architecture, Data Mesh and Data products, with the ability to define and execute a Data Product roadmap.
• In-depth knowledge about data governance and sound data management practices aligned with policy and framework guidelines.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to represent effectively in relevant fora and collaborate across divisions, segments and product areas.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• A diverse, inclusive and equal environment
• Attractive compensation that reflects your experience and contribution
• Opportunity to build connections with a top-level customer network
• Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment
• Long-term stability and growth as a company

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  

Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts:  
https://sebgroup.com/career & https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

Ready to join?

- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)

Relocation-Paket

- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

How often should you perform plant care?
Industrial plant care requires daily monitoring and weekly maintenance - discover optimal scheduling strategies for reliable operations.
Categories: Process IT
- https://conet.nl/news/process-it/how-often-should-you-perform-plant-care/
Regular plant care in industrial settings should be performed according to a structured maintenance schedule that varies by system type and operational demands. Critical systems require daily monitoring, while comprehensive maintenance typically occurs weekly to monthly. The frequency depends on equipment complexity, operating conditions, and regulatory requirements. Effective plant care combines preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and system optimization to ensure reliable operations. What does regular plant care actually involve?
Regular plant care encompasses comprehensive maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, routine inspections, equipment servicing, and system optimization. This approach focuses on identifying and addressing potential issues before they cause operational disruptions or safety concerns.
The fundamental difference between reactive and proactive maintenance approaches defines successful plant care strategies. Reactive maintenance responds to equipment failures after they occur, often resulting in costly downtime and emergency repairs. Proactive plant care involves scheduled maintenance activities, continuous monitoring, and systematic inspections that prevent failures before they happen.

Ben jij op zoek naar een zelfstandige baan waarbij je onderweg bent? Lijkt het jou leuk om technische storingen op te lossen aan onze automaten? Dan is Vending@Work in Groningen op zoek naar jou!
Over Vending@Work
Vending@Work (V@W) is opgericht in 1994 te Groningen en begon destijds met het plaatsen van zogeheten honestyboxen bij bedrijven en instellingen. Het concept was gebaseerd op de eerlijkheid van de mens. Consumenten konden betalen met een gulden voor elk artikel dat zij uit de box haalden, maar konden dit ook niet doen. Vooral bij grotere organisaties hield dit concept niet lang stand, zodat in 1998 werd besloten tot het plaatsen en exploiteren van frisdrank-, snack- en versautomaten. Vandaag de dag bedient V@W vanuit drie distributiecentra (Groningen, Nieuwegein en Nijmegen ) circa 5.000 automaten in Nederland. Daarnaast verzorgt V@W in meerdere school- en bedrijfskantines de catering. Met de inzet van circa 250 medewerkers is V@W daarmee één van de grootste landelijke spelers in de markt van vending.
Voor onze vestiging in Groningen zijn wij op zoek naar een plaatser / medewerker Technische Dienst in de buitendienst.
Over de functie
In deze functie ga je zelfstandig op pad met de bestelbus om storingen te verhelpen aan automaten bij onze opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het (gebruiksklaar) plaatsen en ophalen van de automaten. Ook voer je technisch onderhoud uit zodat de automaten perfect blijven functioneren. Verder ben je telefonische vraagbaak voor onze operators bij storingen.
Wat wij vragen? - Minimaal MBO-niveau - Affiniteit met techniek - Bij voorkeur al in het bezit van VCA-B en anders bereid dit diploma te behalen - In het bezit van een rijbewijs B - 30 of 40 uur per week beschikbaar (verdeeld over 3 of 4 dagen) - Fysiek sterk

title: Postdoc AI in psychiatry
description:
In this position you will develop AI models to improve the lives of patients with psychiatric disorders. Interested? Apply now! In this project, you will develop predictive AI models that support clinically actionable outcomes for psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. Working closely with (neuro)scientists and clinicians, you will translate cutting-edge AI methods into solutions for real-world clinical challenges. Your research will span a broad range of modelstopics, including deep learning, causal machine learning, distributed learning, unsupervised learning, foundation models, natural language processing, and explainable AI. A key challenge is that psychiatric research often relies on relatively small datasets, that while biomedical data are limited, and that data are subject to strict privacy requirements. You will work with a rich variety of data sources, including clinical data, (unstructured) electronic health records, MRI, time-series data (such as EEG, functional MRI, speech, and video), omics data, and mobile sensing. Amsterdam UMC offers access to extensive large datasets for model development and diagnostics, while also providing a unique opportunity to develop AI models for actionable problems for methods that remain effective in the small-data settings that are common in psychiatric research. You will develop innovative AI tools to improve the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. You will initiate and lead AI research projects in close collaboration with clinicians and researchers, combining cutting-edge AI methods with pressing clinical challenges. In addition to conducting your own research, you will (co-)supervise PhD candidates and initiate research projects for AI _tudents, helping to foster the next generation of researchers. Jouw hart gaat sneller kloppen als het om logistiek gaat. Je werkt en denkt op mbo-niveau, bij voorkeur als logistiek medewerker. Van nature denk je in oplossingen en niet in problemen. Allround Monteur Binnendienst - Terberg Used Equipment Location: Benschop
Als Allround Monteur Binnendienst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van service-, onderhouds-, revisie- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan Terberg tractors en carriers.
Wat ga je doen?
In deze rol ben je breed inzetbaar binnen de serviceorganisatie en werk je zelfstandig aan uiteenlopende technische vraagstukken binnen meerdere productgroepen. Je werkt zelfstandig en bent breed inzetbaar binnen de serviceorganisatie en op minimaal drie productgroepen.
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden: - Stellen van diagnoses en oplossen van storingen - Onderhouden, reviseren en repareren van voertuigen - Gereedmaken van voertuigen voor verkoop - Ontvangen, beoordelen en plannen van werkopdrachten - Stellen van diagnoses en bepalen van werkzaamheden (i.s.m. servicecoördinatie) - Bestellen van onderdelen en gereedschappen - Uitvoeren van onderhoud, reparaties, revisies en constructiewerk - Verrichten van keuringen en begeleiden van tests/proefdraaien - Administreren van werkzaamheden en opstellen van servicerapporten - Klaarmaken van voertuigen voor verkoop of externe bewerking - Instrueren van gebruikers en bijdragen aan procesverbetering - Adviseren van leidinggevende over technische en commerciële zaken
Wie ben je en wat breng je mee? - Technisch opleidingsniveau: MBO-3 / MBO-4 (of vergelijkbaar) - Brede technische kennis (mechanica, hydrauliek, elektrotechniek, etc.) - Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring - Ervaring met diagnosesystemen en voertuigsoftware - Inzetbaar op meerdere productgroepen - Probleemoplossend vermogen en zelfstandigheid - In bezit van relevante rijbewijzen
Wat bieden wij?
Als collega van Terberg krijg je een mooie functie bij een van de belangrijkste en grootste maakbedrijven van Nederland. We werken van maandag tot en met vrijdagmorgen, vrijdagmiddag ben je vrij. De sfeer in ons familiebedrijf is prettig en je gaat aan de slag binnen een gemo...
