title: storingstechnieker Weekendploeg nacht
description:
Als technieker speel je een cruciale rol in het garanderen van een vlot en efficiënt productieproces. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het preventief onderhoud van ons geavanceerde machinepark, bestaande uit onder andere industriële molens, persen en diverse productielijnen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat ook de ondersteunende installaties, zoals verwarmingssystemen, stoominstallaties en koelinstallaties, optimaal blijven functioneren.

Wanneer zich technische storingen of defecten voordoen, ga je snel en doelgericht te werk om de oorzaak te achterhalen en een duurzame oplossing te bieden. Dankzij jouw technische expertise beperk je stilstanden tot een minimum en draag je rechtstreeks bij aan de continuïteit van onze productieactiviteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met een team van ervaren techniekers, waarbij kennisdeling en collegialiteit centraal staan. Samen streven jullie naar een veilige, betrouwbare en performante productieomgeving. In deze functie rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Maintenance Manager, die jou ondersteunt in je verdere ontwikkeling en groei binnen de organisatie.

  • Je hebt een technische achtergrond, bij voorkeur in elektromechanica, elektriciteit of elektronica.
  • Je bent een allround technieker met kennis van zowel mechanische als elektrische installaties, aangevuld met basiskennis van pneumatica, hydraulica en PLC's.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een productieomgeving en hebt hierin reeds relevante ervaring opgedaan.
  • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en kan zelfstandig werken.
  • Flexibiliteit is voor jou vanzelfsprekend: werken in vaste weekend nacht of roterend

title: Service technieker
description:
Als service technieker ben je dagelijks op pad om onderhoud en herstellingen uit te voeren aan elektrische en HVAC-installaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat systemen veilig en betrouwbaar blijven werken. Naast technische werken, ben je ook het aanspreekpunt voor klanten en geef je advies over het gebruik en onderhoud van hun installaties.

Je dag begint meestal met een planning van de uit te voeren opdrachten. Je voert inspecties en preventief onderhoud uit bij klanten ter plaatse. Bij storingen ga je op zoek naar de oorzaak en herstel je het probleem zo snel mogelijk. Je documenteert elke uitgevoerde taak en rapporteert hierover. Tussendoor neem je de tijd om klanten professioneel te woord te staan en werk je samen met collega’s om de service te optimaliseren.

Ben jij communicatief sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig én in team, en hou je van afwisseling? Dan is deze job iets voor jou. Solliciteer snel en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kan maken als service technieker.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met techniek en bent bekwaam met gereedschappen en meetinstrumenten
  • Je communiceert vlot en professioneel met klanten
  • Je kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken
  • Je bent goed georganiseerd en kan efficiënt prioriteiten stellen
  • Ervaring is een pluspunt, maar schoolverlaters zijn ook welkom
  • Je hebt een diploma op minimaal lager secundair onderwijsniveau of hoger
  • Je bent bereid om fulltime te werken (38-40u/week)

title: Vertriebsaußendienst Ventiltechnik BeNeLux (m/w/d) (Außendienstmitarbeiter/in)
description:
Ventiltechnik verbindet Märkte und Menschen

Vertriebsaußendienst Ventiltechnik BeNeLux (m/w/d) in Eindhoven

Als spezialisierte Personalvermittlung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau unterstützen wir aktuell ein international tätiges Unternehmen bei der Besetzung einer spannenden Vertriebsposition im BeNeLux-Raum. Gesucht wird eine*n Sales Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich Ventiltechnik für die Märkte Niederlande und Belgien. Unser Kunde entwickelt und vertreibt magnetgesteuerte Ventile, druckgesteuerte Systeme sowie individuelle Lösungen für industrielle Anwendungen. Die Position bietet viel Gestaltungsspielraum, internationale Kundenkontakte und wird durch uns im Rahmen einer Direktanstellung beim Kunden besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Sie betreuen Bestandskunden in den Niederlanden und Belgien technisch und vertrieblich.
- Sie bauen bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt aus und gewinnen neue Geschäftspartner.
- Sie beraten Kunden zu Ventiltechnik, Fluidlösungen und individuellen Systemanwendungen.
- Sie analysieren technische Anforderungen und entwickeln passende Lösungskonzepte.
- Sie koordinieren Projekte gemeinsam mit internen Fachabteilungen und begleiten Angebote bis zum Abschluss.
- Sie beobachten Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und identifizieren neue Vertriebspotenziale.

Ihr Profil:

- Sie verfügen über eine technische oder technisch-kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Fluidtechnik, Maschinenbau oder Automatisierungstechnik.
- Sie bringen Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte mit.
- Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten beim Kunden.
- Sie besitzen Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ein gutes technisches Verständnis für industrielle Anwendungen.
- Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der BeNeLux-Region sowie idealerweise ein Wohnsitz in den Niederlanden.

Was unser Kunde bietet:

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum im internationalen Vertrieb.
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Prozesse und Märkte.
- Spannende Kundenprojekte im industriellen Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.
- Ein wertschätzendes, mittelständisch geprägtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
- Attraktive Vergütung sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten:

- Persönliche Beratung und individuelle Begleitung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses.
- Zugang zu exklusiven Positionen im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau mit internationalem Umfeld.
- Direkte Vermittlung in eine langfristige Festanstellung bei unserem Kunden.
- Vertrauliche und professionelle Betreuung mit transparenter Kommunikation.
- Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf Gespräche sowie während aller weiteren Prozessschritte.

Unser Kunde steht für technische Präzision, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und nachhaltige Lösungen im industriellen Umfeld. Durch langjährige Erfahrung in der Ventil- und Fluidtechnik bietet das Unternehmen stabile Strukturen, internationale Marktpräsenz und moderne Vertriebsprozesse. Mitarbeitende profitieren von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem Umfeld, das Innovation, Teamgeist und persönliche Weiterentwicklung aktiv fördert.

Interesse?

RWB Water ist Spezialist für industrielle Wasseraufbereitung und entwickelt, baut sowie betreibt Anlagen für Trinkwasser-, Prozesswasser- und Abwasseranwendungen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Serviceteams suchen wir einen engagierten Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d).

- Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst im rotierenden System - einmal in 8 Wochen

title: Begeleider wonen WBC Aan de Pas in Bunde
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Wonen Plus een begeleider wonen WBC Aan de Pas.

Onze cliënten
Je werkt of gaat naar school, je gaat op vakantie, maakt heerlijke uitjes, voedt kinderen op. Je leidt het leven dat je wilt en je maakt daarin jouw keuzes. En dan opeens gebeurt er iets waardoor alles niet meer vanzelfsprekend is. Een auto-ongeluk, een hersenbloeding, een ziekte; je mogelijkheden zijn opeens beperkt door het hersenletsel dat je hebt opgelopen. Van de ene op de andere dag is er een breuk in jouw levenslijn.
Al onze cliënten hebben iets gemeenschappelijks. Vanuit het “normale” leven dat iedereen leefde, is er dat moment geweest dat alles drastisch veranderde en er ineens een beroep gedaan moest worden op professionele zorg. SGL is de NAH expert die juist deze mensen helpt in hun stap om weer regie terug te krijgen. Fysieke ondersteuning, mentale ondersteuning, begeleiding en professionele zorg, allemaal afgestemd op elke cliënt afzonderlijk.
Voor ons is het vanzelfsprekend dat iedereen dromen, wensen en doelen heeft. Dus ook als je een beperking hebt. Iedereen wil actief meedoen in de samenleving, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en keuzes maken. Bij SGL helpen we mensen daarbij.

Onze medewerkers
Je ziet de mens achter de beperkingen en je wilt je erin verdiepen om hem of haar goed te begeleiden en te verzorgen. Iedere mens is anders, jij stemt daarom jouw handelen af op de behoefte van deze unieke persoon. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar zijn of haar mogelijkheden ondanks de breuk in de levenslijn en zoekt hoe je hem of haar zoveel mogelijk de eigen regie kan geven. Ook begeleid je de client in het contact met mede cliënten. Groepsdynamiek vind je interessant, conflictsituaties ervaar je als een uitdaging. Uitvoeren van verzorgende taken vind je vanzelfsprekend.
Je denkt in mogelijkheden, durft grenzen te stellen, je bent daadkrachtig en een no-nonsense type.
Met collega’s bespreek je je eigen handelen en hoe je als team nog betere begeleiding kan bieden. Waar nodig stem je af met collega’s van behandeling & expertise of met andere professionals zoals de huisarts, apotheek, zorgpartners. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor de acties die beschreven staan in het ondersteuningsplan. Krachten van het hele team worden gebundeld en op maat ingezet voor onze cliënten. De cultuur waarin we samenwerken is te beschrijven als een grote familie.

Waar ga je aan de slag?
Woonbegeleidingscentrum Aan de pas is een thuis voor mensen met een lichamelijke beperking. Binnen Aan de pas wordt niet alleen gewoond, maar wordt ook gelogeerd en er worden verschillende vormen van dagbesteding aangeboden in en uit huis en leuke variërende vrijetijdsactiviteiten.
Er wonen 20 volwassen met een niet aangeboren hersenletsel en er zijn 2 logeerplekken. Naast begeleiding hebben zij ook persoonlijke verzorging nodig.
Ook verpleegtechnische handelingen zijn aan de orde. Specifiek in WBC Aan de Pas is dat een aantal bewoners met spierziekte ook afhankelijk zijn van beademing.
Cliënten beschikken allen over een eigen appartement en kunnen gebruik maken van een gezamenlijke huiskamer.
Een werkdag start met bewoners uit bed halen, douchen en verzorgen zodat zij op tijd klaar staan voor de taxi naar het activiteitencentrum of werk. Je zorgt voor een zinvolle dag voor alle bewoners. Deze locatie kent een “wakkere” nachtdienst van twee SGL medewerkers.

Wat breng jij mee

  • Je hebt een vakgerichte mbo 3 opleiding afgerond ,Verzorgende IG, verpleegkundige, MMZ persoonlijk begeleider gehandicaptenzorg of SPW
  • Je bent in staat om snel te kunnen schakelen in verschillende ondersteuningsvragen
  • Je hebt een zelfstandige werkhouding, bent initiatiefrijk en kunt tevens goed werken in teamverband
  • Je bent bereid tot het werken in een onregelmatig dienstrooster, vaste voorkeur is mogelijk
  • Je herkent jezelf in de drie kerncompetenties samenwerken, eigenaarschap en zelfreflectie
  • Je hebt een proactieve houding, werkt vanuit de ondersteuningsvraag en bent in staat om cliënten vertrouwen te geven in hun eigen kunnen
  • Je hebt lef, bent nieuwsgierig, enthousiast, en krijgt mensen mee.

40 uur per week, Berkel en Rodenrijs, omgeving Rotterdam
Wat ga jij doen als Productieplanner?
Als Productieplanner ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse planning van onze verpakkingsactiviteiten. Je vertaalt klantvraag, voorraadniveaus en productiecapaciteit naar een realistische en efficiënte planning en zorgt ervoor dat de operatie soepel blijft verlopen.
Je bent veel aanwezig op de werkvloer en werkt nauw samen met teamleiders, productie, logistiek en supply chain collega's. Wanneer omstandigheden veranderen, weet jij snel te schakelen en de juiste keuzes te maken.
Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: - Opstellen en beheren van de korte- en middellange termijn planning. - Inplannen van verpakkingsopdrachten op basis van klantvraag, voorraad en capaciteit. - Bewaken van de voortgang en bijsturen waar nodig. - Vrijgeven van productieorders en zorgen voor beschikbare materialen en halffabricaten. - Optimaliseren van de bezetting en efficiëntie van de verpakkingslijnen. - Signaleren van knelpunten en bijdragen aan verbeteringen binnen het planningsproces.
Een typische dag als Productieplanner
Je start de dag met het beoordelen van de planning en stemt af met collega's op de werkvloer. Gedurende de dag houd je de voortgang van de productie en verpakkingsactiviteiten nauwlettend in de gaten. Loopt een lijn anders dan gepland...

title: Verzorgende IG met hart voor de zorg!
description:
Bij Medicalhunt zoeken wij een Verzorgende IG'er die op zoek is naar een veelzijdige, afwisselende baan in de ouderenzorg.

Werkervaring in de functie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Wel is het belangrijk dat je beschikt over een zorgdiploma van minimaal helpende niveau.

Ben jij een Verzorgende IG die houdt van afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en vrijheid in je werk? Dan hebben wij de baan voor jou!


Als Verzorgende IG via detachering spring jij in bij verschillende zorginstellingen: van verpleeghuizen en thuiszorg tot revalidatiecentra. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je ondersteunt cliënten met hun dagelijkse zorg, voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en zorgt voor een warme en veilige omgeving.

Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team. Na deze periode ga je door naar een nieuwe, uitdagende opdracht. Je kan kiezen voor afwisseling tussen verschillende doelgroepen, hebt de mogelijkheid om een opdracht te verlengen wanneer deze goed bevalt of je kiest voor een doelgroep die jou het meeste aanspreekt.


Bij Medicalhunt sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt een vaste contactpersoon en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet: zorgen voor anderen!


Wat maakt detacheren nou zo leuk?

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Zekerheid: Een arbeidscontract bij ons voor een x aantal uren in de week, mét de flexibiliteit van detachering;

Ontwikkeling: Wij investeren in jouw groei met trainingen en opleidingen;

Teamspirit: Ook al werk je op verschillende locaties, je maak echt deel uit van team Medicalhunt. We staan altijd voor je klaar en zetten jouw werkgeluk op nummer 1!

description:
Als klantenservice medewerker alarmcentrale bij VHD Alarmcentrale ondersteun je mensen die in het buitenland te maken krijgen met medische noodgevallen of onverwachte reisproblemen. Je brengt de situatie in kaart, zoekt uit wat er binnen de verzekering mogelijk is en zorgt dat de juiste hulp wordt geregeld.


Je werkt veel met complexe dossiers die langere tijd kunnen lopen. Daarom is een groot deel van je werk administratief. Je verwerkt informatie nauwkeurig, bewaakt de voortgang en houdt contact met reizigers, betrokken partijen en collega's. Bij medische situaties werk je samen met de artsen van VHD. Zij geven het medische advies, terwijl jij zorgt voor de praktische en administratieve afhandeling.


Jouw werkzaamheden:


• Adviseren en begeleiden bij medische noodgevallen in het buitenland, zoals ziekenhuisopnames, behandelingen en terugkeer naar Nederland.
• Uitzoeken welke zorg, behandeling, accommodatie of terugreis binnen de verzekeringsdekking valt.
• Coördineren van praktische zaken rondom medische repatriëring, bijvoorbeeld wanneer iemand na een ongeval of ziekenhuisopname terug naar Nederland moet.
• Meedenken over oplossingen wanneer iemand door medische omstandigheden tijdelijk niet kan vliegen, bijvoorbeeld door een langer verblijf te regelen.
• Onderhouden van contact met reizigers, patiënten en nabestaanden in complexe en soms emotioneel zware situaties.
• Ondersteunen bij de repatriëring van Nederlanders die in het buitenland zijn overleden.
• Behandelen van reisclaims, zoals vermiste bagage, gemiste vluchten, gestolen eigendommen en problemen met accommodaties.
• Bijhouden en beheren van langdurige en complexe dossiers en zorgen dat alle informatie actueel en compleet is.
• Samenwerken met artsen en zorgprofessionals binnen VHD en verwerken van actuele informatie over de situatie van een patiënt.

title: Account Executive
description:
Om stillingen

Med store inverstornavn i ryggen som blant annet Antler og StartupLab, og en vekst på over 300% så langt i år, er vi rigget for å ta Kobbr videre. Vi søker derfor en uredd og engasjert Account Executive til en sentral rolle i salgsteamet, som ønsker å “brette opp erma” og være med på vårt spennende veksteventyr.

Som Account Executive vil du være ansvarlig for hele salgsprosessen fra å identifisere og kontakte potensielle nye kunder, til å forhandle frem og lukke avtaler. I tillegg vil du være ansvarlig for å følge opp din egen kundeportefølje og representere selskapet utad på messer og andre bransje-events. Du vil jobbe selvstendig men også i tett samarbeid med resten av salgsteamet for å nå våre vekstmålen, og sikre at vi har en bunnsolid salgsprosess til enhver tid.

Som Account Executive vil du være en ekspert på å forstå våre løsninger og dens fordeler. Som en nøkkelperson mellom teknologien og kundene, vil du også ta del i å sikre at Kobbr kontinuerlig utvikles for å være tilpasset kundenes behov og ønsker.

Rollen har konkurransedyktig lønn med gode provisjonsordning!

Om deg

Det aller viktigste for oss er at du er en god relasjonsbygger og har et driv for å jobbe med salg og kunder. Arbeidsdagen vil til tider være hektisk i en voksende startup, så du må trives med mye ansvar og tempo. Og litt kaos. Ellers ser vi etter deg med:

  • Minimum 3 års erfaring innen B2B salg
  • En god relasjonsbygger som kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Du er resultatorientert, initiativrik og ikke redd for å gjøre feil! Vi er et team som prøver og feiler sammen.
  • God teknisk forståelse, opparbeidet via tidligere arbeidserfaring eller utdanning
  • Du har anledning til å jobbe fra vårt kontor i Oslo
  • Det er en bonus om du har erfaring med Hubspot eller tilsvarende CRM-system


Vi tilbyr

  • Et actionfylt arbeidsmiljø der hver dag er unik, med en bratt læringskurve
  • En unik sjanse for å være med å utvikle en startup i en ambisiøs vekstfase
  • En rolle med mye ansvar og innflytelse, hvor din kunnskap og erfaring er verdsatt
  • Et sosialt miljø med kontorplass på Startuplab, Norges fremste oppstartsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn med gode provisjonsordninger


Slik søker du

Vi ønsker gjerne noen som kan starte så raskt som mulig. For rett kandidat er vi naturligvis fleksible med tanke på oppstartstid.

Vi ønsker en mangfoldig kandidatgruppe og en åpen søknadsprosess. Send oss en CV, en oppdatert LinkedIn-profil, eller annen dokumentasjon som viser din erfaring og kompetanse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kobbr is on a mission to lead craftsmen, such as electricians, painters and carpenters, into a data driven future. Craftsmen are used to old and outdated software that requires several training days to master. We are building a product that our customers actually love to use and requires no training to get started. Our approach sets us apart from traditional software companies in the industry. We prioritize integrating seamlessly with existing tools, rather than replacing them. Kobbr simplifies workflows and decreases manual tasks by offering a modern alternative to pen, paper, and Excel. Since our software can be easily integrated with craftsmen’s existing software, it shortens our sales processes significantly and opens the opportunity for product-led growth. Our goal is to develop an inclusive work atmosphere and assemble a varied team, as we encourage individuals from all different backgrounds to submit their applications and join our collective journey.

title: Firmware Developer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an experienced Firmware developer. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!


About the role

As a Firmware Developer, you will join the Platform team, which is responsible for the core of our solution, from the firmware running on our collars, through the backend that our devices communicate with to our data collection and processing pipelines. You will be making sure that our devices keep working well, and that we keep developing our systems into a solid foundation from which we can launch new improvements, features and designs.


The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Firmware design with a focus on efficiency and innovation: We are integrating Zephyr RTOS on ARM-based MCUs to manage a variety of components such as motion sensors, GNSS receivers, LTE modems, and others. Your role will be central to our device's functionality, ensuring robust and innovative firmware development.

  • Striking a practical balance: You'll be tasked with achieving an optimal mix of simplicity, low power consumption, and high performance. This role is about more than just coding; it involves optimizing and introducing new features that enhance the capabilities of our products, making them more efficient and effective.

  • Advancing automated testing: You will play a key role in implementing and overseeing tests in Python within our Continuous Integration (CI) framework. Your efforts will focus on developing automated testing processes that thoroughly assess new features, guaranteeing the reliability and quality of our firmware before it is deployed to customers.

  • Collaborating with our team of engineers: You'll help foster an environment where creativity and practical engineering merge. Your expertise in firmware development will shape our products and promote ongoing teamwork and improvement.

  • Understanding and solving customer needs: Close cooperation with the product team will be essential to grasp user requirements and devise the most effective engineering solutions for the challenges our customers face.

  • Your impact: Joining us means contributing to the advancement of agricultural technology. Your work will help produce devices that are not just efficient and robust but also set a benchmark in engineering quality, contributing significantly to better animal welfare and farming practices.

 

About you

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • A relevant Master's degree, or equivalent. Alternatively, applicants with a Bachelor's degree complemented by significant relevant work experience are also encouraged to apply.

  • 5 years of experience in firmware development.

  • Have knowledge about or are familiar with these technologies: GNSS, LTE, and Bluetooth communication.

  • Have some experience in reading schematics and component data sheets, operating basic instruments like oscilloscopes and logic analysers, and soldering.

  • Solid programming skills, with experience in C, embedded RTOS and Python.

  • Experience in designing and developing robust firmware tests for embedded devices.

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


We are looking for someone who is:

  • A curious learner: As an innovative company we expect you to possess a great curiosity and a commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking to expand your knowledge and skills to drive innovation.

  • A product-oriented developer: You look beyond the tasks at hand and think about product problems, solutions and needs, helping to make sure that we're delivering an excellent and reliable solution for our customers and the animals.

  • A collaborative contributor: You believe in sharing knowledge, supporting your peers, and working together to solve complex problems. We believe this is a crucial part of being a team player.

  • A creative thinker: You challenge the status quo and bring innovative ideas to the table, driving progress and setting new standards of excellence.


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.  


About Us

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Engineering team is currently a team of 23 employees working across our three Norwegian offices. We believe in cooperation, adaptability, and a fun and relaxed working environment! 


What we bring to the table

Nofence is a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth. We think it is important to have fun while working hard, both for it to be worthwhile, and because it improves our output and chance of success.

If you're the right fit, you'll be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast! As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge technology.

Be part of a team that’s always looking forward, where your ideas and creativity are not only welcomed but also essential to our mutual success!


About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? After all, the grass is sometimes greener on the other side. Also, just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer!

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering manager Jakub Pegza at below email.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Glint Solar is an Oslo-based startup accelerating the solar energy revolution. We streamline the process of finding optimal solar project locations using GIS and climate data, making renewable energy development faster and simpler.


Our Team

We are a diverse, fun-loving team with varied interests, from astrophysics to frisbee golf to DJing on the weekend. What unites us is our support for each other, a passion for solving complex problems, and a commitment to driving positive change through technology.


The Role

We seek experienced software engineers that are skilled in their craft and always keeps the big picture in mind. Software engineers are involved early from understanding the problems customers face, prioritization and how to best solve them, together with design and product. We don't have separate front-end, back-end or infrastructure teams, everyone is "full-stack", but it's ok to have a preference. Day to day you will be working with React, Node and Python. We use AWS as our infrastructure provider. Our product is heavily centered around maps, and we use Mapbox as our map provider.

Our product team is on-site in Oslo so for this role we expect you to come in to the office as a rule. That said, we offer flexibility around working remotely when needed.


What we offer

  • A committed team of ambitious and motivated colleagues.

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing startup with global reach.

  • Participation in our option scheme.

  • Lots of laughter.


Location: Oslo, Norway  For more information about working at Glint Solar, you can have a look at our website: https://www.glintsolar.com/careers

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glint Solar is accelerating the adoption of solar energy by building the world's leading solar screening and analysis software. One of the main headaches for the development of large scale solar is identifying where to build and understanding the specific site conditions - we're tackling this! The world needs to build more renewable energy to combat climate change. We in Glint Solar believe that technology is the solution. We are therefore working effortlessly on building technology for developers of solar energy parks. We started with the very exciting floating solar market as this is one of the fastest growing energy sectors in the world and have since expanded into land based solar as well. We're backed by leading Norwegian and international VCs and private equity. Our HQ is at Mesh Nationaltheatret in Oslo where our international team works from, but we serve our global customer base with a focus on Europe. Some of our interesting customers include TotalEnergies, Alight and Statkraft. We have the culture of a startup with a flat hierarchy, where the idea matters, not who had it. We encourage trying new things, even if it fails. At Glint Solar you will have the freedom to do your best work – and focus your efforts on what *you* are good at. We believe in adapting to our people and their strengths – not the other way around. We back each other up, make sure obstacles are out of the way, and then we GO! And sometimes, quite often, actually, we go do something fun together, like cabin trips, company trips and social events. All with lots of laughter. We consider ourselves very privileged to have smart, curious, and caring colleagues who are working together towards our mission. We are comprised of 23 different people with nine different nationalities and a wide range of diversity of thought. Amongst us you’ll find coffee connoisseurs, map nerds, Mandarin speakers, yoga enthusiasts, foodies, cross-country skiiers, olive farmers, frisbee golfers, colleagues who DJ on the weekend and everything in between – because we value exactly who YOU are. Regardless of what you enjoy and value outside of work, there’s a place for you in Glint Solar.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Full-Time UX/UI Designer Opportunity

Remote · Global Team · Start: Beginning-Mid of October

Klingit is looking for a Mid–Senior UX/UI Designer to join our global creative team full-time. This role goes beyond designing interfaces, you will shape digital experiences that deliver measurable impact. If you thrive on creating user-centered, conversion-focused products while leveraging design systems, research, and AI-powered workflows, we want to hear from you.


About Klingit

We are building the most efficient marketing team in the world. We work with ambitious brands and use smart workflows, talented people, and the latest tools to deliver better and faster creative solutions. This is your opportunity to be part of a company reshaping how brand and marketing services are delivered.


Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy & Design Excellence

  • Design responsive, user-centered interfaces following UX/UI best practices and accessibility standards.

  • Build wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that communicate user flows and interactions.

  • Create and maintain design systems, component libraries, and style guides.

  • Conduct user research and apply insights to improve digital experiences.

  • Translate business objectives into compelling visual solutions.

Design Systems & Component Management

  • Build scalable design systems used across multiple projects.

  • Create reusable Figma libraries to streamline developer handoffs.

  • Document design specifications, patterns, and interaction guidelines.

  • Ensure consistency and brand alignment across all digital touchpoints.

Collaboration & Project Delivery

  • Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of design intent.

  • Participate in design reviews, client presentations, and feedback sessions.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  • Provide accurate time estimates and identify design challenges early in the process.

  • Maintain organised project documentation to enable smooth collaboration.

AI-Enhanced Design Workflow

  • Use AI tools to accelerate ideation and iteration.

  • Integrate emerging AI design tools into workflows and share best practices.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio showcasing B2B web design projects.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).

  • Proven experience creating and managing design systems and component libraries.

  • Prior work with high-growth B2B companies or global brands.

  • Strong foundation in UX research, user flows, and information architecture.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and developer collaboration.

  • Strong visual design skills, including typography, colour theory, and layout.

  • Ability to create engaging micro-interactions and motion-enhanced user experiences.


Why Join Klingit

At Klingit, we believe that creative excellence combined with smart workflows delivers real results. If you want to collaborate with an international team and see your work directly impact ambitious brands, this is the right environment for you.


Recruitment Process

Interested candidates should apply with both a CV and portfolio. The process includes:

  1. Initial screening call

  2. Two interviews (experience/cultural fit and technical skills)

  3. Short technical test

  4. Reference check


We move quickly, so please submit your application today.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The All-in-One Solution for Brand and Marketing Needs Unlike traditional agencies, we have built our offering as a plug-and-play solution for all brand and marketing needs. We promise fast turnarounds, transparent prices without surprises, and top-talent creatives that will boost your brand. Klingit acquired Norwegian startup Graphiq in july 2024 and all services are merged under the Klingit name.

title: Junior Activation Manager
description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkaster og lydbøker og vi ser nå etter en Junior Activation Manager til vårt voksende norske team.

Bli med oss på reisen for å berike liv gjennom lytting.


Dette er rollen 

Som vår nye Junior Activation Manager vil du støtte planleggingen og gjennomføringen av show-aktiveringer, og jobbe tett med våre Activation Managers og det bredere kommersielle teamet.

Rollen består av å utvikle ferdighetene dine innen creator-onboarding, kampanjekoordinering og markedsføring av innhold. Du vil hjelpe med logistikk, følge opp resultater og sikre at ingen detaljer blir oversett under gjennomføringen.


Dette vil du gjøre

Kampanjestøtte og koordinering av materiell

  • Bistå med oppsett og koordinering av show-lanseringer og reaktiveringer.

  • Administrere tidslinjer og sikre at assets som cover-art, creator-bios og opptaksplaner leveres i tide.

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre show-lanseringer og synlighet i appen.

  • Ha ansvar for lokale oversettelser for egne og betalte kanaler.

  • Utarbeide interne briefinger og følge opp gjennomføringssteg gjennom hele kampanjeløpet.

  • Bistå med oppdateringer og leveranser til PR byrå

Kontaktpunkt for creators og talenter

  • Hjelpe til med onboarding av creators ved å gi sjekklister, promo-templater og svar på grunnleggende spørsmål rundt lansering.

  • Følge opp creator-leveranser og sikre at forventningene blir innfridd.

  • Vedlikeholde creator-mapper, kontrakter og annen dokumentasjon.

Samarbeid på tvers av interne team

  • Koordinere med SoMe-teamet for å levere creator- og kampanjemateriell.

  • Jobbe sammen med PR- og SR-teamene for å følge opp felles avhengigheter og leveranser.

  • Støtte Activation Managers med å forberede presentasjoner og kampanjesammendrag.

Data & Reporting Assistance

  • Følge opp kampanje-KPIer, inkludert engasjement og aktivitetsmålinger for creatorer.

  • Oppdatere ukentlige rapporter og dashboards i samarbeid med Activation Managers.

  • Identifisere tidlige trendsignaler i performance og dele dem med teamet.


Dette er deg

  • Prosjekt- og kampanjekoordinering – evne til å håndtere tidslinjer, følge opp kampanjesteg og støtte gjennomføringen av aktiveringsplaner.

  • Kommunikasjon med creators og interessenter – klare og organiserte kommunikasjonsevner for å bistå i onboarding av creators og koordinering på tvers av interne team.

  • Materiellhåndtering – ferdigheter i å organisere, velge og følge opp innholdsmateriell, spesielt for bruk i betalte kanaler.

  • Flytende norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Naturligvis er det en stor fordel å være engasjert og kunnskapsrik innen podkast, lydinnhold, media og underholdning!


Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad! Ikke nøl med å søke, da vi vurderer søknader og starter intervjuer fortløpende for å holde fremdriften før jul.


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via We.Care

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap – og se effekten av arbeidet ditt med én gang


Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen. Vi har null tid til “brilliant jerks”.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er – uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Founded in Copenhagen in 2019, Podimo is a platform for podcast and audiobook lovers as well as audio content creators. Our app puts a world of podcasts and audiobooks at your fingertips. We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings, and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for brilliant jerks. We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories. We support our creators deeply and have massive respect for their process as we help them bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it. We seek to build a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means; diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams. You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

title: Head of Commercial
description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkaster og lydbøker, og vi ser nå etter en Head of Commercial til vårt voksende team i Norge.


Dette er rollen

Vi ser etter en Head of Commercial som skal drive kommersiell suksess og publikumsvekst for Podimos norske innholdsportefølje – sammen med ditt kommersielle team. Dette er en sentral lederrolle i skjæringspunktet mellom markedsføring, innhold, partnerskap og forretningsresultater. Du sørger for at de riktige podkastene når riktig publikum til riktig tid, og at alle go-to-market-initiativer gir maksimal effekt på vekst, engasjement og lojalitet.

Du vil lede vårt fantastiske kommersielle team på 4 personer (og voksende!). Sammen jobber dere tett med det lokale Content-teamet og våre globale Brand- og Growth-team for å sette retning, gjennomføre og finne nye muligheter som styrker Podimos lokale relevans, rekkevidde og abonnementsvekst.

Rollen er basert på vårt nye kontor i Oslo, og noe reiseaktivitet må påregnes.


Dette vil du gjøre

  • Lede det lokale commercial/activation-teamet og samarbeide tett med Content, Creator Relations, Product og Market Director for å maksimere verdien av den norske innholdsporteføljen.

  • Eie den lokale go-to-market-planen for nye lanseringer og viktige show-øyeblikk, og gjøre innholdsprioriteringer om til kampanjeplaner som driver vekst, engasjement og lojalitet.

  • Kjøre integrerte kampanjer på tvers av CRM, SoMe, PR og Brand – slik at riktige budskap treffer riktig målgruppe til riktig tid.

  • Samarbeide med globale Growth-team (Paid & Demand Gen) for å sikre god samkjøring for vekst, og bidra med lokale innsikter som forbedrer performance.

  • Prognostisere og følge opp kommersiell effekt: bygge prognoser og vekstscenarier, definere KPI’er, rapportere resultater og initiere raskt basert på hva som fungerer.

  • Data og innsikt: bruke data som beslutningsgrunnlag og oversette data til handling

  • Identifisere og realisere nye vekstmuligheter gjennom partnerskap, distribusjonsavtaler og mediesamarbeid som styrker Podimos posisjon i Norge.

Dette er deg

  • Du har en bachelorgrad innen markedsføring, business eller et relevant fagområde, og 3–5 års relevant erfaring fra kommersielle markedsføringsroller – gjerne fra mediebransjen.

  • Du er strategisk og kommersielt drevet, og evner å koble innholdsaktivering til forretningsvekst.

  • Du har et solid fundament i performance marketing, og god forståelse for SoMe- og audience development-mekanismer.

  • Du er analytisk og datadrevet, med tydelig gjennomføringskraft og evne til å lære raskt.

  • Du har dokumentert erfaring med ledelse og teamutvikling.

  • Du har erfaring med å identifisere og drive nye kommersielle muligheter (f.eks. partnerskap, distribusjonsavtaler, mediesamarbeid og innovative vekstinitiativer).

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, og har sterke kommunikasjons- og stakeholder management-ferdigheter.


Naturligvis er det et stort pluss om du er engasjert i og kunnskapsrik på podkaster, lydinnhold, media og underholdning!

Vi gleder oss til å motta søknaden din! Ikke nøl med å søke – vi vurderer søknader og gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende for å holde tempoet oppe før jul.


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via We.Care

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap – og se effekten av arbeidet ditt med én gang


Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen. Vi har null tid til “brilliant jerks”.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

title: Tech Lead – Shape the Future of Urban Life with Data & Code
description:
Want to build cities with code? 🏙️

Imagine you're the one shaping the future of urban life, not with blueprints and steel, but with data and code. At Plaace, that's exactly what you do. As our Tech Lead, you'll be a master builder of our platform, laying the foundations for growth, designing the blueprints for new features, and making sure all the different districts of our tech stack connect and thrive.

This isn't a role for someone who prefers to follow an old map. This is for you who want to be actively shaping the architecture of a platform that’s already transforming how our cities evolve.


About Us

Plaace is a fast-growing Norwegian tech scale-up on a mission to create vibrant streets and cities that people truly love. Our platform combines state-of-the-art analytics with newly available data sources to power smarter, data-driven decisions for everyone who wants to understand and shape the physical world. We have established valuable strategic partnerships with key data providers, including Telia and BankAxept. These collaborations ensure we have access to the comprehensive data required to develop our insights. We’re already trusted by leading retailers, restaurants, gyms, and service providers, including Elkjøp, Eplehuset, and SATS, as well as the public sector and major property owners. Together, we’re transforming how locations are chosen and how our cities evolve.


The Opportunity

As our Tech Lead, you will join us at a pivotal stage where the foundations are already laid. We have spent the last five years building a robust platform and have already secured over 100 customers in the Nordics. You won’t be starting from scratch; instead, you'll be joining an exciting scaling phase with a unique opportunity to play a central role in building out our new tech team and shaping the future direction of the entire development department. You will be a key part of a company that is challenging major market players by offering more user-friendly and effective solutions.

You'll serve as the hands-on Tech Lead, primarily dedicated to the PLG (Product-Led Growth) team. Your core focus will be on coding and guiding the team while owning the technical vision and ensuring architectural and development alignment across the teams. You will report to the CTO (Peder) on technical matters and collaborate closely with the COO (Tobias) on product strategy.


🏗️ What you will be doing

You'll be hands-on, contributing directly to our codebase across the stack. You'll also take the lead in driving good practices for testing, CI/CD, and ensuring a clean, maintainable codebase that serves as a solid foundation for our product.

  • Oversee the architectural design, working with the team to ensure our systems are scalable, secure, and well-structured.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with designers, product managers, and commercial colleagues to create a product that balances customer needs with business goals.

  • Shape the future by making our platform AI-friendly and ready for Product-Led Growth (PLG).


👤 Who we're looking for

We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on coding, focusing on writing clean code, and is ready to take on the responsibility of shaping a city. You know how to connect the Frontend and Backend, and you have architectural experience with system design, API design, and scaling infrastructure.

  • You're hungry to deliver, pragmatic in trade-offs, and motivated to build great products.

  • You are based in Oslo, with a hands-on and empowering leadership style.

  • You have experience mentoring or leading engineers.

  • You are a collaborative person who can bring out the best in others.

  • You take ownership and enjoy solving problems end-to-end.

  • You are pragmatic and solution-oriented, balancing short-term and long-term needs.


We know great candidates don’t all follow the same path. If you believe you can create impact in this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if your profile doesn’t match every single point.


🧰 Your toolkit for building the city

We build modern solutions with technology that allows us to move quickly and securely. We don't expect you to know our entire stack beforehand. The most important thing is that you have a good technical foundation, are familiar with common frameworks and languages, and, of course, are eager to learn new and modern technology.

  • Frontend: Typescript with Next.js

  • Backend: Typescript with Node.js, GraphQL

  • Databases: PostgreSQL

  • Infrastructure: AWS

  • Bonus Tools: Python, GCP, BigQuery


We are in the process of modernizing our tech stack to ensure a more scalable, robust, and efficient platform. We are now laying the foundation to deliver better and faster solutions, and you can help shape it.


🚀 What we offer you:

  • A central role in a growing, VC-backed startup.

  • The opportunity to shape the technical direction and culture of our engineering team.

  • A friendly, ambitious, and collaborative team with high motivation and good code quality.

  • The chance to see your work have a direct, real-world impact on urban development.

  • Competitive benefits, including 5 weeks of vacation, good insurance, and equipment of your choice.


Ready to be a master builder?

Join us on our journey to build a platform that truly transforms cities! Apply now and become a valued part of our engaged, innovative team at Plaace.

For questions, please contact Anna Viken via below email or phone.

We look forward to hearing from you!


Plaace is the controller of your personal data for the purposes of this recruitment. Amby AS acts as the processor of your personal data, except when you agree to join our Talent Pool, in which case Amby also becomes the data controller. We process your personal data to manage and conduct the recruitment process. You have the right to access your data, request rectification, erasure, and restriction of processing, as well as the right to object to processing and data transfer. For a more detailed understanding of how we handle your data, the purposes of processing, and your rights, please refer to the Amby Privacy Policy and Plaace's Privacy Policy.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

🚀 Plaace (/pleɪs/) is a rapidly growing Norwegian tech startup on a mission to create vibrant streets and cities that people truly love. We do so with a platform fuelled by state-of-the-art analytics and newly available data sources to enable smarter decisions for every actor involved in the city floor. Our data-driven platform provides valuable insights and recommendations based on card transactions, footfall, demographics, and competition to empower businesses and organisations to make informed decisions. We work with some of the largest property companies, retailers and brokers including OBOS, Eiendomsspar, Alti Forvaltning, Stor-Oslo Eiendom, Norgesgruppen, CBRE, Princess, Fretex, etc. We’re at a stage where we focus on growing the customer list and harvesting the market potential both nationally and internationally. At Plaace you’ll join a high-paced environment in a rapidly growing startup. We work from a a kick-ass office environment at coworking space StartupLab, surrounded by other cool startups, and a convenient easy (5 mins) train access from the city center of Oslo. We work in a fun and inspiring culture where you’ll get a ton of responsibility and freedom to contribute with your talent and experience. We benefit from high flexibility, where everyone is free to work from home a couple of times/week, but not fully remote, as we reap the high benefits of bringing our bright and diverse minds together. You will join a team of smart, talented and committed colleagues from a variety of backgrounds, both culturally and academically. Because we are a small team and work closely together, we also enjoy a lots of social activities, Friday beers, social dinners and company trips. If this sounds like the right place for you, then we would love to hear from you. Check out our job openings below!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
The world needs to increase the amount of renewable energy to battle climate change. Glint Solar is an Oslo-based startup accelerating the growth of solar energy by making it fast and simple to find the best solar project locations. Glint Solar was founded in 2020 with the mission of accelerating the adoption of solar energy across the globe. Today we are counting 50 employees, an increasing number of customers from all over the world, and we have exciting times ahead. We are scaling and we need a data-driven problem solver to keep our commercial operations running at full speed.

We are now seeking a Customer Success Manager who turns everyday interactions into “wow” moments that keep customers coming back.


Role Overview

We’re looking for an energizing, empathic Customer Success Manager who loves turning customers into champions. You thrive on solving problems, building strong relationships, and making sure customers get real value from Glint Solar’s platform. You’ll be a key part of our commercial team, working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to deliver an experience customers genuinely love.


What you’ll do

  • Guide customers from smooth onboarding to long-term success through close engagement and clear communication.

  • Monitor account health, act early on risks, and confidently drive renewals.

  • Proactively identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities to support our growth

  • Be the customer’s voice internally, sharing insights that shape product improvements and priorities.

  • Keep customer data and activity updated in HubSpot and track key usage and satisfaction metrics.

  • Support content creation and process improvements that help Customer Success scale.


This is what we can offer

We are a fun-loving team of people from different backgrounds, with different likes and personalities. Between us you will find people who: love cross-country skiing, enjoy cooking new dishes, play frisbee golf, and DJ on the weekend. So what do we have in common? We support each other, love solving customer problems, and want to drive positive change in the world. In addition to a great team we can also offer you:

  • Chance to join early in a young, fast-growing startup with a global reach

  • Competitive salary plus an option scheme to share in our future success

  • Flexible work-life balance, including support for remote work weeks

  • A fun, collaborative team culture with plenty of laughter and team events

  • Steep learning curve with opportunities to take on increasing responsibilities as the company grows


Excited to join us? We’re just as excited to have you on board! We’ll be reviewing applications as they come in, so there’s no need to wait until the last day. The final deadline to apply is January 5th.

Please contact Karin at below email if you have any questions.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glint Solar is accelerating the adoption of solar energy by building the world's leading solar screening and analysis software. One of the main headaches for the development of large scale solar is identifying where to build and understanding the specific site conditions - we're tackling this! The world needs to build more renewable energy to combat climate change. We in Glint Solar believe that technology is the solution. We are therefore working effortlessly on building technology for developers of solar energy parks. We started with the very exciting floating solar market as this is one of the fastest growing energy sectors in the world and have since expanded into land based solar as well. We're backed by leading Norwegian and international VCs and private equity. Our HQ is at Mesh Nationaltheatret in Oslo where our international team works from, but we serve our global customer base with a focus on Europe. Some of our interesting customers include TotalEnergies, Alight and Statkraft. We have the culture of a startup with a flat hierarchy, where the idea matters, not who had it. We encourage trying new things, even if it fails. At Glint Solar you will have the freedom to do your best work – and focus your efforts on what *you* are good at. We believe in adapting to our people and their strengths – not the other way around. We back each other up, make sure obstacles are out of the way, and then we GO! And sometimes, quite often, actually, we go do something fun together, like cabin trips, company trips and social events. All with lots of laughter. We consider ourselves very privileged to have smart, curious, and caring colleagues who are working together towards our mission. We are comprised of 23 different people with nine different nationalities and a wide range of diversity of thought. Amongst us you’ll find coffee connoisseurs, map nerds, Mandarin speakers, yoga enthusiasts, foodies, cross-country skiiers, olive farmers, frisbee golfers, colleagues who DJ on the weekend and everything in between – because we value exactly who YOU are. Regardless of what you enjoy and value outside of work, there’s a place for you in Glint Solar.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up which has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management we need more top-notch competence in our Product team, and we are now looking for a Senior User Experience Designer. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!

Dive into the heart of agricultural innovation with Nofence! We are looking for a designer who brings strong interaction and interface skills and enjoys working across teams. In this role you will responsible for evolving defined parts of the Nofence app experience and work closely with other product lead application teams to ensure a coherent end-to-end journey. You will bridge user needs and business objectives, using rapid iteration and user feedback to guide decisions. This role is senior which means working closely as a UX lead, Product mangers and a Engineering leads, contributing to decisions and help shaping the direction of crucial parts of the application.  Nofence is where passion meets the field, are you ready to bring your energy to our dynamic team?


About the role

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • App UX feature operation: Contribute to the user experience for defined features in our main app. Work closely with UX lead, Product Manager and engineers to set the vision, outcomes, and roadmap for this area, and ensure it fits well with the rest of the app.

  • Cross-Application collaboration: Work with other Application teams to align patterns, coordinate releases, and remove seams between journeys. Share insights, resolve dependencies, and contribute to a consistent experience across the app.

  • Interaction design: Create engaging, intuitive interfaces and flows. Move from low-fidelity sketches to high-fidelity prototypes and ready-to-build specifications.

  • Collaborative problem solving: Work closely with UX designers, researchers, product managers, and developers to tackle complex design challenges and deliver feasible solutions that meet user needs.

  • User-centered design: Plan and run discovery, concept tests, and usability evaluations. Use findings to inform prioritisation, iteration, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design system stewardship: Contribute components and patterns to our design system and help Application teams adopt and evolve them.

  • Stakeholder engagement: Communicate decisions, trade-offs, and user insights with clarity. Ensure shared understanding and buy-in for your domain's direction.

  • Service design mindset: Bring a service design way of thinking to all products and services we touch, considering the full end-to-end journey, support, and operations.


About you

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • Relevant degree/diploma/certificate in Design, HCI, or equivalent.

  • Proven experience in interaction design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work on digital products.

  • Exceptional design skills with a deep understanding of user-centred design principles and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in design and prototyping tools such as Figma is a must.

  • Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to partake in workshops and design sprints that drive collaboration and innovation.

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in design, with a track record of successfully delivered projects.

  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


We are looking for someone who is:

  • A friendly and approachable person that meshes well with a collaborative team environment.

  • Strong in communication, with a knack for presenting complex design concepts in a clear, compelling manner.

  • Passionate and empathetic: We appreciate pixel perfect, but passionate problem solvers who are focused on the solution at any cost is the best fit.

  • Comfortable with rough work that is refined through later iterations over time.

  • A curious learner: As an innovative company we expect you to possess a great curiosity and a commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking to expand your knowledge and skills to drive innovation.

  • Adaptable: As a quick growing and constantly evolving scale-up we need people with the ability to adapt to ever-changing landscapes. We want you to embrace flexibility and thrive in dynamic environments. In Nofence we view challenges as opportunities for growth.


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilised.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About Us

As a company still scaling up, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Product team is currently a team of 15 employees working with Product development, UX Design and Global Customer Support. We're excited to add a Senior User Experience Designer to our team who's not only skilled in interaction design but also embodies the collaborative and friendly spirit of Nofence. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment! 


What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we are not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We are a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you will be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an UX Designer in our team, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech! We will evaluate candidates continuously.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

title: Market Director, Content (Norway)
description:
We are one of the fastest-growing podcast and audiobook platforms in Europe, and we are now looking for a Market Director, Content, to join our growing team in Norway.

Join us on our journey to enrich lives through listening.


This is the role

As the Market Director, Content for Norway, you define and execute an integrated content and platform strategy in close partnership with Podimo Studios, Labels and global Platform teams, with clear ownership of the content and platform KPIs that underpin growth, engagement and monetisation.

You’ll get full ownership of content investment decisions, budget discipline, forecasting accuracy and the definition, tracking and optimisation of KPIs, balancing bold creative bets with rigorous performance management and transparent reporting against market and global targets. A critical part of the role is to embed global processes, KPI frameworks and operating models in-market, championing new ways of working, and ensuring clarity of ownership, accountability, and decision-making across teams.

The role is based in our new Oslo offices. Some travel activity to our HQ in Copenhagen and our offices in our other markets is to be expected. 


What you'll do:

  • Market Leadership & Strategy: Develop and execute the market’s content and Platform strategy, serving as the market’s editorial figurehead to ensure content drives audience growth and strengthens the brand.

  • Commissioning & Portfolio Ownership: Working closely with the Head of Content to lead the commissioning and acquisition of original and exclusive podcasts. Together, you’ll lead the Greenlight process for new content, ensuring every title and the overall slate deliver against ambitious service-level and title-specific goals.

  • Commercial & Deal Execution: Own content investment decisions, budget discipline, and forecasting accuracy. Work closely with Legal and Business Affairs to secure commercially astute deals with creators and partners that align with our strategic and financial goals.

  • Creator & Industry Relationships: Build and maintain high-level relationships with top creators, production companies, and talent representatives, representing Podimo in key industry forums.

  • Audience & Performance Insight: Leverage audience insights, performance metrics, and competitive intelligence to guide content planning and programming, ensuring long-term content impact.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Provide senior leadership to the market content team, fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, and high performance. Champion cross-functional collaboration across local and global teams.

  • Stakeholder Management: Own transparent reporting and present strategic impact and performance updates to the Chief Content Officer and Lead Team.


This is you

  • 6+ years of progressive, leadership experience within the audio, podcast, and/or broader premium media/content industry (e.g., streaming services, television, publishing, digital media).

  • Proven track record of leading, supporting, and developing high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability and seamless cross-functional collaboration.

  • Exceptional ability to balance high-level strategic editorial and commercial judgment. Proven expertise in budget ownership, investment planning, and complex deal negotiation for content acquisition.

  • Solid data-led approach to content programming and optimization, leveraging performance metrics and audience insights to drive growth, engagement, and monetization KPIs.

  • Strong executive stakeholder collaboration skills, with the proven ability to operate effectively within a global, matrixed organization, driving alignment between local market needs and global strategic priorities.

  • Deep understanding of the Norwegian media market dynamics, creator landscape, and consumer behavior. Fluency in Norwegian and English is essential.


Naturally, being passionate and knowledgeable about podcasts, audio content, media, and entertainment is a big plus! 


These are the benefits

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for all employees. 

  • Free online therapy sessions through We.Care.

  • Delicious lunch with great colleagues.

  • Learning and personal development opportunities to help you thrive and enrich your skills in a fast-paced creator economy.

  • Opportunity to work flexible hours and remotely.

  • The chance to make an impact at a growing international company and see your work pay off immediately.


This is us

Founded in Copenhagen in 2019, Podimo is a platform for podcast and audiobook lovers as well as audio content creators. Our app puts a world of podcasts and audiobooks at your fingertips. Our revenue-sharing model rewards creators for making content that people want to hear – whether they have an established following or a niche audience.

We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for brilliant jerks.

We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories. We support our creators deeply and have massive respect for their process as we help them bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it.

We seek to build a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means; diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams.

You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.
