title: Join our Account Executive teams!
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Glassmontør søkes til Glassmester1
description:
Glassmontør søkes til Glassmester1

Vil du jobbe med varierte glassprosjekter i et solid og faglig sterkt miljø?

Glassmester1 har økende aktivitet og søker nå en dyktig glassmontør som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag med både små og større oppdrag.

Glassmester1 er et av Norges ledende selskaper innen glassfaget. Hos oss blir du en del av et godt fagmiljø der kvalitet, selvstendighet og gode løsninger står sentralt.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Montering og utskifting av glass, isolerruter, speil, dusjløsninger, glassrekkverk, glassvegger og dører
  • Montering av enklere aluminiums- og fasadeløsninger hos privat- og bedriftskunder
  • Oppmåling og vurdering av gode og praktiske montasjeløsninger
  • Dokumentasjon av utført arbeid gjennom bilder, avvik og rapportering
  • Bruk av digitale systemer for HMS, timeregistrering, dokumentasjon, FDV og prosjektoppfølging
  • Praktiske oppgaver knyttet til daglig drift, utstyr, servicebil, lager og verksted
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser gjerne at du har fagbrev innen glassfaget eller annen relevant håndverksbakgrunn. Relevant og dokumenterbar erfaring kan kompensere for manglende fagbrev.

Du har gjerne erfaring fra glassfaget, byggebransjen, fasadearbeid, vindu- og dørmontasje eller tilsvarende praktisk håndverksarbeid.

I tillegg ønsker vi at du:

  • Har førerkort klasse B
  • Behersker norsk/skandinavisk eller engelsk
  • Kan arbeide selvstendig og ta ansvar for egne oppdrag
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst og liker å finne gode løsninger ute på oppdrag. Du tar ansvar for jobben du gjør og møter både kunder og kollegaer på en profesjonell og positiv måte.

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er:

  • Pålitelig og løsningsorientert
  • Strukturert og opptatt av kvalitet
  • Faglig engasjert og interessert i håndverket
  • Serviceinnstilt og samarbeider godt med kollegaer, kunder og prosjektledere
Vi tilbyr
  • En trygg arbeidsplass i et solid og faglig sterkt glassmesterfirma
  • En variert arbeidshverdag med spennende prosjekter
  • Gode kollegaer og et uformelt arbeidsmiljø
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Moderne verktøy, digitale systemer og servicebiler


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glassmester1 inngår i konsernet Carlot AS. Selskapet er et av Norges ledende firma innenfor glassbransjen. Konsernet har i dag ca. 300 ansatte,

title: Head of Software Engineering
description:
About Monil

Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we've grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars deployed across multiple markets, and we are now entering a new phase of international growth with rapid expansion into the US.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication, but the value our customers experience lives in the software: the cloud platform, the data pipelines that turn raw device telemetry into insight, and the apps farmers use every day to control and understand their herds in real time.

We're looking for a Head of Software Engineering to own and scale that software, and to build the team and technical foundations that will carry us through international expansion.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with full ownership of our software engineering function across frontend, backend, and data. You will set technical direction, build and grow the team, and be accountable for the quality, reliability, and velocity of everything we ship above the device layer. The role is part of Monil’s management team and will be crucial to guide the company in a rapid growth phase.

You will collaborate closely with our product and hardware teams. Your effectiveness will depend as much on strong, trust-based collaboration with those teams as on your technical leadership. Product owns the what and the why; Hardware owns the device. You own the how and the when for all software and data products, and you are the connective tissue that turns device capability and product intent into reliable, shipped systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of Monil's software platform across frontend, backend, and data.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organisation: hiring, mentoring, structuring teams, and setting the technical and cultural bar.

  • Define and drive software engineering standards, and technical best practices across the platform, including CI/CD, testing, observability, and on-call/reliability practices.

  • Build the data foundation that turns high-volume telemetry into reliable, queryable, and actionable data. Ensure that all models are productionised, platform-integrated, and maintained to the same high standards as the rest of the systems.

  • Partner closely with Product to translate roadmaps into deliverable, well-sequenced engineering plans, and to make pragmatic trade-offs on scope, timing, and technical investment.

  • Partner closely with R&D on the device-to-cloud boundary, telemetry contracts, device management, and OTA: ensuring software and firmware evolve coherently.

  • Own delivery: balance feature velocity against the architectural and operational work needed to scale internationally and reliably.

  • Be accountable for software quality, security, and the production reliability of customer-facing systems.

We believe you have

  • Significant experience leading software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale.

  • Strong technical depth across at least one of frontend, backend, or data engineering, and the breadth and credibility to lead all three.

  • Experience with modern backend and cloud architectures, distributed systems, and the data infrastructure behind high-volume telemetry or IoT-style workloads.

  • A solid grasp of modern engineering practices; CI/CD, automated testing, observability.

  • Experience working alongside product and hardware functions, and a genuine ability to drive outcomes through influence and collaboration rather than authority alone.

  • Strong people leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining engineers, and building team structures that scale.

Experience with any of the following is a plus: connected/IoT systems and device-to-cloud data flows; edge or on-device ML; low-power or connectivity-constrained system design; OTA and device management at scale.

We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments.

  • Comfortable owning outcomes end to end and driving them from idea to production.

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering and organisational challenges.

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and who builds trust with peer leaders in Product and Hardware.

  • Able to hold a high quality and reliability bar while keeping the team moving fast in an engaging way.

We offer

  • Full ownership of a software function during a period of rapid international growth.

  • Challenging engineering problems spanning connected devices, large-scale data, and customer-facing applications.

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities.

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Some travel might be required.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

title: Internship Data Engineer
description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer Intern at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior Data Engineer, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets, ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in collaboration with diverse teams.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow within a dynamic startup environment.
What We Offer:
  • Mentorship and growth opportunities working directly with our Senior Data Engineer and exposure to industry leaders like Simula.
  • Work on cutting-edge projects in the EV charging infrastructure and green energy space.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class partners like the European Space Agency and EIT Urban Mobility.
  • A vibrant, innovative startup environment with flexible working hours at our office in StartupLab in Oslo.
  • Be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to bold innovation, sustainability, and creating positive environmental impact.
Preferred Location:

We prefer candidates based in Oslo, but we are open to remote positions for the right candidate.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

title: Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee?
description:
Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee? Help us design and build the future of roasting technology.

ROEST is revolutionizing the coffee industry with advanced roasting technology designed and built in Norway. Our team of passionate coffee experts, engineers, and designers work together to create innovative solutions that empower roasters worldwide. We're driven by a commitment to quality, consistency, and sustainability, helping coffee professionals achieve perfect roasts every time. Join us on our mission to make (even) better coffee!

The Opportunity

Are you a visionary Senior Product Development Engineer eager to lead transformative projects and shape the future of coffee technology? At ROEST we are redefining the art and science of roasting with advanced Norwegian-engineered technology. We offer an opportunity to lead significant product initiatives and thrive within a collaborative, innovative culture that values your expertise.

Your Impact at ROEST

As a Product Development Engineer at ROEST, you won't just be designing parts; you'll be shaping the experience for thousands of coffee professionals worldwide. You will be a vital part of a dedicated team where your ideas have a direct and immediate impact on the final product. We're looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every stage of development. Here's what you can expect to be working on:

  • Design, develop, and test a game-changing new electrical coffee roaster. Project start Q3 2026.

  • Create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using Solidworks (or other tools) for prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Collaborate directly with the production team to implement and refine DFM/A principles.

  • Build and validate physical prototypes to rigorously test new concepts and technologies.

  • Participate in the full product lifecycle, from initial ideation and sketching to mass production and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leading the design, development, and validation of new hardware products.

  • Optimizing existing product lines for performance, cost, and reliability.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (production, customer support, R&D).

  • Researching and integrating new technologies and engineering solutions.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Master's degree in product development or 7+ years of industrial experience

  • Proven experience leading products from concept to launch.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering problems.

  • Proven experience in product development, from concept to production.

  • High proficiency in 3D CAD software

  • Strong understanding of DFM/A (Design for Manufacturing/Assembly) principles.

  • Experience applying project management methodologies in a development context.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Computational fluid dynamics to solve complex tasks.

  • Experience with thermal management simulation and design.

  • Prior experience in the coffee industry or with food processing equipment.

  • Leadership experience or mentorship of junior engineers.

  • Understanding of electrical engineering principles for product integration.

  • A genuine passion for coffee and the technology that perfects it.

  • Highly motivated and comfortable working both independently and in a team.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work with cross-functional teams.

  • An innovative mindset, always curious and looking for better solutions.

Work Arrangement & Location

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Oslo, Norway.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. ROEST Sample Roaster has received several industry awards and even helped coffee enthusiasts to succeed in the World Coffee Championships. In 2023 we will launch a new production roaster for small to medium-sized roasteries. Since 2018 we have sold over 1000 roasters to more than 80 countries around the world. What started as a master thesis has turned into a fast-growing, open-minded company with an international team dedicated to improving coffee. ROEST AS became the national gaselle winner for 2022. https://www.dn.no/gaselle Our product can be viewed here: https://youtu.be/VDi4KYr3pYw Our story can be viewed here: https://youtu.be/xMdB0wTXoR8

title: Production Technician
description:
Production Technician at ROEST – Bring Innovation to the Heart of Coffee!

Are you passionate about technical products, great design, and precision work? Then we may have the perfect job for you!

ROEST søker en produksjonstekniker til vårt team i Oslo, som skal montere, teste og forbedre verdensledende kaffebrennere med avansert teknologi, presisjon og design.

At ROEST, we design and produce some of the world’s most innovative coffee roasters, combining advanced technology with sleek design. Our products are renowned for precision, quality, and sustainability. With customers in over 80 countries, we’re proud to set new standards in the coffee industry.


What We Offer:
  • An exciting and varied workday with tasks including assembly, testing, service, and continuous improvement of our award-winning technology.
  • The opportunity to help launch our next-generation electric roaster .
  • A key role in producing a product that impacts the global coffee industry.
  • A collaborative work environment where we support each other to ensure top quality and efficient processes.

Your Responsibilities:

As a Production Technician/Assembler at ROEST, your tasks will include:

  • Assembling and inspecting advanced mechanical, electrical, and electronic components.
  • Performing quality control and testing of finished products.
  • Contributing to the optimization of production processes to enhance efficiency and quality.
  • Troubleshooting and repairing components when needed.

Who Are You?

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Has experience in technical assembly, mechanics, electronics, or a related field.
  • Enjoys precise, systematic work with strong attention to detail.
  • Is eager to contribute to continuous improvement in production processes
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-driven environment.


If you’re passionate about technology, have a knack for hands-on work, and enjoy seeing tangible results from your efforts, this could be the job for you!

Your Benefits:
  • We offer a chance to work in a team-oriented working atmosphere in a fast-growing, profitable scale-up 
  • Competitive salary.
  • Employee stock program.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.
  • Company pension scheme.

Why Work For Us?

At ROEST, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact and join us as we design solutions that revolutionize the coffee industry. We are on an incredible journey to create smart and efficient innovations for our customers and the coffee world.

What began as a master’s thesis has grown into a fast-paced, open-minded company with an international team passionate about improving coffee. Since 2018, we have sold over 2,000 coffee roasters to more than 80 countries worldwide. Along the way, we’ve earned numerous industry awards, including the prestigious Red Dot Award and numerous best new product awards.

We’re now preparing for our next big leap – the launch of the P3000, a cutting-edge production roaster designed to redefine coffee roasting for professional roasteries.

Join us at ROEST and be part of shaping the future of the coffee industry!


Location: ROEST is centrally located at Bryn in Oslo, Norway.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. title: Platform Engineer - Backend
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of app development?

Appfarm is challenging the principles of how great software should be made by delivering a cutting-edge technology for software creation. Our product, Appfarm Create, empowers users to build advanced software tailored to their needs without a single line of code, and only with the help of a web browser.

Now, we’re seeking a Platform Engineer with backend specialization who will play a crucial role in further architecting the backbone of our platform. If you’re passionate about pioneering technology and ready to embark on an exciting journey of innovation, Appfarm could be the place for you!


What can we offer you?

  • A unique opportunity for a vital role in a tech scale-up.
  • A company seeking to create the next big thing in software, and enthusiastic colleagues with the ability to execute.
  • Competitive compensation and stock option plan.
  • A hybrid work setup and flexible working hours.
  • Offices at Rebel – the new center of excellence for tech in Norway, with the best employee restaurant in Oslo.
  • Amazing colleagues and an open and inclusive work environment.
  • Awesome yearly company retreats, cottage trips, and lots of social events.


Your main task and areas of responsibility will be:

  • Develop and maintain our platform and backend services.
  • Design, build and deploy new services in the platform.
  • Ensure optimal performance, scalability, and reliability in our backend solutions.
  • Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies to improve system architecture.


To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • Solid experience and skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Proficiency in system architecture and DevOps practices.
  • Passion for building scalable services with a security-first approach.
  • Previous experience with complex applications and product development will be considered a plus.
  • Strong interest in the tech scale-up environment with a drive to dive into the no-code domain.
  • You live in Norway/Østlandet or are planning to relocate here.
  • You have strong English skills. 


To develop innovative technology, you need a diverse and multidisciplinary team with different backgrounds and experience. If you want to be part of an adventure building Appfarm to the next level, we look forward to receiving your application. Please attach a short resume preferably with examples on previous work experiences/projects.

Any questions? Please contact Malin Haglund (Head of Talent) at malin@appfarm.io

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Appfarm, our mission is to enable anyone to build exceptional digital solutions as fast and hassle-free as possible. We have commercialized a unique cloud-based development platform where you create, launch and manage business software 10x faster than previously possible, without using a single line of code. With drag & drop components and one-click deploy in the cloud, creating powerful digital experiences for web, tablet and mobile devices has never been easier. We are a diverse and multidisciplinary team of around 40 employees with a passion for no-code and changing the nature of digital transformation, but we're growing quickly. Our offices are located at Rebel, the new center of excellence for tech in Norway, with the best employee restaurant in Oslo. Working at Appfarm comes with the following four things: 💟 A healthy and happy work environment where everyone is respected, welcomed and included. We encourage knowledge sharing between departments, and have monthly events where we get the possibility to learn from and praise each others work. 🚀 Career development. We do everything we can to ensure the happiness and professional growth of our employees. We are still a small company that is quickly developing, meaning that there is a lot of room for you to shape your own career by taking on responsibilities in areas that you are interested in. 🎉 A lot of social events where we get to do fun things together! We have four major annual events (summer party, christmas table, cabin trip, and trip abroad), but we also do smaller things in between. ↔️ Flexibility. We believe that our employees know best when and in what surroundings they are most productive, and trust that the work get done without micromanaging your schedule. We are also firm believers in putting family before work when needed, and generally avoid scheduling meetings outside our core business hours between 9-15.

title: Tech Lead - Software
description:
Hey there!🌞

Do you want to contribute to a cleaner planet?

Skyfri Technologies AS is a  global and fast-growing clean technology company based in Oslo. Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production.

Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy globally and we believe that software will be the engine to achieve that goal.

What you’ll be doing

As a Technical Lead at Skyfri, you will play a pivotal role in leading and guiding a team of software engineers to deliver high-quality and innovative software solutions. You will be responsible for overseeing the technical aspects of projects, providing technical direction, and ensuring the successful execution of software development initiatives.

In this role, you will

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of software engineers.
  • Set and enforce coding standards, best practices, and development methodologies.
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  • Break down project requirements into tasks and allocate them appropriately among the team.
  • Lead the design and architecture of software solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to design principles and coding standards.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
  • Provide guidance on the selection of appropriate technologies for projects.
  • Address technical challenges and provide solutions in a timely manner.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues within the team.
  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality software through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Implement and improve automated testing processes.

 

    You are…

    … Smart and ambitious, with a passion for start-ups and clean tech. You are creative, always willing to break new ground and come up with new and exciting ideas. You are open-minded, kind, and a team player who understands that we are all in this together.

    In addition, we need you to:

    • Be fluent in English, our working language.
    • Live in or in commuting distance to Oslo, Norway.
    • Have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Work experience of a similar nature may be considered in place of the specified qualifications.
    • 6+ years of experience as a software developer, with a strong background in software architecture.
    • Strong background working with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure App Service, and Azure SQL Database.
    • Proficiency in React and JavaScript.
    • Expertise in C# and .NET development for building scalable and maintainable back-end systems.
    • Familiarity with version control systems, continuous integration, and deployment pipelines.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    What we offer

    • Competitive salary and benefits package.
    • Flexible working hours with work-from-home days.
    • Interesting work within a dynamic and innovative company.
    • A central role in a company in high growth, with great opportunities for career and personal development.
    • A lot of fun in an international and diverse office environment.

     

    At Skyfri, we embrace diversity as the cornerstone of who we are. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic. We choose our candidates based only on qualifications, merit and business need.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production. Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy globally and we believe that software will be the engine to achieve that goal.

title: Head of Technology Development
description:
About reTyre

At reTyre, we're not just another tyre company; we're revolutionising the industry. With our groundbreaking machines that can produce tyres from any material, we're setting new standards for what's possible. Imagine tyres that are biodegradable, luminescent, reflective, and more. This is not in the future; this is happening now. But that's not all; our new production technology opens up previously unimaginable opportunities.

We want you to be a part of this exciting journey. We're looking for an experienced leader with excellent talent in Project and People management. These qualities combined with R&D experience will contribute to driving our technologies and developments to the next level.


The Role

As Head of Technology Development at reTyre, you'll be at the forefront of leading the development team in innovative projects, meaning that you will own overall responsibilities of coordination, strategic planning, risk management, and ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in tyre technology.

But that's just the beginning.

Your role will extend beyond your team. You'll have the unique opportunity to work across departments, collaborating with our Commercial, Material and Manufacturing teams to take part in shaping the brand's next steps to meet and create new market demands and segments.

You'll also collaborate with technology teams from leading international brands, offering a global perspective to your teams’ work. Your involvement will span the entire development cycle—from the fuzzy front-end of ideation, through testing, designing manufacturing tools, overseeing trial production, and finally, to commercialization.

In essence, no two days will be the same. The team, will under your pristine management, pioneer new and sustainable tyre products, transforming not just how tyres look, but how the world views them. Your team’s work will be the future of the tyre industry.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and drive the team towards successful execution of development projects according to company milestones.

  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation as well as provide progress updates, gather feedback, and make necessary project adjustments.

  • Assign tasks and responsibilities, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.

  • Ensure projects adhere to relevant regulations, standards, and best practices, as well as implement quality control measures to ensure outputs meet required specifications and standards.

  • Lead the way! We are looking for an experienced people manager with a high focus on team building as well as being attentive to the individual, bringing out the best in both.

  • Leading with a culture of continuous improvement and innovation, that fosters a collaborative environment.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Project management, Engineering, Science, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in project management, with a track record of successful project delivery.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills and experience.

  • Proficient in project management tools and software.

  • Background from R&D


Personal Characteristics

  • Forward-thinking, engaged and a natural leader.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strategic and operative thinker with the ability to manage multiple complex projects at the same time, and lead a team to achieve innovative outcomes.


Why Join reTyre?

Be a Pioneer: This is an unparalleled opportunity to be the driving force of technologies that have never been seen before.

Influence: Your leadership will drive innovation and progress in our technology to set the new industry standard, impacting how tyres are made and used globally.

Career Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer tremendous opportunities for career advancement.

Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a competitive package.

Dynamic Team: Work with a team as forward-thinking and innovative as you are.


How to Apply

If you're ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime and make a global impact, send us your application, including your CV and other relevant documentation, demonstrating your relevant experience.

Applications are continuously evaluated, so apply today and redefine the future with us at reTyre.

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for a Manufacturing Engineer. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!

Your role

As our Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the consistent high quality and efficient production of Nofence's virtual fencing systems. You will be responsible for overseeing the entire manufacturing process, from designing and optimising manufacturing processes, to developing and implementing quality control procedures and troubleshooting any issues that may arise. Additionally, you will be involved in training and mentoring production staff, maintaining manufacturing equipment, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality and delivery. You will work in the Manufacturing team, close to both the development and operations teams.


Your responsibilities

  • You will be responsible for overseeing the entire manufacturing process. From designing and optimising processes to developing and implementing quality control procedures and troubleshooting.
  • Designing, optimising, and implementing manufacturing processes in our contract manufacturer's facility.
  • Conduct thorough inspections and testing of products to verify their quality and compliance with specifications.
  • Providing comprehensive training and mentorship to production staff, ensuring their expertise in manufacturing processes and quality control procedures at our contract manufacturer's facility.
  • Maintain and optimise manufacturing equipment and facilities, including fixtures and automation equipment, to maintain peak performance and efficiency.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including design, quality assurance, production, and logistics, to achieve seamless product development and delivery.
  • Proactively identify and troubleshoot manufacturing issues, utilising root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
  • Developing and implementing comprehensive quality control procedures to ensure product adherence to Nofence's stringent quality standards.
  • The role will include some travelling to our contract manufacturers and sub contractors.


Qualifications

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related fields.
  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, with a focus on quality control and electronics testing.
  • Strong understand of quality control principles and techniques.
  • Proficiency in designing and building fixtures and automation for manufacturing.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex manufacturing issues.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong work ethic, initiative, and a commitment to excellence in quality and efficiency.
  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


About Nofence 

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About Us

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Engineering team is currently a team of 21 employees working across our three Norwegian offices. We are open for candidates that can work from either Molde, Trondheim or Oslo. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment. 
 

What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you'll be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? After all, the grass is sometimes greener on the other side. Also, just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer!

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Head of Manufacturing Steinar Fagerli at steinar@nofence.no 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

Why Join reTyre?

If you're ready to be a part of something big and make a tangible impact every day, send us your application, including any relevant experience and skills you bring to the table.

title: Manufacturing Wizard
description:
At reTyre, you have the chance to join a unique and modern industrial adventure!

reTyre is in the process of building a brand new and revolutionary factory centrally located in Ski and needs even more skilled people to join the team now as production prepares to start. The factory will be the world's first sustainable tire factory.

With our innovative production method, reTyre enables the use of new and sustainable materials that will replace rubber in pneumatic tires. We are committed to innovative technology and production methods that are sustainable for the world we live in, and this is reflected in all our activities.

We are now seeking more colleagues with expertise and experience in production. Everything from machine operators to technicians and industrial mechanics to form our new team in the Manufacturing department. We are looking for both junior and senior levels. Those who are already experienced team leaders or aspire to such a role are also welcome to apply for this position and inform us of their career goals. Together, we will build a department of competent, motivated, and engaged employees who complement each other's strengths and bring out the best in each other. We work closely together in the organization to find the best solutions, and this department will work closely with the engineering team in R&D.

The production line will at some point in the future be staffed for 2 shifts.

 

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Operating and optimizing production processes
  • Adjusting machines for product changes
  • Reporting deviations, conditions, and improvement opportunities
  • Daily maintenance of machines
  • Following up on HSE activities

In addition, you will have the opportunity to participate in projects, documentation, workshops, and similar activities to enhance your own skills and contribute to development in the workplace.


We would like to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience with larger, automated machines such as injection molding or CNC-controlled machines
  • Practical experience from a production environment
  • Vocational certificate in relevant areas such as CNC, industrial mechanics, polymer, or thermoplastics. This is not an absolute requirement, and relevant experience can compensate for this.
  • English language skills to make yourself understood both orally and in writing


As a person, we are looking for someone who is:

  • Eager to learn, curious, initiative taker, and solution-oriented
  • Tidy and organized, with an understanding of what a well-maintained workplace should look like
  • A positive contributor to the work environment

Why work at reTyre:

The People: Our people are our primary tool for achieving our goals, and we focus heavily on taking good care of our employees through unity, well-being, and growth opportunities for those who desire.

Be a Pioneer: Become part of an innovative company that is redefining the tire industry. Your work will help set new industry standards and have a global impact.

Influence: Work in an innovative environment with a short distance from idea to implementation.

Dynamic Team: Work with a team as forward-thinking and innovative as you.

A simpler everyday life: Traffic-free to Ski, free parking, charging facilities, training facilities, and a good canteen arrangement.

Competitive salary and conditions.

title: Account Executive
description:
Om stillingen

Med store inverstornavn i ryggen som blant annet Antler og StartupLab, og en vekst på over 300% så langt i år, er vi rigget for å ta Kobbr videre. Vi søker derfor en uredd og engasjert Account Executive til en sentral rolle i salgsteamet, som ønsker å “brette opp erma” og være med på vårt spennende veksteventyr.

Som Account Executive vil du være ansvarlig for hele salgsprosessen fra å identifisere og kontakte potensielle nye kunder, til å forhandle frem og lukke avtaler. I tillegg vil du være ansvarlig for å følge opp din egen kundeportefølje og representere selskapet utad på messer og andre bransje-events. Du vil jobbe selvstendig men også i tett samarbeid med resten av salgsteamet for å nå våre vekstmålen, og sikre at vi har en bunnsolid salgsprosess til enhver tid.

Som Account Executive vil du være en ekspert på å forstå våre løsninger og dens fordeler. Som en nøkkelperson mellom teknologien og kundene, vil du også ta del i å sikre at Kobbr kontinuerlig utvikles for å være tilpasset kundenes behov og ønsker.

Rollen har konkurransedyktig lønn med gode provisjonsordning!

Om deg

Det aller viktigste for oss er at du er en god relasjonsbygger og har et driv for å jobbe med salg og kunder. Arbeidsdagen vil til tider være hektisk i en voksende startup, så du må trives med mye ansvar og tempo. Og litt kaos. Ellers ser vi etter deg med:

  • Minimum 3 års erfaring innen B2B salg
  • En god relasjonsbygger som kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Du er resultatorientert, initiativrik og ikke redd for å gjøre feil! Vi er et team som prøver og feiler sammen.
  • God teknisk forståelse, opparbeidet via tidligere arbeidserfaring eller utdanning
  • Du har anledning til å jobbe fra vårt kontor i Oslo
  • Det er en bonus om du har erfaring med Hubspot eller tilsvarende CRM-system


Vi tilbyr

  • Et actionfylt arbeidsmiljø der hver dag er unik, med en bratt læringskurve
  • En unik sjanse for å være med å utvikle en startup i en ambisiøs vekstfase
  • En rolle med mye ansvar og innflytelse, hvor din kunnskap og erfaring er verdsatt
  • Et sosialt miljø med kontorplass på Startuplab, Norges fremste oppstartsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn med gode provisjonsordninger


Slik søker du

Vi ønsker gjerne noen som kan starte så raskt som mulig. For rett kandidat er vi naturligvis fleksible med tanke på oppstartstid.

Vi ønsker en mangfoldig kandidatgruppe og en åpen søknadsprosess. Send oss en CV, en oppdatert LinkedIn-profil, eller annen dokumentasjon som viser din erfaring og kompetanse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kobbr is on a mission to lead craftsmen, such as electricians, painters and carpenters, into a data driven future. Craftsmen are used to old and outdated software that requires several training days to master. We are building a product that our customers actually love to use and requires no training to get started. Our approach sets us apart from traditional software companies in the industry. We prioritize integrating seamlessly with existing tools, rather than replacing them. Kobbr simplifies workflows and decreases manual tasks by offering a modern alternative to pen, paper, and Excel. Since our software can be easily integrated with craftsmen’s existing software, it shortens our sales processes significantly and opens the opportunity for product-led growth. Our goal is to develop an inclusive work atmosphere and assemble a varied team, as we encourage individuals from all different backgrounds to submit their applications and join our collective journey.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Attensi is a Norwegian tech company specialized in gamified simulation training. Since our inception in 2012, Attensi has grown to become a global leader in the field, with training solutions used by global brands in more than 140 countries and 30 different languages.

We use gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues, powered by our game AI, to create a ‘learning by doing’ training environment that encourages repetition and builds mastery. It is a radically new method to achieve high impact training that scales across large organisations.

We work with some of the largest retail, hospitality, industry, energy, pharmaceutical and professional services brands in the world including Circle K, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. Attensi is growing fast and are now focused on accelerating our business growth. We are over 250 Game Changers across our HQ in Oslo, London and Boston.


Role Overview

We are now seeking a data-driven and creative Digital Marketing Manager to take ownership of performance marketing channels and marketing automation. This is a fantastic opportunity for a digital marketer with solid B2B SaaS experience looking to step into a more strategic and senior role.


Key Responsibilities

Performance Marketing

  • Plan, launch, and optimise high-performing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns for lead generation and brand awareness

  • Drive A/B testing and landing page optimisation in collaboration with design/content teams

  • Manage ad budgets, targeting, and bidding strategies aligned with marketing goals

SEO & Content Strategy

  • Oversee SEO roadmap, including on-page optimisation, technical audits, and keyword strategy

  • Collaborate with content creators to ensure SEO best practices are embedded from concept to publication

Website maintenance

  • Work with WordPress to maintain the current website, create new pages and implement edits

Marketing Automation & CRM (HubSpot)

  • Own HubSpot as the central marketing automation platform

  • Build and optimise email nurture journeys, segmentation, lead scoring, and reporting

  • Work closely with Sales and RevOps to align lead lifecycle stages and lead quality

Email Marketing & Campaigns

  • Develop and deploy effective email marketing campaigns focused on engagement and lead conversion

  • Lead segmentation and personalised content strategy

Analytics & Data Segmentation

  • Track and report on KPIs across all digital channels

  • Set up dashboards and insights to support campaign decision-making

  • Monitor and enhance lead segmentation and data hygiene within CRM


Requirements

  • 5–6 years of hands-on B2B digital marketing experience, ideally in SaaS

  • Proven success with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads

  • Deep understanding of SEO best practices

  • Expert in HubSpot for email marketing and automation

  • Growth hacker mentality – obsessively trying to figure how to take us to the next level

  • Strong analytical skills with a data-first mindset (experience with Google Analytics, HubSpot Reporting, Looker Studio or similar)

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a scale-up environment

  • Curious, ambitious, and excited to own strategy and execution


Nice to Have’s

  • HR Technology experience and familiarity with the landscape

  • Experience working with international markets

  • Knowledge of paid social beyond LinkedIn (e.g., YouTube, Reddit, etc.)

  • Basic HTML or web CMS editing (e.g., WordPress)


What do we offer?

At Attensi you will become part of an exciting and rapidly growing scale-up that is already a global leader in its field. You get to work in a flat, open and free environment, surrounded by committed, smart and talented colleagues from a variety of backgrounds, both culturally and academically.

Attensi is committed to giving people the opportunity to grow and you will also be able to develop your role over time. You will also be offered exciting challenges in a dynamic and innovative environment with great ambitions.

Attensi has an energetic and social working environment. We work hard but also have a lot of fun. Monthly social activities like Attensi-days, sporting events, after-work drinks, parties, game nights and company trips are some of the ways in which we ensure we not only work together but also play together!


Are you a Game Changer?

We use gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues, powered by our game AI, to create a ‘learning by doing’ training environment that encourages repetition and builds mastery. It is a radically new method to achieve high impact training that scales across large organisations. We work with some of the largest industry, energy, retail, hospitality, pharmaceutical and professional services brands in the world including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. title: Forretningsutvikler
description:
Vi styrker nå vårt Business Development-team!

Teamet jobber med hele verdikjeden. Dette innebærer også å identifisere nye markeder og muligheter for videre vekst både lokalt og internasjonalt. Vårt ansvar er å sikre leveranse og skalering av våre produkter og tjenester i tett samarbeid med produktteamet. Denne rollen vil ha ansvar for markedsplass.

Teamet står sammen om å skape de beste leveransene for våre produkter og tjenester til markedet. Alle på teamet bidrar derfor der det er behov, men vil også i perioder kunne fokusere mer på et ansvarsområde.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bidra i strategiske prosjekter
  • Bygge business case
  • Tiltrekke og beholde kunder og partnere
  • Sikre relevante og konkurransedyktige leveranser
  • Sørge for høy kundetilfredshet
  • Analysere og konkretisere forretnings- og kundeinnsikt
  • Forstå kundebehovene, identifisere gap og iverksette forbedringer som bidrar til å sikre ytterligere vekst og økte markedsandeler.
  • Andre oppgaver på Business Development-teamet etter behov.

Hvem vi ser etter:

Som Business Developer vil du være ansvarlig for å skape vekst både nasjonalt og internasjonalt med vår unike markedsplass. Dine hovedoppgaver vil inkludere å identifisere nye forretningsmuligheter, bygge sterke relasjoner med kunder og partnere, samt utvikle og implementere strategier for førsteklasses leveranse.

Arbeid med Business Development forutsetter at du er målrettet, nøyaktig og strukturert med god ordenssans. Du er imøtekommende, tillitsfull og bygger raskt nye relasjoner. Du må evne å sette deg inn store mengder informasjon og jobbe systematisk og analytisk med flere parallelle løp for å sikre fremdrift.

Teamet har fokus på å støtte hverandre slik at alle drar i samme retning. I Bember er det alltid "vi" foran "jeg".

Kvalifikasjoner:

Dette er en "Middle Management-level" stilling hos oss. Du bør ha minimum 4 års relevant erfaring etter fullført høyere utdanning. Gjerne fra tilsvarende rolle som krever både teknisk forståelse og kommersiell teft innenfor digitale tjenester.

Du må evne å kommunisere på en tillitsbyggende og solid måte både internt og eksternt.

Stillingen krever meget gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter både på norsk og engelsk.

Arbeidssted er i Oslo og arbeidsspråket er i hovedsak norsk.

Hva vi tilbyr:

Først og fremst er dette en unik mulighet til å bli en del av et norskeid teknologiselskap som jobber for å utgjøre en forskjell i verden. Våre tjenester representerer et taktskifte i digitalisering av eiendommer og brukerreisene til leietakere, besøkende samt driftspersonale og eiere. Vi er veldige stolte av å kunne tilby sømløse digitale brukerreiser som også bidrar til et grønnere fotavtrykk!

Vi holder til i moderne lokaler sentralt i Oslo med tilknytning til Epicenter Oslo med kantineordning, treningsfasiliteter og sosiale arrangementer. Hos oss får du fast stilling, konkurransedyktig lønn og tilbud om årlig helsekontroll.

Bare ta kontakt om det er noe du lurer på - vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Smart retailers have strong webshops and lots of tools and data to drive traffic and conversion. But most of their business is still conducted through their physical locations. Using our tools, the physical shops are able to communicate and adjust their customer experience to the individual. Using the existing payment cards and terminals, we recognize the customer and capture all relevant data as is the norm online. This unique information is used to design a better shopping experience in the physical space. Our customers are the well-known retail brands you know from shopping malls across Northern Europe and the malls themselves. Norway and the Nordics already lead the world in electronic payments and the use of mobile and SMS to enhance sales. Now, we are pushing this further by combining access to the existing infrastructure surrounding shopping and a digital mindset to build closer relationships between retailers, shopping venues and their customers. One example of a customer using our on-site technologies to build loyalty and traffic can be seen here: https://youtu.be/c0qcv7CtIZE

title: Demand Planner
description:
• Want to predict customer demand using cutting-edge forecasting tools?

  • Looking for a role where your analytical insights influence executive-level decisions?


About the position:

As a Demand Planner with reMarkable, you'll drive our forecasting processes, mastering statistical forecasting while translating key commercial intelligence - promotions, campaigns, and product launches - into dynamic and accurate demand predictions across our global customer base and diverse sales channels. This role offers excellent career growth in data analytics and commercial strategy, giving you direct access to executive decision-making in a fast-paced, innovative environment where your forecasts shape key business outcomes.


Your responsibilities may include:

  • Contribute to end-to-end demand planning by generating statistical forecasts, supporting key account planning, and participating in monthly forecasting cycles.

  • Support S&OP and S&OE by collaborating with marketing and sales, supply, finance, and product development teams to gather data for integrated planning and identify demand plan gaps.

  • Manage planning systems by becoming proficient in the o9 demand planning platform, supporting daily operations, and helping adopt new forecasting capabilities.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration by preparing materials for forecast consensus sessions and gathering data on key demand drivers including promotions and seasonality.

  • Monitor performance and analytics by tracking forecasting KPIs, maintaining dashboards, conducting root-cause analysis on forecast errors, and preparing demand trend reports.


We are looking for the following experience:

  • 2+ years in analytical roles (demand planning, supply chain, finance, data science, or business analytics); exposure to S&OP environments preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Engineering, or related field. APICS/IBF certifications are a plus.

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets proficiency, and familiarity with forecasting tools (e.g. o9, Anaplan, SAP IBP) and data visualization platforms (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is beneficial.

  • Basic understanding of forecasting methodologies and ability to translate data into actionable insights.


As a person, you are structured and detail-oriented with great communication skills and a logical approach to problem-solving. You're eager to learn, adaptable to business changes, and bring a continuous improvement mindset with a proactive approach to tasks. As a responsible and collaborative team player, you thrive in cross-functional environments.


Practical information:

  • We will consider applicants on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Professional English, written and spoken. Our company language is English.

  • Location:  Oslo, Norway or Central London, UK.

  • Visa requirement Norway: Citizenship/valid work permit from EU/EEA.

  • Visa requirements UK: Citizenship/indefinite leave to remain (relocation to the UK is not possible at the moment).


Why we enjoy working here:

  • Highly skilled colleagues both within the team and in reMarkable at large.

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to our 25 days regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deep dive and be creative.

  • Premium health and life insurance.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Part-Time Driver
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Part-Time Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoys being active and thrives in a physically demanding role.

  • Likes working independently and with a team
