title: Senior Embedded Software Developer
description:
About us

Sensio is the leading provider of care technology in the Nordics, solving today's and tomorrow's care challenges for the benefit of service recipients, healthcare professionals, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

We are on an exciting journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. With the backing of Nordic Capital, one of Europe’s top private equity firms, we’re ready to take our flagship product, RoomMate, to the world.

RoomMate is a revolutionary safety sensor that detects and reduces falls using advanced algorithms. In addition, the sensor can be used for digital supervision and passive notification in case of dangerous situations. Both hardware and software are developed in-house by the RoomMate team.


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Developer who is product-driven, takes ownership, thinks big, and makes a real impact. You’ll be at the core of our product development, working on embedded software that powers the RoomMate sensor. In addition, you’ll have the freedom to take the lead and drive innovation forward.

The position is based across two locations: RoomMate’s Sandvika office and Sensio’s central Oslo headquarters.


What you'll be doing 
  • Developing embedded software in C++.
  • Collaborating with a world-class team of engineers, designers, and product managers to define and shape RoomMate’s evolution. 
  • Mentoring and supporting others by fostering an environment of knowledge-sharing and continuous learning within the team.
  • Taking ownership of complex problems, driving solutions with autonomy.
  • Contributing to product discovery, ensuring we build the right solutions for real-world healthcare challenges.


What we're looking for 
  • Expertise in C++ with a solid background in embedded software development on Linux.
  • Ownership mindset- You anticipate challenges, take initiative, and drive solutions forward.
  • A team player- You thrive in a team environment, sharing knowledge and growing together.
  • A product-oriented thinker- You think beyond code and understand how technology impacts the end user.
  • Fluent in English (Norwegian is a plus, or a willingness to learn). 


In addition, it's nice if you have one of the following 
  • Experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing.
  • Experience in signal processing, ML, or AI.
  • Understanding of hardware development.
  • Knowledge of communication technologies such as TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, mobile, or Bluetooth.


What we offer 
  • Meaningful work with purpose – making a difference for health care personnel, patients, and next-of-kin.
  • The opportunity to be part of a Norwegian tech company with ambitions of becoming a global leader.
  • Having a big impact on the development of Sensio’s flagship product.
  • To be part of an innovative culture focused on collaboration and user-centric development.
  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

title: Firmware Developer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an experienced Firmware developer. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!


About the role

As a Firmware Developer, you will join the Platform team, which is responsible for the core of our solution, from the firmware running on our collars, through the backend that our devices communicate with to our data collection and processing pipelines. You will be making sure that our devices keep working well, and that we keep developing our systems into a solid foundation from which we can launch new improvements, features and designs.


The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Firmware design with a focus on efficiency and innovation: We are integrating Zephyr RTOS on ARM-based MCUs to manage a variety of components such as motion sensors, GNSS receivers, LTE modems, and others. Your role will be central to our device's functionality, ensuring robust and innovative firmware development.

  • Striking a practical balance: You'll be tasked with achieving an optimal mix of simplicity, low power consumption, and high performance. This role is about more than just coding; it involves optimizing and introducing new features that enhance the capabilities of our products, making them more efficient and effective.

  • Advancing automated testing: You will play a key role in implementing and overseeing tests in Python within our Continuous Integration (CI) framework. Your efforts will focus on developing automated testing processes that thoroughly assess new features, guaranteeing the reliability and quality of our firmware before it is deployed to customers.

  • Collaborating with our team of engineers: You'll help foster an environment where creativity and practical engineering merge. Your expertise in firmware development will shape our products and promote ongoing teamwork and improvement.

  • Understanding and solving customer needs: Close cooperation with the product team will be essential to grasp user requirements and devise the most effective engineering solutions for the challenges our customers face.

  • Your impact: Joining us means contributing to the advancement of agricultural technology. Your work will help produce devices that are not just efficient and robust but also set a benchmark in engineering quality, contributing significantly to better animal welfare and farming practices.

 

About you

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • A relevant Master's degree, or equivalent. Alternatively, applicants with a Bachelor's degree complemented by significant relevant work experience are also encouraged to apply.

  • 5 years of experience in firmware development.

  • Have knowledge about or are familiar with these technologies: GNSS, LTE, and Bluetooth communication.

  • Have some experience in reading schematics and component data sheets, operating basic instruments like oscilloscopes and logic analysers, and soldering.

  • Solid programming skills, with experience in C, embedded RTOS and Python.

  • Experience in designing and developing robust firmware tests for embedded devices.

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


We are looking for someone who is:

  • A curious learner: As an innovative company we expect you to possess a great curiosity and a commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking to expand your knowledge and skills to drive innovation.

  • A product-oriented developer: You look beyond the tasks at hand and think about product problems, solutions and needs, helping to make sure that we're delivering an excellent and reliable solution for our customers and the animals.

  • A collaborative contributor: You believe in sharing knowledge, supporting your peers, and working together to solve complex problems. We believe this is a crucial part of being a team player.

  • A creative thinker: You challenge the status quo and bring innovative ideas to the table, driving progress and setting new standards of excellence.


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.  


About Us

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Engineering team is currently a team of 23 employees working across our three Norwegian offices. We believe in cooperation, adaptability, and a fun and relaxed working environment! 


What we bring to the table

Nofence is a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth. We think it is important to have fun while working hard, both for it to be worthwhile, and because it improves our output and chance of success.

If you're the right fit, you'll be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast! As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge technology.

Be part of a team that’s always looking forward, where your ideas and creativity are not only welcomed but also essential to our mutual success!


About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? After all, the grass is sometimes greener on the other side. Also, just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer!

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering manager Jakub Pegza at below email.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

title: Visual Designer - Digital Marketing
description:
As a Visual Designer at reMarkable, you'll be working hands-on with visual production for digital advertising while contributing to art direction and strategic creative development. This role offers the unique opportunity to see your creative work perform in real-time, reaching millions of potential customers worldwide. You'll work across the full spectrum, from nitty-gritty ad iterations to large-scale commercial film productions, making this a varied and exciting position.


Your responsibilities may include:

title: Software Engineer
description:
Glint Solar is an Oslo-based startup accelerating the solar energy revolution. We streamline the process of finding optimal solar project locations using GIS and climate data, making renewable energy development faster and simpler.


Our Team

We are a diverse, fun-loving team with varied interests, from astrophysics to frisbee golf to DJing on the weekend. What unites us is our support for each other, a passion for solving complex problems, and a commitment to driving positive change through technology.


The Role

We seek experienced software engineers that are skilled in their craft and always keeps the big picture in mind. Software engineers are involved early from understanding the problems customers face, prioritization and how to best solve them, together with design and product. We don't have separate front-end, back-end or infrastructure teams, everyone is "full-stack", but it's ok to have a preference. Day to day you will be working with React, Node and Python. We use AWS as our infrastructure provider. Our product is heavily centered around maps, and we use Mapbox as our map provider.

Our product team is on-site in Oslo so for this role we expect you to come in to the office as a rule. That said, we offer flexibility around working remotely when needed.


What we offer

  • A committed team of ambitious and motivated colleagues.

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing startup with global reach.

  • Participation in our option scheme.

  • Lots of laughter.


Location: Oslo, Norway  For more information about working at Glint Solar, you can have a look at our website: https://www.glintsolar.com/careers

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glint Solar is accelerating the adoption of solar energy by building the world's leading solar screening and analysis software. One of the main headaches for the development of large scale solar is identifying where to build and understanding the specific site conditions - we're tackling this! The world needs to build more renewable energy to combat climate change. We in Glint Solar believe that technology is the solution. We are therefore working effortlessly on building technology for developers of solar energy parks. We started with the very exciting floating solar market as this is one of the fastest growing energy sectors in the world and have since expanded into land based solar as well. We're backed by leading Norwegian and international VCs and private equity. Our HQ is at Mesh Nationaltheatret in Oslo where our international team works from, but we serve our global customer base with a focus on Europe. Some of our interesting customers include TotalEnergies, Alight and Statkraft. We have the culture of a startup with a flat hierarchy, where the idea matters, not who had it. We encourage trying new things, even if it fails. At Glint Solar you will have the freedom to do your best work – and focus your efforts on what *you* are good at. We believe in adapting to our people and their strengths – not the other way around. We back each other up, make sure obstacles are out of the way, and then we GO! And sometimes, quite often, actually, we go do something fun together, like cabin trips, company trips and social events. All with lots of laughter. We consider ourselves very privileged to have smart, curious, and caring colleagues who are working together towards our mission. We are comprised of 23 different people with nine different nationalities and a wide range of diversity of thought. Amongst us you’ll find coffee connoisseurs, map nerds, Mandarin speakers, yoga enthusiasts, foodies, cross-country skiiers, olive farmers, frisbee golfers, colleagues who DJ on the weekend and everything in between – because we value exactly who YOU are. Regardless of what you enjoy and value outside of work, there’s a place for you in Glint Solar.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionise livestock management we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for a Senior Project Manager. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology! Your role

Our Product & Engineering team design and develop the mechanics of our physical product and the electronics that goes into it. We develop the firmware that runs on the device and the cloud service it communicates with. We design and develop the mobile and web apps that our customers use. In short, there’s a lot of exciting work to be done, and by joining us you will be one of our keys to success!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Product & Engineering team to drive project management excellence. We also believe, and are sure you agree, that presence with our customers and observing the animals are important to further develop the product in use. In the field you will gather much information and use that input to make our product even better.


Your responsibilities

  • Drive execution of cross-functional initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, with high quality, and in alignment with Nofence’s strategic goals.

  • Define project plans, timelines, and milestones, while proactively managing risks, dependencies, and resources.

  • Serve as the main point of coordination between product, engineering, design, operations, and other stakeholders to maintain alignment and transparency.

  • Lead task forces during critical incidents, ensuring rapid coordination across teams to mitigate short- and long-term impacts.

  • Run daily stand-ups or incident response meetings to ensure swift communication and decision-making.

  • Ensure corrective and preventative actions are identified, implemented, and tracked to avoid recurrence of similar issues.

  • Manage new hardware projects end-to-end, from concept through to mass-volume production.

  • Coordinate across disciplines such as mechanical engineering, electronics, firmware, UX, manufacturing, and sourcing to ensure successful integration and delivery.

  • Oversee prototype builds, testing cycles, and validation activities, ensuring issues are tracked, prioritised, and resolved.

  • Partner with manufacturing and supply chain teams to ensure scalability and readiness for production ramp-up.

  • Advocate for data-driven decision-making and consistent use of project management tools and metrics.

  • Act as the primary point of contact between management, technical teams, and other stakeholders. Provide regular updates on project progress and challenges.

  • You will rely on the hardware product owner to drive the product and market requirements, while the project manager will be responsible for making sure the project is executed according to the right cost, time and quality, and fulfils those requirements set forward by the product owner.


Qualifications

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of project management experience, ideally in electro-mechanical or IoT product development.

  • Bachelor's or Masters degree in relevant field.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent planning, coordination, and multi-tasking abilities.

  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project challenges.

  • Driven and result oriented, always exploring ways to improve the timeline, cost and quality of any given project.

  • Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.


About Nofence 

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About Us

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 700 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Product and Engineering team is currently a team of 35 employees working across our three Norwegian offices. We are open for candidates that can work from either Molde, Trondheim or Oslo. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment.   


What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you'll be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo and Trondheim for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!


About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? After all, the grass is sometimes greener on the other side. Also, just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer! We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our CPTO, Egil Anonsen at below email.

title: Creative Copywriter
description:
Do you have a passion for creative ideas, sharp words – and grazing animals? Then you might be exactly the person we’re looking for.


About Nofence

Nofence is a fast-growing Norwegian tech company that combines nature and innovation, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in animal welfare and sustainable grazing. We’ve built the world’s first virtual fencing system for livestock, helping farmers let their animals graze freely without physical fences – while maintaining full control and making better use of their land. We are expanding rapidly in Europe and the US, creating a new category that is reshaping how the world thinks about grazing and livestock management.

We are looking for a Creative Copywriter to bring our brand to life through words across platforms, formats, and markets.


The role

At the heart of this role is creating powerful communication ideas and turning them into clear, engaging, and consistent messages that build trust and brand recognition. From punchy ad copy across multiple channels to campaign-driven landing pages. You will be part of our global brand team, working closely with our Brand Manager, designers, and local marketing teams to ensure our tone of voice is clear, recognizable, and scalable worldwide. Your work will follow our campaign calendar and communications cycle to ensure coherence throughout the year.


Your key contributions

  • Develop communication concepts and campaign ideas rooted in insights about farming and our product.

  • Work closely with design to create integrated concepts where words and visuals align.

  • Write creative, engaging copy for ads across channels (social media, display, video, print, events).

  • Adapt key messages for different markets and channels.

  • Manage and evolve Nofence’s tone of voice, ensuring consistent global storytelling.


Who are we looking for?

You’re a creative and commercially minded copywriter who makes ideas shine. You enjoy diving into the product and audience, and you’re just as confident writing a print ad as you are crafting a campaign landing page. You thrive in a cross-functional team and work closely with design, project management, and local markets. We imagine you have:


Your background

  • A brand-building background with solid experience in creative/marketing copywriting (agency or in-house).

  • Exceptional writing skills and a sharp instinct for concise, impactful messaging.

  • Ease in switching between punchy one-liners and longer campaign copy.

  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with designers, project coordinators, and local marketers.

  • Excellent English writing skills; Norwegian is a strong plus


Why join us?

Because you want to make a difference. At Nofence, you’ll get to:

  • Be part of a purpose-driven tech company focused on animal welfare, sustainability, and farmers’ everyday lives.

  • Work in an international environment with high pace, openness, and genuine passion.

  • Have room to influence the brand, experiment, and shape your role.

  • Enjoy a varied workday with exciting projects – and opportunities to meet colleagues and customers where they are.


Ready to talk?

You don’t need to write a long application. Just send us a few sentences about who you are, what motivates you in this role, and links to texts or projects you’re proud of (campaigns, landing pages, newsletters, ads).

The application deadline is Sunday October 5th. .

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Software Developer
description:
Join us to build products that give healthcare professionals more time for care. At Sensio, you’ll work on innovative products, shape architecture, and influence how our team grows.


About us

Sensio is the leading provider of care technology in the Nordics, solving today's and tomorrow's care challenges for the benefit of service recipients, healthcare professionals, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

One of our products is Sensio Insight, a decision support platform that gives healthcare professionals immediate, data-driven insights. By collecting and analysing information from sensors and systems, Insight helps staff plan, prioritise and act more effectively in a busy care environment.

Integrated with our widely used RoomMate sensor and as part of the Sensio 365 platform, Insight is designed to be secure and user-friendly. It ensures that the right information is always available so healthcare professionals can spend more time on care and less on searching for answers.


About the role

We are now looking for an experienced Software Developer to strengthen the Sensio Insight team. This is a hands-on role where you will contribute directly to the architecture and development of a brand-new product, while also shaping how the team works and grows.

This is a unique opportunity to work on a product that truly makes a difference. With Sensio Insight, healthcare staff gain more time for care and the confidence that their decisions are based on the best available information.

You will be part of a small but growing team where your work has a direct impact. Developers at Sensio help shape not only the code, but also the product itself.

The position is based at Sensio’s central Oslo headquarters.

What you'll be doing

  • Build scalable backend services in C# / .NET Core

  • Write clean, maintainable code with a focus on quality and test coverage

  • Collaborate with product managers and business stakeholders to evaluate ideas

  • Support cross-team collaboration with other Sensio products and integrations

  • Contribute to the architecture and design of a new platform 

You will report to our Development Lead, Arni, but you will also have the freedom to work independently and take responsibility for your own contributions.


What we're looking for

  • Solid experience with C# / .NET Core and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

  • Strong understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles and Data Structures

  • Experience building scalable distributed systems

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • At least five years of relevant experience (but skills and mindset matter most)

  • It is a bonus if you are familiar with algorithms and Domain-Driven Design


What we offer

  • Meaningful work with purpose – making a difference for health care personnel, patients, and next-of-kin

  • The opportunity to be part of a Norwegian tech company with ambitions of becoming a global leader

  • Having a big impact on the development of Sensio Insight

  • To be part of an innovative culture focused on collaboration and user-centric development

  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

title: Client Executive
description:
Join the Green Transition with a Leading Solar Energy Company

The climate crisis is the biggest challenge of our time, and building renewable energy is critical to succeed with the energy transition. Sunday Power’s mission is to accelerate solar energy for commercial buildings. With our unique business model and technology, we offer building owners and tenants all the benefits from solar, without any investment. We specialise in developing, building, financing and operating solar power plants on large commercial and industrial rooftops, helping accelerate solar energy smart and efficiently for all stakeholders.

With a portfolio of over 100 large scale solar projects we have quickly grown to be one of the largest solar companies in Norway, and we are now looking for a skilled and driven Business Developer at Associate up to Director level to join our Client Advisory team to help shape our next growth journey.


Key Responsibilities 

  • Working closely with CCO and the Client Advisory Team with lead generation, client advisory, sales and customer relationship management

  • Engage with main partners including EPCs, building contractors and energy advisors

  • Sales presentations, financial analysis, proposals, and contracts for prospective clients

  • Prep for and join client meetings with real estate owners (range from Norway's leading Real Estate owners and institutional investors to mids sized and family owned RE businesses) and their tenants

  • Ensure timely follow up is coordinating with different internal and external parties

  • Work with CCO and wider teams to improve our client value proposition

  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify new business opportunities

  • Support and work with other functions across marketing, finance and tech

  • Interest in renewable energy and sustainability

  • Strong organisational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks

  • Excellent communication skills in Norwegian

  • Mindset: A proactive, highly motivated individual with a strong commercial acumen and the ability to work independently


What We Offer

You will be part of Sunday Powers Client Advisory function working with sales and advisory.

You will also work as part of a team including marketing, finance, deployment, tech and legal. You’ll play a key role in driving sales to key clients including some of Norway's leading Real Estate players and investment groups.


This is a unique opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute to a fast-paced, impact-driven company.

  • A great opportunity to join a fast growing market leader

  • Full time position reporting to Chief Commercial Officer

  • A competitive salary package that reflects your skills and experience

  • Culture of excellence and innovation: be part of a passionate and ambitious team that aims to be the best at what we do, motivated by driving the green transition and value creation

  • Work Environment: Modern offices in the heart of Oslo.


If you are passionate about renewable energy and eager to contribute to a company that’s leading the way, we want to hear from you.


About Sunday Power

Sunday Power is a Norwegian scale up offering smart, profitable solar energy and battery solutions to commercial real estate. We are a team of 16 passionate team players coming from various backgrounds at leading firms in technology, energy, media and finance motivated by accelerating the energy transition with effective and profitable solar energy.

We are a profitable company with revenues above NOK 100M, have secured one of the largest financing partnerships for C&I solar in the Nordics, and are in a strong position to continue with high, profitable growth in the years to come.


Mission

Drive the energy transition in commercial real estate by providing the most efficient and valuable solar energy and storage solutions.


Learn more at www.sundaypower.no.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sunday Power’s mission is to accelerate solar power growth, put more renewable energy into the mix, and help the world decarbonize. The real estate industry stands for 40% of global CO2 emissions, and pressure is increasing on the industry to become greener and more sustainable. Our strategy is to offer property owners the easiest and most profitable way to greener buildings, and our business model enables us to give our customers all benefits of solar power – for free. We are developing technology for the future to make solar power on commercial buildings easier, smarter, and more profitable. Luckily, the resource we are harvesting shines everywhere. Therefore, we are aiming for international growth as part of our goal to make a difference in the world. We are constantly looking for new team members that can help us reach our ambition to help the world towards net zero. We have brand new offices in central downtown Oslo. We have a coffee machine where we brew great coffee, and eat typical Norwegian lunch together in our kitchen. We also have a rooftop terrace on the 9th floor where we like to take our Friday beers to celebrate the end of the week. Our working culture is Nordic - we have a flat hierarchy where everyone's expected to participate in discussion about the direction and strategy of the company. We believe we can build the best culture if everyone works primarily from the office, but we all work from other locations for a day or a week every now and then.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

We were acquired by Nordic Capital in 2024, one of Europe’s top private equity companies. Sensio has one of the leading in-house product development organizations in Norway, with about 80 product people. In total, we are a team of 220 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK, and Germany.

Read more about Sensio and our products here.


About the role

Sensio is on an exciting growth journey, transforming how we manage and deliver our SaaS offerings in healthcare and welfare technology. We are now looking for two experienced DevOps Engineers to join our Infrastructure & DevOps team.

You will be part of the group responsible for scaling, maintaining, and modernising the infrastructure behind Sensio’s S365 SaaS platform, including Unity, Vista, Insight, and our Dataplatform. We are moving from traditional infrastructure management to Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Configuration-as-Code (CaC), using tools like Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure Graph. This enables us to automate, scale efficiently, and build highly reliable systems that empower our customers and internal teams.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will have an immediate impact by supporting our rapid customer growth, enhancing platform reliability, and driving the delivery of new functionality. You will also play a key role in enabling new ways of working across Sensio as we continue to scale. 


Where you’ll work

You will be part of our Infrastructure & DevOps team, currently consisting of a Team Lead and three engineers. With your addition, the team will grow to five, with further expansion planned. We collaborate closely within the team and across various development teams to ensure our infrastructure supports Sensio’s ambitious product goals.

Location: Sensio HQ - Møllergata 4, Oslo (with flexibility for hybrid work). 


What you will do

  • Build and operate cloud-native infrastructure on Azure and on-prem environments.

  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, SQL/Postgres databases, Redis, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise).

  • Migrate existing services to IaC and CaC using Terraform, PowerShell, and automation frameworks. 

  • Implement and maintain robust observability solutions (monitoring, logging, alerting) to ensure high reliability and proactive operations.

  • Support and improve our CI/CD pipelines to enable smooth and reliable deployments.

  • Collaborate with product teams to ensure infrastructure meets current and future scalability needs.

  • Maintain high operational standards, ensuring platform reliability, security, and compliance.

  • Facilitate new teams and ways of working to enable delivery of new functionality as we grow.


Who you are

We believe you are a skilled engineer who takes ownership, thrives in a collaborative environment, and enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges.


We’re looking for someone with:

  • Deep expertise in at least one core area: Kubernetes, IaC with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud operations.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure and hybrid cloud environments.

  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills.

  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility.

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor focused on delivering results. 

  • Fluency in English. Norwegian is a plus. 


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work on products that improve thousands of lives.

  • A chance to shape Sensio’s infrastructure and platform capabilities during a period of major transformation.

  • The opportunity to take ownership of specific areas, becoming a domain expert and trusted advisor.

  • Daily collaboration with diverse engineering teams.

  • A role where your approach and values will help define how we collaborate, learn, and support each other within the team. 

  • Hybrid work options and a culture built on trust and flexibility.

title: UX/UI Designer

Remote · Global Team · Start: Beginning-Mid of October

What you’ll be doing as a People Advisor

You’ll be a partner for our Delivery/Fulfillment organization — and work closely with leaders to make sure we create great conditions for people to thrive and grow, while helping the business succeed.

  • Be the go-to person for personnel cases like sick leave follow-up and performance management, advise leaders on such cases, and participate in meetings for complex cases

  • Help leaders utilize Workday, sick leave data, and Peakon data to identify improvement areas and advise them on ways to improve these

  • Support union negotiations and general dialogue, including preparing materials and documentation

  • Design and improve low to medium complex people processes and create learning material for leaders on those processes.

  • Participate in People projects, such as developing the leaders, improving value creation and/or people engagement and wellbeing

  • Bring insights from your areas to help improve how we work with people across our organization


To thrive in this role, we believe you enjoy working both tactically and hands-on. You're curious, pragmatic, and comfortable navigating complex people challenges. You pay attention to detail, build trust easily, and know how to balance empathy with business needs. You're a confident communicator who’s not afraid to challenge or be challenged — always with the goal of helping people and teams grow.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Educational background in HR, relevant field, or equivalent work experience

  • Experience working with operational HR, working closely with leaders

  • Strong understanding of both the human and business sides of leadership

  • Solid knowledge of labor law, union collaboration, and compliance matters

  • Experience with HR systems (e.g., Workday, Quinyx, Peakon, or similar)

  • Be able to work from Lier, Norway

  • Fluent in both English and Norwegian


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Someone who builds trust with leaders and union representatives while also challenging them when needed

  • Strong communication skills

  • Ability to be structured and thorough, but at the same time handle quick operational tasks when needed

  • Ability to prioritize and do things in a “good enough” way when things are hectic

  • It’s a bonus if you’ve worked with People data and enjoy drawing insights to support good decisions.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

title: Current söker efter en svensk Support Specialist!
description:
Om CURRENT

Vårt mål är att driva en hållbar framtid för laddning av elbilar hemma, på arbetsplatsen och kommersiellt. CURRENTs molntjänst erbjuder en pålitlig, skalbar och sömlös laddningslösning för destinationer och passar företagskundernas behov. Vi erbjuder en innovativ arbetsplats, meningsfull karriär och att vara en del av ett växande företag. På CURRENT arbetar vi med etablerade kulturella värderingar och omfamnar mångfald. Innovation, öppenhet och pålitlighet driver oss. Vi arbetar hårt och firar framgångar, hanterar utmaningar med solidt teamwork, alltid för att skapa den bästa kundupplevelsen.

Är du nyutexaminerad eller har några års arbetslivserfarenhet och letar efter en plats att utveckla din karriär? Där du kan göra skillnad för dina kunder? Vill du påverka din arbetsvardag genom att vidareutveckla rutinerna för vårt växande kundsupportteam? Och samtidigt vara en del av ett elektriskt, hållbart äventyr för framtiden? Då kanske du är personen vi letar efter!

Arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden:
  • Uppföljning av kunder i vårt kundcenter via e-post, telefon och skärmdelning. Vi erbjuder tjänster till både B2B- och B2C-kunder, vilket ger variation i din arbetsvardag.
  • Du kommer också att arbeta med utveckling och förbättring av våra tjänster, med målet att vidareutveckla våra självbetjäningslösningar.
  • Du kommer också att delta i produktutvecklingen genom att föreslå förbättringar och förmedla kundens önskemål om nya funktioner.
  • Att vara bästa vän, mentor, informationskälla och hjälpare för våra partners (elinstallatörer) när de behöver hjälp med att konfigurera nya kunder i CURRENT-laddningslösningen.
  • Bidra till arbetet med information och artiklar till nyhetsbrev och artikler.
  • Vi använder för närvarande Zendesk som verktyg, och du kommer att få träning i detta
  • Om du är framgångsrik kommer du att kunna växa in i rollen som Customer Success Manager
Önskade kvalifikationer:
  • Slutförd treårig utbildning eller relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Intresse för IT och programvaruutveckling.
  • Gärna erfarenhet av teknisk support eller kundservice.
  • Gärna erfarenhet av liknande programvarusystem eller annan erfarenhet inom e-mobilitet.
Personliga egenskaper:
  • God muntlig och skriftlig framställning på både svenska och engelska. Vi planerar också att utöka vårt team inom Norge och Europa, så kunskaper i andra europeiska språk är en fördel.
  • Serviceinriktad och problemlösare (förstår användarens behov och hittar bra lösningar).
  • Strukturerad, självständig och pålitlig.
  • Stor arbetsförmåga och förmåga att prioritera
Vår anställningsprocess:
  1. Screening
    Detta kommer att vara ett kort samtal med vår rekryterare för att lära känna varandra bättre.
  2. Meet and Greet
    Intervju på vårt kontor med någon från CSM-avdelningen.
  3. Andra intervjun
    En ytterligare intervju för att lära känna dig bättre och för att du ska kunna ställa alla dina frågor!
  4. Referenskontroll
    En kort konversation med dina referenser.
  5. Erbjudande
    Om det finns en ömsesidig matchning hoppas vi att du kommer att gilla vårt erbjudande!
  6. Preboarding och onboarding
    Välkommen till CURRENT-teamet!

I den här rollen kommer du att få värdefull erfarenhet av kundsupport och användarsupport samt möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett kompetent supportteam på en spännande marknad.

Så om du brinner för kundservice och vill bli en del av vårt supportteam som vår nya supportspecialist, hör gärna av dig:)


Ansök idag och bli en del av vårt team på CURRENT! 💚

Om arbeidsgiveren:

WE ARE CURRENT CURRENT is developing a software platform for enterprise customers to manage, build and scale charging infrastructure for Electric Vehicles (EVs), with our hardware independent, certified, and future-proof smart energy management technology. Our ambition is to drive the sustainable future of home, workplace, and commercial EV charging. Being fully certified solution by the Open Charge Alliance, we support more than 40 charger types across 15.000 stations across 6 countries, and growing fast! To date, our solution has contributed to reducing CO2 emission by more than 20 tons. Our amazing team in CURRENT has been committed to e-mobility and smart energy management since 2013, almost at the same time as electric cars began hitting the streets. Over the years, we have grown to become the leading independent provider of EV charging platforms in the Nordics. OUR SOLUTION CURRENT's cloud-based platform provides the most reliable, scalable, and seamless management system for destination, home, and workplace charging. Our technology brings together installers, operators, service providers, EV drivers, and businesses with an all-in-one solution for handling charge points. At our core, we make EV charging simple, accessible, and reliable. And we are laying the ground for a scalable and sustainable EV infrastructure. OUR TEAM CULTURE We at Current Eco embrace a well-established set of cultural values, we embrace diversity. We believe it’s what helps us thrive. Innovation, openness, and reliability are values that guide our work. We work hard and celebrate our successes, handle challenges with solid teamwork, always focused on creating the best possible customer user experience.

title: Content Creator
description:
Creativity and content creation in the financial crime industry are broken. Not because we lack the tools, inspiration, or room for creativity, but because we are still letting the same boring conference panels, dry whitepapers, and sales-y webinars define the narrative.

At Strise Media, we are fighting a war against boring and brain-dead content plaguing the industry. We are here to embarrass every competitor who thought B2B content had to be dull.

Are you the Content Creator who makes execs sweat and laugh, and competitors copy you six months too late?


What We Have Already Done:

  • Hosted our podcast The Laundry live at Ministry of Sound in London (yes, a legendary nightclub, not a conference basement). Over 200 people queued up outside!

  • Turned our 130 podcast episodes into an AI-powered Megamind report that shipped in print.

  • Dropped a viral TikTok on GPT misuse for money laundering that hit 22 million views.

  • Launched a soapbox format collecting the most interesting voices in financial crime.


That’s just the baseline. Can you imagine the next move no one else dares to make, and actually bring it to life?


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop and deliver from A to Z on scroll-stopping and disruptive content across all platforms and channels, including LinkedIn, newsletters, TikTok, the website, and blog, in both written and video formats that actually create engagement. 

  • Bringing bold ideas to the table, keeping the creative energy high, pushing the brand (and the team) to stay ahead of the curve and stand out with a creative edge.

  • Take charge of our content plan, steering the timing and making sure campaigns, events, and launches hit hard, land right, and actually move the needle.


Apply if:

  • You would rather ignite a fire of ideas than quietly polish another 20-second b-roll.

  • You have killer creative instincts, you can smell cringe a mile away, and you put it down instantly.

  • You know how to take “compliance” (don’t worry, you don’t have to know anything about compliance to start with) and make it addictive, entertaining, and shareable.

  • If you don’t know something, you know where and how to learn it. 

  • You would rather break the industry with something new than blend into it.


Do not apply if:

  • If you proudly say you have never been on TikTok and believe that’s only for Gen Alpha. 

  • You still need a boss to hold your hand. This is not daycare, and we are not babysitters.

  • You think another 52-slide PowerPoint in a webinar will “spark inspiration.”

  • You confuse “content strategy” with reposting yesterday’s LinkedIn garbage in blog format.

  • You are scared of ambition, allergic to chaos, or the type who whispers “maybe next quarter” when faced with a big idea.

  • You think AI is too scary to try out, and when you hear things like “Veo3 and Nano Banana” just launched, you switch topics. 


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary, pension, and bragging rights.

  • A chance to be part of a global FinTech-scaleup that actually has taste.

  • A rare chance to make a dent in one of the most stagnant yet important industries out there.

  • Hybrid working set-up (minimum 3 days in-office) with subsidised lunch every day.

  • Central, brand new office located in the middle of Oslo.

  • We have the best social committee arranging monthly after-work events, an annual offsite, and more. 


We’re focused on making Strise a great place to be and to keep hiring great people to work with. If you want to know more about Strise, check out life at Strise on Instagram (strise.ai), our podcast on Anti-Money-Laundering, The Laundry, and our YouTube channel!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Strise is a fast-expanding technology company based in Oslo. We have built a revolutionary AML (anti-money laundering) Automation Cloud to help top-tier banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions fight financial crime. Our self-developed graph and AI technology centers around connecting insights about B2B clients and providing intelligent information to our customers. Vipps, SpareBank 1, and Nordea are just a few that have had great success in using Strise. We make an impact by making it easier and faster for banks to fulfill their mission of uncovering financial violations like money laundering. After successfully becoming trusted by many of the biggest financial institutions in Scandinavia, and securing $10M in funding from Atomico, we are now venturing into the UK, followed by the rest of Europe. We’re well on our way to becoming the global standard in anti-money laundering technology.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Sensio is a Nordic leader in the health care technology sector and is solving the elderly care challenges of today – and building the solutions of tomorrow for the benefit of residents, patients, healthcare personnel, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

Sensio is on a journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. We were acquired by Nordic Capital in 2024, one of Europe’s top private equity companies. Sensio has one of the leading in-house product development organizations in Norway with about 80 product people — in total we are a team of 210 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK, and Germany. 

Read more about Sensio and our products here. 


About the role

Are you driven by solving hard technical problems – the kind that require both patience, persistence, and creativity? Do you enjoy figuring things out while standing knee-deep in unknowns? Then we’d love to meet you!

We’re looking for embedded developers who want to shape the future of healthcare and education technology through smart, connected products. You’ll work on wireless systems that save lives, improve communication, and make classrooms sound better – all by getting the firmware just right. In our team, we’re working with cutting-edge technologies and modern tools to shape the future of healthcare and educational technology. If you’re passionate about building pioneering technology from the ground up, you’ll feel right at home here.

You’ll be part of a highly skilled and multidisciplinary product development team, collaborating closely with hardware, app, and cloud developers. The systems you help create will be used in home care, care homes, private residences, and schools.

The position is located in Sandefjord (Vestfold) and reports to our Tech and Development Lead. 


Responsibilities:

  • Develop robust, efficient, and secure firmware in C/C++ for resource-constrained embedded systems.

  • Work with RTOS-based environments like FreeRTOS and Zephyr.

  • Contribute to platform development on STM32 and Nordic nRF microcontrollers.

  • Design and implement low-power wireless communication protocols using Thread, BLE, and WiFi 6.

  • Optimize for power consumption, reliability, and safety in real-world use cases.

  • Participate in system design, code reviews, debugging, and hardware bring-up.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure tight integration across the full stack – from sensor to server.


What we are looking for:

  • Preferably 3+ years of experience working with embedded systems.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer engineering, cybernetics, electronics, or similar.

  • Strong skills in C and C++ programming for embedded systems.

  • Hands-on experience with RTOS environments and real-time firmware development.

  • Good understanding of wireless communication technologies (BLE, Thread, WiFi, etc.).

  • Experience with microcontrollers (especially ST and/or Nordic Semiconductor).

  • Familiarity with debugging tools, oscilloscopes, and low-level system analysis.

  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, written and verbal.

Bonus points for:

  • Previous experience with Zephyr RTOS or FreeRTOS in commercial products.

  • Background in low-power system design, medical devices, or safety-critical systems.

  • Knowledge of security practices in embedded systems.

  • Comfort with CI/CD, version control (Git), and automated testing frameworks.

  • A passion for breaking down tough problems – and sticking with them until they're solved.


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work on products that genuinely improve lives.

  • A strong embedded team where you’ll grow by solving real engineering challenges.

  • Access to a full product development pipeline – from idea to field deployment.

  • Hybrid work options and a culture built on trust and flexibility.

  • Professional development opportunities – including time to explore and learn.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

  • A friendly team where curiosity and initiative are truly appreciated.


Let’s be honest. You’ll get stuck sometimes. The problems we’re solving don’t always have obvious answers. But if you love the feeling of figuring something out that seemed impossible at first — and if you're the kind of person who can’t let go until the problem is solved — then you'll probably thrive here.

Come help us build the systems that create #MoreTimeForCare.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. title: Customer Service Agent
description:
Working at Mercell 

At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.


Your Mission

You will be part of a dynamic team with colleagues across the Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden, Germany and Norway. The Norwegian team, based in Skøyen (Oslo), currently consists of six Customer Service Agents. In this role, you will report to the Team Lead Customer Service.

As a 1st Line Customer Service Agent at Mercell, your mission is to deliver outstanding customer support by providing timely, accurate, and professional assistance. As the first point of contact, you will guide customers through product usage, troubleshoot technical issues, and enhance their overall experience. Your role is crucial in fostering customer loyalty, gathering valuable feedback, and collaborating with internal teams to improve our products and services continuously.


We see the following qualities as important to thrive and evolve in this role:

  • Strong Communication Skills – Ability to actively listen, clearly convey information, and maintain a professional and customer-focused approach across various communication channels

  • Problem-Solving Mindset – A proactive attitude towards troubleshooting, resolving customer issues efficiently, and escalating when necessary.

  • Adaptability & Product Knowledge – Willingness to learn and keep up with fast pace evolving products, services, and technical requirements.

  • Time Management & Multitasking – Capability to handle multiple inquiries efficiently while prioritizing tasks to ensure a seamless customer experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Multi-Channel Inquiry Management – Handle multiple customer inquiries simultaneously across different communication channels, prioritize workload effectively, and maintain detailed documentation using Jira and other tools.

  • Customer Communication & Support – actively listen to customer needs, provide clear and professional responses, and follow up as needed to ensure issue resolution.

  • Technical Troubleshooting & Guidance – Assist customers with technical issues, provide accurate product information, and escalate complex problems to the appropriate teams when necessary.

  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement – Work closely with internal teams to enhance the customer journey, contribute to product and service improvements, and update self-help knowledge base articles to empower users.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in a customer service or help desk role.

  • Professional-level fluency in both written and spoken Norwegian and English.

  • Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting public sector customers.

  • Basic knowledge of procurement processes.

  • Work experience within a SaaS environment.


Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Full time

Workplace type: Hybrid (working onsite at the office and from home, balancing flexibility with collaboration)

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 26.09.2025. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them


What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.


Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!

If you have questions for this position, we are happy to chat with you. Please reach out to Rune Johansen , Team Lead Customer Service Norway and Denmark at below email.


We may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Driver
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoys being active and thrives in a physically demanding role.

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Service-oriented and a problem-solver, with a genuine desire to make customers happy.

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Assessed on an ongoing basis

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Storemyrsletta 8, 4790 Lillesand

  • Working hours: Full-time Morning/Evening shifts


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Content Marketing Manager
description:
Please note: Interviews for this role will be conducted in August.

Strise is a fast-expanding technology, creator of the AML Automation Cloud that helps top-tier banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions fight financial crime.

Strise’s graph and AI technology centres around connecting insights about B2B clients and providing intelligent information to our customers. Over 70 percent of the financial institutions in the Nordics are our clients and have had great success in using Strise.

Strise makes an impact by making it easier and faster for banks to fulfill their mission of uncovering financial violations, like money laundering. You will be our go-to wordsmith, capable of conveying messages in unique and impactful ways across various formats and platforms. Your creative acumen will enable you to not only produce written content but also contribute to multiple projects like the Laundry, ensuring consistency and quality across all channels.

Join us in our journey to redefine industry standards with AI-driven solutions.

You can read more about what makes Strise special on our Careers Page.

We are looking for individuals to be based in our London or Oslo office.


What you will do:
  • Take ownership of LinkedIn and manage the copy across all platforms including web, sales collateral, and pitch decks.

  • Work with the design team to continue developing and maintaining a consistent tone of voice across all platforms.

  • Contribute to various projects across departments, such as product marketing, demand gen, and The Laundry to repurpose content and create written materials based on target audience preferences.

  • Utilize AI tools to enhance copywriting efforts, maintaining authenticity while leveraging technology for efficiency.

  • Be the point person for copywriters, constantly testing, tweaking, and improving messaging to differentiate us in the market.

Requirements

  • Strong background in content marketing or a similar role with a proven ability to contribute to marketing strategies and execute hands-on content production.

  • Expertise in writing copy that effectively sells products and drives marketing efforts.

  • Creative thinker with a passion for storytelling and an obsession with messaging.

  • Experience with utilizing AI tools to 10x the output.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary.

  • Learning & Development Budget (L&D) to support certifications, conferences, etc. for your continuous development in Strise.

  • A unique opportunity to join and impact a fast-growing scale-up with global ambitions in the field of anti-money laundering.

  • Opportunity to work with modern technology in a highly skilled and motivated team solving a real societal problem.

  • We have the best social committee in the business with two off-sites a year, a week worckation to Greece planned in November, and after-work catch-ups, as well as monthly sauna to mention some things - we’re focused on making Strise a great place to be and to keep hiring great people to work with.

If you want to know more about Strise, check out life at Strise on Instagram (@strise.ai), our podcast on Anti-Money-Laundering, The Laundry, and our YouTube channel!

Vipps, SpareBank 1, and Nordea are just a few that have had great success in using Strise. We’re well on our way to becoming the global standard in anti-money laundering technology.

title: Privacy Lead
description:
About Sensio

Sensio is a European leader in care technology, on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. We solve today’s and tomorrow’s challenges for the benefit of residents, healthcare professionals, and society as a whole.

We design and deliver sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of elderly care. Our portfolio includes silent nurse call systems, fall prevention, digital supervision, and mobile security alarms, all enhanced by AI that transforms sensor data into actionable insights and unique decision support for care professionals. The result is better workflows, higher quality, and more time for person-centred healthcare.

With 230 employees and growing, we are already the market leader in Scandinavia and are now expanding into the UK and Germany. By developing both hardware and software in-house, we ensure our innovations are reliable, scalable, and tailored to the real needs of elderly care. Backed by Nordic Capital and Longship, Sensio combines the agility of a scale-up with the strength of a well-funded growth company.

Read more about Sensio and our products here. 


About the role

We are looking for a Privacy Lead to be Sensio’s leading expert in privacy and data protection. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution: you will set direction, drive initiatives, and take ownership of privacy across the company – but without necessarily leading a team. The role reports directly to our CISO and has a significant impact on Sensio’s commercial and product success.

As Privacy Lead, you will advise teams across Sensio on GDPR and privacy matters, provide training, and help strengthen our overall culture around privacy. You will also play a key role in customer dialogues, ensuring that Sensio not only complies with regulations but also builds trust – a critical driver of our growth.

Looking ahead, you will guide us as we enter new markets with different regulatory frameworks and ensure that privacy is embedded by design in our new products and solutions. This is a role for someone who thrives on combining legal expertise with technology and business understanding – and who wants to make a tangible impact in a company that develops products used daily in elderly care across Europe. 


Key responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain internal privacy policies, routines, and processes.

  • Provide advice and support on privacy matters across Sensio.

  • Lead and further develop Sensio’s privacy program.

  • Contribute to training, awareness, and building a strong privacy culture.

  • Contribute to our work with ISO 27001based Information Security Management System (ISMS)

  • Participate in risk assessments, DPIAs, and projects involving personal data.

  • Ensure Sensio stays updated on relevant legislation and best practices, particularly within the healthcare sector.

  • Support product development by embedding privacy by design principles.


What we are looking for

  • Strong expertise in GDPR and privacy regulations.

  • Several years of experience working with privacy in a tech environment.

  • An understanding of the intersection of law, technology, and business.

  • Balance between strategic thinking and a hands-on, operational approach.

  • Experience working with information security

  • A clear communicator who can build trust across teams and stakeholders.

  • Fluency in English. Norwegian is a plus.


In addition, it’s nice if you have

  • Experience working with different aspects of using AI

  • Technical understanding of IT systems and how privacy should be integrated into digital solutions.

  • Education in law, legal informatics, or similar – but your skills and experience matter most.


What we offer

  • An opportunity to work on products that truly make a difference for people and society.

  • A leading expert role. You will be Sensio’s top privacy authority, with influence on strategy, product design, and customer success.

  • Strategic and international exposure. As we expand into new markets such as the UK and Germany, you will play a key role in navigating different regulatory landscapes.

  • Being part of a collaborative and mission-driven culture.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Central offices at Møllergata 4, in the middle of Oslo.

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people.
