title: Marketing Manager
description:
Do you want to be part of a fast-growing Norwegian technology company?

Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy globally and we believe that Energy Management Software (EMS) will be the engine to achieve that goal.

Skyfri is a fast-growing climate technology company in Norway that has developed a groundbreaking management and monitoring system for distributed hybrid solar and battery power plants. We continuously work to adapt our solutions to meet tomorrow's energy needs. Our system ensures that the emerging amount of local energy production will work for, and not against, today's energy infrastructure.

What you’ll be doing

We seek an ambitious Marketing Manager who wants to make a difference and enjoys driving individual work and being a part of a diverse and international team. The work will consist of exciting opportunities to develop, implement, and execute strategic marketing plans aiming to attract new portfolio clients and partners. You will be a part of the commercial team.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage the marketing budget, suggest plans and priorities, and track spending of the different initiatives
  • Provide monthly reports to the management team on key marketing-related KPIs (leading and lagging indicators)
  • Bring our brand to life through both digital and physical channels
  • Turn our achievements into stories to be consumed by both potential customers and potential employees
  • Event management: Plan, execute, and report results from trade show participation as well as conference attendance
  • Serving as the internal owner of our external digital surfaces, including our knowledge base, product documentation, and marketing material

You are...

... smart and ambitious, with a passion for start-ups and clean tech. You are creative and willing to break new ground and produce exciting ideas. You are open-minded, kind, and a team player who understands that we are all together.

In addition, we need you to: 

  • Have at least one relevant super-skill that aligns with your passion. Please tell us about your super-skill in the application form and be prepared to demonstrate it during the interview process. Examples of super-skills: Photography, Video editing for SoMe, Writing and storytelling, Layout & Design, Creative high-impact SoMe campaigns, Paid ads campaigns, Building web presence (incl. a high proficiency in front-end coding), etc.
  • Be proactive and drive the development of projects and tasks independently
  • Have excellent English written communication skills, Norwegian is a great plus
  • Provide an existing portfolio of work you have completed (please show us what you have done before!)
  • Live in or within commuting distance of Oslo, Norway
  • Have a minimum of 2 years of work experience in marketing (student/voluntary engagements counts)
  • Be familiar with marketing software and tools (please list the tools you are familiar with in the application form)

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Flexible working hours with work-from-home days (note: first 6 months are in-office only for onboarding purposes)
  • Engaging workplace within a dynamic and innovative company
  • A leading role in one of Norway’s most attractive high-growth tech companies, with great opportunities for career and personal development
  • Opportunities for developing competence and skills
  • A lot of fun in an international and diverse office environment

At Skyfri, we embrace diversity as the cornerstone of who we are. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic. We choose our candidates based only on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skyfri Technologies AS is a global and fast-growing clean technology company based in Oslo, Calgary, Singapore and Hyderabad. Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production. title: Lead Demand Planner
description:
• Want to develop and lead cutting-edge forecasting while mentoring the next generation of demand planners?

  • Can you unite Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain and directly influence C-suite decisions?


About the position

In the pivotal role of Demand Planning Lead, you will take full ownership of our forecasting engine. You'll drive strategic alignment as the central figure in our S&OP process, leverage the advanced capabilities of the o9 platform, and be responsible for developing the next generation of planning talent at reMarkable.


Your responsibilities may include:

  • Developing end-to-end demand planning processes, leading monthly forecasting cycles with key accounts, and maintain statistical forecast models.

  • Owning demand-side S&OP/S&OE contributions, collaborating with marketing and sales, supply chain, finance, and product teams for integrated planning to understand end-customer dynamics, promotions, seasonality, new-product introductions, and risk factors.

  • Serving as functional owner of the demand module in o9 and drive continuous improvement to achieve increased effectiveness and quality

  • Convening forecast consensus sessions with sales, marketing, and supply chain leaders, ensuring alignment on demand plans.

  • Identifying gaps in demand plans and trigger mitigation or escalation actions.

  • Defining forecasting KPIs, create executive dashboards, mentoring the demand planning team, and lead change management initiatives.


We are looking for the following experience:

  • 5+ years in demand planning or supply chain planning with proven track record owning forecast processes in mid-size organizations.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Engineering, or related field; APICS/IBF certifications strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency with forecasting tools (SAP IBP, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, o9, Anaplan) and strong understanding of statistical forecasting methodologies.

  • Extensive experience with sales, marketing, and supply chain teams, preferably in S&OP or IBP environments.

  • Strong data analytics capabilities with experience in Power BI, Looker, or Tableau, plus ability to translate data into insights and decisions.


As a person, we're looking for someone with strong analytical abilities and who’s passionate about building a team, implementing best practice and continuous improvement. You're an excellent communicator who translates insights into actionable recommendations. Your technical expertise with advanced platforms, combined with leadership skills to mentor teams and drive change, makes you adaptable to our rapidly evolving business needs.


Practical information:

  • We will consider applicants on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Professional English, written and spoken. Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway or Central London, UK

  • Visa requirements UK: Citizenship/indefinite leave to remain (relocation to the UK is not possible at the moment).

  • Visa requirement Norway: Citizenship/valid work permit from EU/EEA.


Why we enjoy working here:

  • Highly skilled colleagues both within the team and in reMarkable at large.

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to our 25 days regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deep dive and be creative.

  • Premium health and life insurance.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey there!🌞

Do you want to contribute to a cleaner planet?

Skyfri Technologies AS is a  global and fast-growing clean technology company based in Oslo. Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production.

title: Graduate 2025 - Solution Engineer
description:

Vi er på utkikk etter flere kollegaer som ønsker å jobbe med banebrytende teknologi i et arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, flat struktur og mye moro. Som en del av vårt team vil du hjelpe kunder med å skape skreddersydde digitale løsninger raskt og effektivt, samtidig som du bidrar til å utvikle et ledende no-code ekspertmiljø sammen med våre kunder og partnere.

Appfarm (appfarm.io) leverer skreddersydde digitale tjenester ved hjelp av vår egenutviklede teknologi. Vårt innovative produkt, Appfarm Create, muliggjør utvikling av avansert programvare med tilpassede funksjonaliteter - alt uten å skrive en eneste linje med kode, kun ved hjelp av en nettleser.

Som et ungt og dynamisk teknologiselskap utfordrer vi prinsippene for hvordan god programvare bør utvikles, og vi leter etter talentfulle individer til å bli med på denne reisen. Kanskje det er deg?


Hva kan vi tilby deg?

  • En sentral rolle i en tech scale-up.

  • Et selskap som ønsker å skape det neste store innen programvareutvikling, og engasjerte kollegaer med evne til å få det oppfylt.

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og opsjoner.

  • Hybrid arbeidsmodell og fleksible arbeidstider.

  • Kontor på Rebel – med en av Oslos beste lunsjordninger.

  • Et åpent og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og fantastiske kollegaer.

  • Årlige firmaturer, hytteturer og en rekke sosiale arrangementer.


Dine viktigste oppgaver og ansvarsområder vil inkludere:

  • Utvikling av komplette web- og mobilapplikasjoner ved hjelp av Appfarm Create. Dette inkluderer alt fra design av løsning til utvikling av datamodell, forretningslogikk og brukergrensesnitt.

  • Prototyping og eksperimentell utvikling med “fuzzy” spesifikasjoner.

  • Aktivt samarbeid med våre kunder, partnere og leverandører.

  • Bidra til den faglige og sosiale utviklingen i selskapet vårt, slik at vi kan bli en av Norges mest spennende arbeidsplasser.

  • Bidra til strategiske initiativer knyttet til teknologi, produkt og markedsføring.


Vi tror du vil lykkes i denne rollen hvis:

  • Du er en problemløser som ser helheten, men også forstår viktigheten av detaljer for å skape gode løsninger.

  • Du har evnen til å forstå kommersielle aspekter og sluttbrukernes utfordringer.

  • Du har kanskje ikke en utviklerbakgrunn, men du har et analytisk sinn, god logisk tenkning og en forståelse for prinsipper innen programvareutvikling. Erfaring med programmering er en fordel.

  • Du er komfortabel med å jobbe med uklare spesifikasjoner og innser at suksessfulle digitale løsninger til syvende og sist defineres av brukeropplevelsen.

  • Du har gjennomføringsevne, er resultatorientert og trives i et team med ambisiøse kollegaer.

  • Du fullfører din utdanning i 2025.

  • Du bor i Norge/Østlandet eller planlegger å flytte hit.

  • Du behersker engelsk og kan kommunisere på et skandinavisk språk.


Vi har troen på at et mangfoldig, tverrfaglig team skaper innovative løsninger. Hvis du ønsker å bli med og løfte Appfarm til neste nivå vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Send inn din søknad, inkludert et kort motivasjonsbrev som forklarer hvorfr du ønsker å jobbe hos oss, samt en CV med relevante prosjekter og akademiske resultater.

Har du noen spørsmål? Ta gjerne kontakt med Malin Haglund via email.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Appfarm, our mission is to enable anyone to build exceptional digital solutions as fast and hassle-free as possible. We have commercialized a unique cloud-based development platform where you create, launch and manage business software 10x faster than previously possible, without using a single line of code. With drag & drop components and one-click deploy in the cloud, creating powerful digital experiences for web, tablet and mobile devices has never been easier. We are a diverse and multidisciplinary team of around 40 employees with a passion for no-code and changing the nature of digital transformation, but we're growing quickly. Our offices are located at Rebel, the new center of excellence for tech in Norway, with the best employee restaurant in Oslo. Working at Appfarm comes with the following four things: 💟 A healthy and happy work environment where everyone is respected, welcomed and included. We encourage knowledge sharing between departments, and have monthly events where we get the possibility to learn from and praise each others work. 🚀 Career development. We do everything we can to ensure the happiness and professional growth of our employees. We are still a small company that is quickly developing, meaning that there is a lot of room for you to shape your own career by taking on responsibilities in areas that you are interested in. 🎉 A lot of social events where we get to do fun things together! We have four major annual events (summer party, christmas table, cabin trip, and trip abroad), but we also do smaller things in between. ↔️ Flexibility. We believe that our employees know best when and in what surroundings they are most productive, and trust that the work get done without micromanaging your schedule. We are also firm believers in putting family before work when needed, and generally avoid scheduling meetings outside our core business hours between 9-15.

title: Fulfillment Team leader
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD LIER DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.


As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


We’re looking for Fulfillment Team Leaders to join Oda!

As a Team Leader, you will lead a team of operators to achieve operational excellence. You will be responsible for the well-being and development of your team members, providing support and guidance to help them thrive in their roles. Additionally, you are responsible for ensuring that your team operates in accordance with current safety standards while achieving ambitious goals in terms of quality and efficiency.

We are looking to hire several new team leaders for both day (06:30-14:30) and night (22:00-06:00) shifts. The position follows a rotational shift schedule, including one weekend every 4th week. We are hiring for both the Dry and Cold departments. Please indicate the shift and department for which you are applying.


What you’ll be doing as Fulfillment Team Leader

Lead your team (consisting of 10-15 operators) in operations, participating in the operational tasks and processes required during a shift.

  • Set daily production targets in agreement with the Operating Manager and Operations Coordinator, and communicate these targets to your team to ensure everyone is engaged and motivated to reach them.

  • Ensure your team’s well-being by ensuring that everyone is seen and has a designated person to turn to if they have any feedback or concerns.

  • Give direct and constructive feedback to your team members and guide them in how they can develop and grow in their roles.

  • Work actively to prevent and follow up on sick leave and disciplinary cases in accordance with company-defined standards within your team, setting high expectations while ensuring clear and open communication with your employees.

  • Follow up on our expectations for our employees and serve as a role model for the company’s leaders and employees.

  • Use the internal Leadership Principles as a foundation for your leadership.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Operational experience from warehouse and/or logistics.

  • Previous leadership experience is a plus

  • Proficient in communicating clear goals and expectations.

  • Used to working in warehouse management and with technical support tools.

  • A practical sense toward solving operational issues that may arise throughout the day.

  • Proficient in English

  • Understanding Norwegian is an advantage, but not a strict requirement

  • Good computer skills and a technological interest


What Success Looks Like in This Role💡

  • A highly motivated team spearheaded by you, working together towards reaching a common goal.

  • High spirits and presence within your team, with you as a role model.

  • A working environment where individuals are met on their level and developed accordingly.

  • An efficient way of communicating important information, within the team, across the rest of the shift, and with other stakeholders.


To thrive in this role, you live by Oda’s behaviours, communicate openly, and handle challenging conversations and situations with confidence. You’re goal-driven, enjoy problem-solving, and stay open to feedback, new ideas, and continuous improvement.


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Team Leader in a fast-moving company with a product people love, while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to stay fueled and energized.

Apply before October 12th – applications will be processed on an ongoing basis.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let us know, and we’ll do our best to assist you. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal opportunity to land the job. 🧡

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Head of Sales - 10 months contract
employer: TOO GOOD TO GO NORGE AS
description:
More than one third of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: To inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. We are the world's #1 app for fighting food waste and we work with thousands of restaurants and food retailers to make their surplus food available to local consumers. The magic of Too Good To Go has expanded rapidly across Europe, the US, and Canada, with over 300 million meals saved across our 19 countries to date.

We’re proud of what we’ve achieved so far, but did we mention the issue is huge? We always want to raise the bar and that’s where you come in.

We’re looking for an exceptional Head of Sales - 10 months contract to join our superstar team at Too Good To Go in Oslo, Norway 🚀. 

 

 

Your mission:

 

Our store partnerships are the life-blood of our business - in this role, you will lead the team responsible for acquiring new independent stores at full speed across strategic areas in Norway.

Are you excited about sales? Do you get energy from working with great colleagues in a social impact company with a higher purpose?

Do you want to support our team in learning all about how to sell over the phone, from the first cold call all the way through to onboarding and post sales, retention and supply optimization calls?



The team is composed of 3 sales specialists and 1 account manager (Partner Growth).
Your goal will be to maximize sales performance by providing leadership to the independent sales team and implementing global initiatives at local level with success 🚀

 

Your role:

  • Recruit, develop and build the team: Using your in-depth knowledge and experience of different sales methodologies you will ensure the team fulfil their potential and constantly train, coach, mentor and support them for peak performance.
  • Lead the Sales Team, while maintaining a positive, energetic and motivating work environment. You will provide leadership by coaching, inspiring and engaging your team. You will ensure the effective fulfillment of objectives and deadlines assigned on an individual and team basis and adherence to agreed team KPIs. 
  • Inspire & Empower: Champion a high-performance sales culture within the team to support our mission and business objectives.
  • Structure and Optimise: Identify key performance drivers and set up the right team structures and processes for exponential growth.
  • Strategy and market mapping: Analyse the Norway market to identify geographic and segment opportunities for growth and build the plan for optimum results.
  • Leadership and Management: Your role is to inspire and empower your team : you set the vision, the ambition and make sure your experts have everything they need to run their own area of ownership.  You lead with trust and share our values.

 

Requirements

  • You have a solid experience in Sales and a in-depth knowledge and understanding of food sector
  • You have leadership skills
  • Mastering both Salesforce and Excel are a must have. 
  • You thrive given freedom and accountability for results, enjoy setting ambitious goals for your team and over-perform.
  • You have developed a sales function in a fast-growing business, continuously searching for better ways of working based on the various sales methodologies
  • You believe in preparation and anticipation and have set the bar higher for your previous teams 
  • You are highly organised and can build structures and processes that meet business needs
  • You are commercially highly astute with proven problem-solving and influencing skills and are able to draw on those skills to set the bar high and get team members to perform at their absolute best constantly.
  • You are a make-it-happen person and excited to roll up your sleeves.

 

Our values:

  • We Win Together
  • We Raise the Bar
  • We Keep It Simple
  • We Build A Legacy
  • We Care

What we have to offer 

  • A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company (and certified B Corporation!) where you can see real and tangible impact in your role.
  • Working alongside an international community of users, partners and 1,200+ colleagues across 17 countries that are on the same important mission.
  • Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work
  • A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues that care.

Benefits

  • WORK FLEXIBLY: 
    • Enjoy hybrid working from our great offices, at home or abroad.
    • Extra parental leave and days off beyond local legislation and the option to take an extra week of unpaid leave
    • Health insurance and pension plans (subject to country of employment).
    • Additional days off for significant life events
  • CELEBRATE & SOCIALISE
    • Regular social events like summer and winter parties.
    • Coffee, snacks and fully-equipped kitchens.
    • Get to know our community with a monthly free Surprise Bag
    • Paid volunteer time through our Shareback volunteering programme
    • Women in the Workplace, P.R.I.D.E., People of Colour and Functionally Diverse Employee Resource Groups 

How to apply

  • We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
  • Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.
  • Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

 

#LI-PC1

 

A Movement for Everyone
We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Too Good To Go we are dedicated to the fight against food waste! Food waste is a huge global issue, with one-third of all food produced being wasted, a landfill is overflowing and our environment is really suffering the consequences. And it's not just about the food itself, it's all the resources that went into producing the food, the land, the water, the labour. It's a sad state of affairs and we're on a mission to inspire and empower everyone to take action! Our platform allows people to buy surplus, unsold food from restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, bakeries etc. that otherwise would have to be thrown out. Through our app, everybody can make a difference by 'saving'​ perfectly good, delicious food from going in the bin.

title: Junior Activation Manager
description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkaster og lydbøker og vi ser nå etter en Junior Activation Manager til vårt voksende norske team.

Bli med oss på reisen for å berike liv gjennom lytting.


Dette er rollen 

Som vår nye Junior Activation Manager vil du støtte planleggingen og gjennomføringen av show-aktiveringer, og jobbe tett med våre Activation Managers og det bredere kommersielle teamet.

Rollen består av å utvikle ferdighetene dine innen creator-onboarding, kampanjekoordinering og markedsføring av innhold. Du vil hjelpe med logistikk, følge opp resultater og sikre at ingen detaljer blir oversett under gjennomføringen.


Dette vil du gjøre

Kampanjestøtte og koordinering av materiell

  • Bistå med oppsett og koordinering av show-lanseringer og reaktiveringer.

  • Administrere tidslinjer og sikre at assets som cover-art, creator-bios og opptaksplaner leveres i tide.

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre show-lanseringer og synlighet i appen.

  • Ha ansvar for lokale oversettelser for egne og betalte kanaler.

  • Utarbeide interne briefinger og følge opp gjennomføringssteg gjennom hele kampanjeløpet.

  • Bistå med oppdateringer og leveranser til PR byrå

Kontaktpunkt for creators og talenter

  • Hjelpe til med onboarding av creators ved å gi sjekklister, promo-templater og svar på grunnleggende spørsmål rundt lansering.

  • Følge opp creator-leveranser og sikre at forventningene blir innfridd.

  • Vedlikeholde creator-mapper, kontrakter og annen dokumentasjon.

Samarbeid på tvers av interne team

  • Koordinere med SoMe-teamet for å levere creator- og kampanjemateriell.

  • Jobbe sammen med PR- og SR-teamene for å følge opp felles avhengigheter og leveranser.

  • Støtte Activation Managers med å forberede presentasjoner og kampanjesammendrag.

Data & Reporting Assistance

  • Følge opp kampanje-KPIer, inkludert engasjement og aktivitetsmålinger for creatorer.

  • Oppdatere ukentlige rapporter og dashboards i samarbeid med Activation Managers.

  • Identifisere tidlige trendsignaler i performance og dele dem med teamet.


Dette er deg

  • Prosjekt- og kampanjekoordinering – evne til å håndtere tidslinjer, følge opp kampanjesteg og støtte gjennomføringen av aktiveringsplaner.

  • Kommunikasjon med creators og interessenter – klare og organiserte kommunikasjonsevner for å bistå i onboarding av creators og koordinering på tvers av interne team.

  • Materiellhåndtering – ferdigheter i å organisere, velge og følge opp innholdsmateriell, spesielt for bruk i betalte kanaler.

  • Flytende norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Naturligvis er det en stor fordel å være engasjert og kunnskapsrik innen podkast, lydinnhold, media og underholdning!


Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad! Ikke nøl med å søke, da vi vurderer søknader og starter intervjuer fortløpende for å holde fremdriften før jul.


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via We.Care

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap – og se effekten av arbeidet ditt med én gang


Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen. Vi har null tid til “brilliant jerks”.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er – uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Founded in Copenhagen in 2019, Podimo is a platform for podcast and audiobook lovers as well as audio content creators. Our app puts a world of podcasts and audiobooks at your fingertips. We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings, and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for brilliant jerks. We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories. We support our creators deeply and have massive respect for their process as we help them bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it. We seek to build a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means; diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams. You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

title: Full-time Driver Lier
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD LIER DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


Would you like to join us as a full-time driver in Lier?

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to stay fueled and energized.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Assessed on an ongoing basis

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • The position is based on a rotational shift schedule (35,5h), working one weekend per month.

  • Working Hours:

    • Morning shift (start between 04:15 and 06:00)

    • Evening shift (start between 12:45 and 14:30)

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖


Due to the Christmas holiday and limited capacity, it might take slightly longer to process and respond to applications. Rest assured that all applicants will receive a response to their application.


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Technical Writer
description:
At Six Robotics, you're not just joining a company; You're joining a mission to reshape the future of autonomous systems.

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 40+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop Valkyrie, our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. We only hire the best. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.


About the Role

At Six Robotics, we believe world-class technology deserves world-class documentation. As we scale Valkyrie, our autonomous drone swarm platform, we’re making an early and intentional investment in how users understand, adopt, and succeed with our products. That’s why we’re hiring our first Technical Writer to own all product documentation. This role goes far beyond writing manuals. With help from our software team, you’ll implement a living documentation platform, combining structured guides with live data, interactive tools, and embedded testing.

Your ultimate goal is maximizing team and user efficiency by ensuring Valkyrie is clear, accessible, and reliable for mission-critical users. As the founding member of this function, you will define the standards and processes that all future hires will follow. While you do not need to be a deep-level engineer, you must have the confidence to extract and structure complex information from technical experts. Success means Valkyrie's capabilities are fully documented, structured, and easy to maintain, with all user manuals published accurately and on time with every software release.


What You’ll Do:

  • Documentation Architecture: Be the architect for all documentation and own our platform, using tools like Sphinx and custom integrations as needed.

  • Content Development: Develop and manage content enriched with live data, interactive tools, and 3D visualizations.

  • Internal Collaboration: Proactively engage with engineers and subject matter experts to gather necessary information, and never hesitate to ask clarifying questions to ensure documentation is accurate and testable.

  • Publishing Automation: Enable multi-format publishing (web, PDF, localized versions) using automation and version control for consistency and scale.

  • Strategic Foundation: Lay the groundwork for the future expansion of the documentation function, contributing to standards and processes that will enable team growth.


Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who loves the craft of technical writing and thrives on ambiguity. You know how to turn sprawling, technical complexity into clear, structured, and user-friendly documentation. As the first hire in this function, you’re excited to define standards, solve edge cases, and lay the groundwork for a scalable documentation practice.


To thrive in this role, you likely bring a combination of the following:

  • Exceptional writing skills and fluency in English.

  • A “docs as code” mindset, meaning you understand the principles of Git, version control, and automation.

  • Familiarity with dynamic documentation and integrating live data from external systems.

  • A strong sense of structure, clarity, and usability, always advocating for the end-user perspective.

  • Motivation to build something from scratch, with full ownership of both process and platform, and the vision to scale it into a function.


Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with the s1000D standard is a huge plus.

  • An understanding of scripting languages.


Why You Should Join Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

Work on problems that matter

Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

Build from zero, shape the future Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

Work with purpose, supported by great benefits You'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.


Our Recruitment Process

We aim to keep our process short and sweet, but also thorough. As a small team, every hire matters, and we can’t afford to get this one wrong.

Here’s what to expect:

  1. Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min).

  2. Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min).

  3. Structured case interview to get to know you even better (90 min).

  4. Final interview and a chance to meet with the management team (45 min).

  5. Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well


If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to the below email. We look forward to hearing from you!


Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.


Deadline for applications: Nov 29th. We evaluate candidates on a rolling basis. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. Swarm autonomy as a force multiplier.

title: Head of Commercial
description:
Vi er en av Europas raskest voksende plattformer for podkaster og lydbøker, og vi ser nå etter en Head of Commercial til vårt voksende team i Norge.


Dette er rollen

Vi ser etter en Head of Commercial som skal drive kommersiell suksess og publikumsvekst for Podimos norske innholdsportefølje – sammen med ditt kommersielle team. Dette er en sentral lederrolle i skjæringspunktet mellom markedsføring, innhold, partnerskap og forretningsresultater. Du sørger for at de riktige podkastene når riktig publikum til riktig tid, og at alle go-to-market-initiativer gir maksimal effekt på vekst, engasjement og lojalitet.

Du vil lede vårt fantastiske kommersielle team på 4 personer (og voksende!). Sammen jobber dere tett med det lokale Content-teamet og våre globale Brand- og Growth-team for å sette retning, gjennomføre og finne nye muligheter som styrker Podimos lokale relevans, rekkevidde og abonnementsvekst.

Rollen er basert på vårt nye kontor i Oslo, og noe reiseaktivitet må påregnes.


Dette vil du gjøre

  • Lede det lokale commercial/activation-teamet og samarbeide tett med Content, Creator Relations, Product og Market Director for å maksimere verdien av den norske innholdsporteføljen.

  • Eie den lokale go-to-market-planen for nye lanseringer og viktige show-øyeblikk, og gjøre innholdsprioriteringer om til kampanjeplaner som driver vekst, engasjement og lojalitet.

  • Kjøre integrerte kampanjer på tvers av CRM, SoMe, PR og Brand – slik at riktige budskap treffer riktig målgruppe til riktig tid.

  • Samarbeide med globale Growth-team (Paid & Demand Gen) for å sikre god samkjøring for vekst, og bidra med lokale innsikter som forbedrer performance.

  • Prognostisere og følge opp kommersiell effekt: bygge prognoser og vekstscenarier, definere KPI’er, rapportere resultater og initiere raskt basert på hva som fungerer.

  • Data og innsikt: bruke data som beslutningsgrunnlag og oversette data til handling

  • Identifisere og realisere nye vekstmuligheter gjennom partnerskap, distribusjonsavtaler og mediesamarbeid som styrker Podimos posisjon i Norge.

Dette er deg

  • Du har en bachelorgrad innen markedsføring, business eller et relevant fagområde, og 3–5 års relevant erfaring fra kommersielle markedsføringsroller – gjerne fra mediebransjen.

  • Du er strategisk og kommersielt drevet, og evner å koble innholdsaktivering til forretningsvekst.

  • Du har et solid fundament i performance marketing, og god forståelse for SoMe- og audience development-mekanismer.

  • Du er analytisk og datadrevet, med tydelig gjennomføringskraft og evne til å lære raskt.

  • Du har dokumentert erfaring med ledelse og teamutvikling.

  • Du har erfaring med å identifisere og drive nye kommersielle muligheter (f.eks. partnerskap, distribusjonsavtaler, mediesamarbeid og innovative vekstinitiativer).

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, og har sterke kommunikasjons- og stakeholder management-ferdigheter.


Naturligvis er det et stort pluss om du er engasjert i og kunnskapsrik på podkaster, lydinnhold, media og underholdning!

Vi gleder oss til å motta søknaden din! Ikke nøl med å søke – vi vurderer søknader og gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende for å holde tempoet oppe før jul.


Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via We.Care

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap – og se effekten av arbeidet ditt med én gang


Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere – og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på – enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen. Vi har null tid til “brilliant jerks”.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør – og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er – uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Founded in Copenhagen in 2019, Podimo is a platform for podcast and audiobook lovers as well as audio content creators. Our app puts a world of podcasts and audiobooks at your fingertips. We're a courageous and curious bunch. We recognize the value every individual brings, and respect our coworkers’ ideas, opinions, and time. We approach our work with integrity and humility and believe that we are better together. We have zero time for brilliant jerks. We’re fiercely passionate about discovering, creating, and obsessing over great stories. We support our creators deeply and have massive respect for their process as we help them bring their most exciting ideas and stories to life. We love what we do, but more importantly, we have a good time doing it. We seek to build a company and culture that mirrors the diversity of the world we’re living in. This means; diversity of talent, voices, ideas, and thoughts. That goes both for our brand, our content, our creators, and our teams. You are welcome at Podimo for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what stories you have playing in your headphones.

title: Tech Lead - Software
description:
Hey there!🌞

Do you want to contribute to a cleaner planet?

Skyfri Technologies AS is a  global and fast-growing clean technology company based in Oslo. Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production.

Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy globally and we believe that software will be the engine to achieve that goal.

What you’ll be doing

As a Technical Lead at Skyfri, you will play a pivotal role in leading and guiding a team of software engineers to deliver high-quality and innovative software solutions. You will be responsible for overseeing the technical aspects of projects, providing technical direction, and ensuring the successful execution of software development initiatives.

In this role, you will

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of software engineers.
  • Set and enforce coding standards, best practices, and development methodologies.
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  • Break down project requirements into tasks and allocate them appropriately among the team.
  • Lead the design and architecture of software solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to design principles and coding standards.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
  • Provide guidance on the selection of appropriate technologies for projects.
  • Address technical challenges and provide solutions in a timely manner.
  • Act as a point of escalation for technical issues within the team.
  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality software through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Implement and improve automated testing processes.

 

    You are…

    … Smart and ambitious, with a passion for start-ups and clean tech. You are creative, always willing to break new ground and come up with new and exciting ideas. You are open-minded, kind, and a team player who understands that we are all in this together.

    In addition, we need you to:

    • Be fluent in English, our working language.
    • Live in or in commuting distance to Oslo, Norway.
    • Have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Work experience of a similar nature may be considered in place of the specified qualifications.
    • 6+ years of experience as a software developer, with a strong background in software architecture.
    • Strong background working with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure App Service, and Azure SQL Database.
    • Proficiency in React and JavaScript.
    • Expertise in C# and .NET development for building scalable and maintainable back-end systems.
    • Familiarity with version control systems, continuous integration, and deployment pipelines.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    What we offer

    • Competitive salary and benefits package.
    • Flexible working hours with work-from-home days.
    • Interesting work within a dynamic and innovative company.
    • A central role in a company in high growth, with great opportunities for career and personal development.
    • A lot of fun in an international and diverse office environment.

     

    At Skyfri, we embrace diversity as the cornerstone of who we are. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic. We choose our candidates based only on qualifications, merit and business need.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Skyfri Technologies AS is a global and fast-growing clean technology company based in Oslo, Calgary, Singapore and Hyderabad. Our advanced proprietary technology, powered by machine learning and big data, will completely digitize the way asset owners operate their power plants, and help them improve uptime and production. Our vision is to accelerate the deployment of renewable energy globally and we believe that software will be the engine to achieve that goal.

title: Head of Technology Development
description:
About reTyre

At reTyre, we're not just another tyre company; we're revolutionising the industry. With our groundbreaking machines that can produce tyres from any material, we're setting new standards for what's possible. Imagine tyres that are biodegradable, luminescent, reflective, and more. This is not in the future; this is happening now. But that's not all; our new production technology opens up previously unimaginable opportunities.

We want you to be a part of this exciting journey. We're looking for an experienced leader with excellent talent in Project and People management. These qualities combined with R&D experience will contribute to driving our technologies and developments to the next level.


The Role

As Head of Technology Development at reTyre, you'll be at the forefront of leading the development team in innovative projects, meaning that you will own overall responsibilities of coordination, strategic planning, risk management, and ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in tyre technology.

But that's just the beginning.

Your role will extend beyond your team. You'll have the unique opportunity to work across departments, collaborating with our Commercial, Material and Manufacturing teams to take part in shaping the brand's next steps to meet and create new market demands and segments.

You'll also collaborate with technology teams from leading international brands, offering a global perspective to your teams’ work. Your involvement will span the entire development cycle—from the fuzzy front-end of ideation, through testing, designing manufacturing tools, overseeing trial production, and finally, to commercialization.

In essence, no two days will be the same. The team, will under your pristine management, pioneer new and sustainable tyre products, transforming not just how tyres look, but how the world views them. Your team’s work will be the future of the tyre industry.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and drive the team towards successful execution of development projects according to company milestones.

  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation as well as provide progress updates, gather feedback, and make necessary project adjustments.

  • Assign tasks and responsibilities, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.

  • Ensure projects adhere to relevant regulations, standards, and best practices, as well as implement quality control measures to ensure outputs meet required specifications and standards.

  • Lead the way! We are looking for an experienced people manager with a high focus on team building as well as being attentive to the individual, bringing out the best in both.

  • Leading with a culture of continuous improvement and innovation, that fosters a collaborative environment.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Project management, Engineering, Science, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in project management, with a track record of successful project delivery.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills and experience.

  • Proficient in project management tools and software.

  • Background from R&D


Personal Characteristics

  • Forward-thinking, engaged and a natural leader.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strategic and operative thinker with the ability to manage multiple complex projects at the same time, and lead a team to achieve innovative outcomes.


Why Join reTyre?

Be a Pioneer: This is an unparalleled opportunity to be the driving force of technologies that have never been seen before.

Influence: Your leadership will drive innovation and progress in our technology to set the new industry standard, impacting how tyres are made and used globally.

Career Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer tremendous opportunities for career advancement.

Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a competitive package.

Dynamic Team: Work with a team as forward-thinking and innovative as you are.


How to Apply

If you're ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime and make a global impact, send us your application, including your CV and other relevant documentation, demonstrating your relevant experience.

Applications are continuously evaluated, so apply today and redefine the future with us at reTyre.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are an award-winning tyre manufacturer focusing on innovation and sustainability and the first company in the world capable of mass-producing pneumatic tyres without the use of rubber. As pioneers in tyre manufacturing, we’re spearheading an ambitious production method that integrates cutting-edge technologies from multiple industries. As a result, our tyres have significantly lower emissions compared to conventional tyres. reTyre wants to make the lives of various vehicle users easier by sustainable tyre solutions. Above anything else, reTyre values an innovative and fearless entrepreneurial mindset. JOIN THE REVOLUTION Make A Real Difference If you have been dreaming of being part of something great – now’s your time. We’re not just another tyre company. We’re building a state-of-the-art factory with groundbreaking machines, pushing the boundaries of innovation. Our mission? Leading the charge in sustainability and innovation. We have multiple positions open in all departments of our company and we are always looking for talented people who want to be a part of our exciting growth journey and make a real difference.

title: Senior Embedded Software Developer
description:
About us

Sensio is the leading provider of care technology in the Nordics, solving today's and tomorrow's care challenges for the benefit of service recipients, healthcare professionals, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

We are on an exciting journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. With the backing of Nordic Capital, one of Europe’s top private equity firms, we’re ready to take our flagship product, RoomMate, to the world.

RoomMate is a revolutionary safety sensor that detects and reduces falls using advanced algorithms. In addition, the sensor can be used for digital supervision and passive notification in case of dangerous situations. Both hardware and software are developed in-house by the RoomMate team.


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Developer who is product-driven, takes ownership, thinks big, and makes a real impact. You’ll be at the core of our product development, working on embedded software that powers the RoomMate sensor. In addition, you’ll have the freedom to take the lead and drive innovation forward.

The position is based across two locations: RoomMate’s Sandvika office and Sensio’s central Oslo headquarters.


What you'll be doing 
  • Developing embedded software in C++.
  • Collaborating with a world-class team of engineers, designers, and product managers to define and shape RoomMate’s evolution. 
  • Mentoring and supporting others by fostering an environment of knowledge-sharing and continuous learning within the team.
  • Taking ownership of complex problems, driving solutions with autonomy.
  • Contributing to product discovery, ensuring we build the right solutions for real-world healthcare challenges.


What we're looking for 
  • Expertise in C++ with a solid background in embedded software development on Linux.
  • Ownership mindset- You anticipate challenges, take initiative, and drive solutions forward.
  • A team player- You thrive in a team environment, sharing knowledge and growing together.
  • A product-oriented thinker- You think beyond code and understand how technology impacts the end user.
  • Fluent in English (Norwegian is a plus, or a willingness to learn). 


In addition, it's nice if you have one of the following 
  • Experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing.
  • Experience in signal processing, ML, or AI.
  • Understanding of hardware development.
  • Knowledge of communication technologies such as TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, mobile, or Bluetooth.


What we offer 
  • Meaningful work with purpose – making a difference for health care personnel, patients, and next-of-kin.
  • The opportunity to be part of a Norwegian tech company with ambitions of becoming a global leader.
  • Having a big impact on the development of Sensio’s flagship product.
  • To be part of an innovative culture focused on collaboration and user-centric development.
  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Glint Solar is an Oslo-based startup accelerating the solar energy revolution. We streamline the process of finding optimal solar project locations using GIS and climate data, making renewable energy development faster and simpler.


Our Team

We are a diverse, fun-loving team with varied interests, from astrophysics to frisbee golf to DJing on the weekend. What unites us is our support for each other, a passion for solving complex problems, and a commitment to driving positive change through technology.


The Role

We seek experienced software engineers that are skilled in their craft and always keeps the big picture in mind. Software engineers are involved early from understanding the problems customers face, prioritization and how to best solve them, together with design and product. We don't have separate front-end, back-end or infrastructure teams, everyone is "full-stack", but it's ok to have a preference. Day to day you will be working with React, Node and Python. We use AWS as our infrastructure provider. Our product is heavily centered around maps, and we use Mapbox as our map provider.

Our product team is on-site in Oslo so for this role we expect you to come in to the office as a rule. That said, we offer flexibility around working remotely when needed.


What we offer

  • A committed team of ambitious and motivated colleagues.

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing startup with global reach.

  • Participation in our option scheme.

  • Lots of laughter.


Location: Oslo, Norway  For more information about working at Glint Solar, you can have a look at our website: https://www.glintsolar.com/careers

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Glint Solar is accelerating the adoption of solar energy by building the world's leading solar screening and analysis software. One of the main headaches for the development of large scale solar is identifying where to build and understanding the specific site conditions - we're tackling this! The world needs to build more renewable energy to combat climate change. We in Glint Solar believe that technology is the solution. We are therefore working effortlessly on building technology for developers of solar energy parks. We started with the very exciting floating solar market as this is one of the fastest growing energy sectors in the world and have since expanded into land based solar as well. We're backed by leading Norwegian and international VCs and private equity. Our HQ is at Mesh Nationaltheatret in Oslo where our international team works from, but we serve our global customer base with a focus on Europe. Some of our interesting customers include TotalEnergies, Alight and Statkraft. We have the culture of a startup with a flat hierarchy, where the idea matters, not who had it. We encourage trying new things, even if it fails. At Glint Solar you will have the freedom to do your best work – and focus your efforts on what *you* are good at. We believe in adapting to our people and their strengths – not the other way around. We back each other up, make sure obstacles are out of the way, and then we GO! And sometimes, quite often, actually, we go do something fun together, like cabin trips, company trips and social events. All with lots of laughter. We consider ourselves very privileged to have smart, curious, and caring colleagues who are working together towards our mission. We are comprised of 23 different people with nine different nationalities and a wide range of diversity of thought. Amongst us you’ll find coffee connoisseurs, map nerds, Mandarin speakers, yoga enthusiasts, foodies, cross-country skiiers, olive farmers, frisbee golfers, colleagues who DJ on the weekend and everything in between – because we value exactly who YOU are. Regardless of what you enjoy and value outside of work, there’s a place for you in Glint Solar.

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
About Sensio

Sensio is a Nordic leader in the health care technology sector and solves todays’ and tomorrows’ elderly care challenges for the benefit of residents, patients, healthcare personnel, and society. We create sensors, systems, and platforms that radically improve the quality and efficiency of health care – leading the sector to embrace technology and provide #MoreTimeForCare.

Sensio is on a journey from being the leading tech company in Scandinavia in the elderly care space to becoming a trusted transformation partner across Europe. In 2024, we were acquired by Nordic Capital, one of Europe’s top private equity companies. Sensio has one of the leading in-house product development organizations in Norway with about 80 product people - in total we are a team of 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK, and Germany.

Read more about Sensio and our products here.


About the role

At Sensio, we’re transforming elderly care through innovative technology. Our platform, Sensio 365, brings together sensors, systems, and health data to empower caregivers and improve quality of life.

In this role, you’ll be part of the team that tackles complex architectural challenges, helping shape a platform that is scalable, reliable, and maintainable. You’ll work with .NET, C#, and Azure to design and implement robust services, ensuring high technical standards while delivering real value to users.


What you’ll do

  • Help design, develop and scale the platform that connects several complex systems.

  • Develop with .NET and C#. We also use Azure.

  • Understand how to create customer value and enforce architectural quality.

  • Mentor junior developers and foster knowledge sharing across the team.


Who you are

  • A pragmatic, sociable senior technologist. We are seeking a technical, collaborative, and culturally attuned individual to join a high-ownership team.

  • Strong experience in architecture, ideally within distributed or monolithic-to-service migration contexts.

  • Solid background in .NET, C#, Azure, and a good understanding of system resilience, uptime SLAs/SLIs/SLOs.

  • You are open to exploring how emerging technologies can enhance system reliability, efficiency, and long-term value creation.


Experience & background

  • Ideally, 5–10+ years in software development roles. Consulting experience is a bonus.

  • Formal education is welcome, but demonstrable experience is key.

  • Fluency in English.


Why join Sensio?

  • Influence foundational architecture in a scaling, purpose-driven platform.

  • Be part of a scale-up with societal impact: we help caregivers spend more time with people, less time with systems. Collaborate with an experienced, passionate team, plus product and design partners.

  • We offer hybrid flexibility, a modern office, competitive compensation, and strong opportunities for professional growth.
