title: VP of Engineering
description:
Location: Oslo, Norway

Type: Full-time

Start date: As soon as possible


About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 50+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop Valkyrie, our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. We only hire the best. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.


About the Role

We are hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the day-to-day operation and scaling of our engineering organization. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will take end-to-end ownership of execution cadence and delivery predictability, people leadership, and engineering hiring, while ensuring a healthy, high-performing organization.

As Six Robotics grows in size, complexity, and delivery pressure, this role is designed to take full ownership of engineering operations and talent leadership, enabling the CTO to focus on technical direction, architecture, and long-term technology strategy.

Success in this role means clear priorities, reliable delivery, and strong leadership across the engineering organization. Hiring scales without lowering the bar, teams stay aligned on what we are building and why, and leadership has clear visibility into delivery status, risks, and capacity.


What You Will Do

  • Build and lead the engineering organization Take full ownership of people leadership across all levels, with a clear focus on leadership development, performance management, and culture. Build a high-performing, resilient organization, handle difficult conversations with confidence, and reinforce the standards set by the CTO.

  • Scale the engineering team Own hiring quality and tempo as the organization scales. Identify and attract top talent, keep the bar high as volume increases, and ensure the engineering organization continues to grow with strong leadership and professionalism.

  • Own and shape the engineering execution Set the operating cadence for engineering, ensuring clear planning, predictable delivery, and strong coordination across teams as complexity and pressure increase.

  • Introduce a structure that enables speed Design and embed pragmatic processes (e.g. OKRs) that create clarity, alignment, and accountability without slowing down execution.

  • Partner closely with the CTO and leadership team Report directly to the CTO as a trusted sparring partner. Provide clear visibility into delivery status, risks, and capacity, and challenge constructively when needed.


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a VP of Engineering who thrives in environments where responsibility is real, expectations are high, and delivery matters. You are a structured and resilient leader who can run engineering across all levels, take full ownership of outcomes, and bring clarity under pressure.

You are a strong people leader who is comfortable leading through others, handling difficult conversations, and making tough calls when needed. While you do not need to be hands-on with coding, you bring sufficient technical depth to be credible with strong engineers and to make sound trade-offs in software-heavy environments.

Reporting directly to the CTO, you operate as a close partner: aligned, trusted, and willing to challenge constructively to ensure the organization stays focused on what we are building, when, and why.


We Believe The Right Candidate Brings

  • 8–10+ years of engineering leadership experience in scaling environments, with end-to-end accountability for delivery and people outcomes, including leading through managers.

  • Strong people leadership, including leadership development, performance management, and handling difficult conversations with confidence.

  • High standards for execution: predictable cadence, strong ownership, and pragmatic governance that enables speed.

  • Excellent technical communications skills.

  • Ability to structure and effectively keep leadership informed on Engineering status.

  • Sound technical judgment and sufficient depth to be credible with strong engineers in software-heavy environments, without needing to be hands-on with coding.

  • Fluency in English.

  • A relevant degree in engineering or natural sciences, or equivalent experience.


Nice-To-Haves

It would also be a strong plus if you have experience from top-tier consulting or advisory environments, proven experience building and/or scaling engineering organizations to 200+ people, and leadership experience from deep-tech companies.


Why Join Six Robotics

  • Build systems that matter Your work will be deployed in the field, trusted by operators, and critical to national defence.

  • Shape the future of scalable, robotic defence We’re shifting unmanned systems from pre-programmed drones to intelligent, collaborative autonomy.

  • Work where thinking and action meet We believe great engineering happens when people are given responsibility, trust, and room to move. Your ideas will shape the direction of our technology and our company.

  • Join a team that thrives under pressure We move from lab to deployment quickly, adapting as conditions change to ensure our systems deliver when it matters.

  • Work with purpose, supported by great benefits We offer competitive pay, equity opportunities, strong benefits, and a mission-driven environment built on clarity, integrity, and collaboration.


Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.


Security Clearance

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance (Sikkerhetsklarering) due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. Prior clearance is not required; the process begins as part of onboarding. Eligibility is limited to candidates holding citizenship from NATO member countries. Due to the nature of this role, we can only consider candidates who hold Norwegian citizenship.

Please note that due to the holiday period, applications will be processed from early January. You are welcome to apply in the meantime, and we will review applications on our return.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

title: Vil du være med og bygge salget i en norsk industritech-startup?
description:
RoboConnect søker en ambisiøs B2B-selger som vil være med fra tidlig fase og ta en sentral rolle i å bygge selskapets kommersielle side.

Vi utvikler en digital plattform som skal gjøre det enklere for industribedrifter å avklare automatiseringsbehov og finne riktige systemintegratorer og teknologileverandører.

Vi starter i Norge og Sverige, men ambisjonen er større: RoboConnect skal bygges for et internasjonalt marked.

Derfor ser vi ikke bare etter noen som ønsker seg en ny salgsjobb. Vi ser etter en person med høyt driv, store mål og et sterkt ønske om å skape resultater og utvikle seg sammen med selskapet.


Ambisjon og driv betyr mer enn en lang CV

Du trenger ikke ti års erfaring eller en perfekt CV.

Vi er mer opptatt av hvor raskt du lærer, hvor mye initiativ du tar, hvordan du håndterer motgang og hvor sterkt du ønsker å lykkes.

Vi ser etter en person som er sulten på fremgang, ansvar og læring. En som setter høye mål for seg selv, oppsøker muligheter og ikke trenger en ferdig oppskrift for å komme i gang.

I en tidlig startup er mye fortsatt under utvikling. Det betyr større usikkerhet, men også langt større mulighet til å påvirke. Du kommer inn tidlig, får tett kontakt med produkt, kunder og strategi, og kan få ansvar langt raskere enn i en mer etablert organisasjon.


Rollen

Du vil være med på å bygge opp det direkte B2B-salget mot industribedrifter, systemintegratorer og andre relevante aktører innen industriell automasjon.

I starten handler mye om å være hands-on i markedet: kontakte potensielle kunder, forstå hva som faktisk skaper interesse, lære av responsen og kontinuerlig forbedre hvem vi kontakter, hvordan vi kommuniserer og hva vi tilbyr.

Arbeidet vil blant annet innebære å:

  • identifisere og kontakte relevante potensielle kunder

  • drive aktivt B2B-salg gjennom telefon, e-post, LinkedIn og møter

  • forstå kundenes utfordringer og avdekke hvor RoboConnect kan skape verdi

  • presentere RoboConnect og følge potensielle kunder systematisk fra første kontakt til neste kommersielle steg

  • bygge og følge opp en strukturert salgspipeline

  • teste og forbedre salgsbudskap, målgrupper og kommersielle tilbud

  • hente innsikt direkte fra markedet og bruke den til å forbedre både salgsmodell og produkt

  • samarbeide tett med founder om kommersiell retning og prioriteringer

  • bidra til å utvikle en salgsmodell som etter hvert kan skaleres i Norge og internasjonalt

Dette er ikke en rolle der du kommer inn i en ferdig salgsorganisasjon med etablerte prosesser og en ferdig pipeline.

Du skal være med på å bygge den.


Hvem vi ser etter

Vi tror du vil passe godt dersom du:

  • har høye ambisjoner og sterk indre motivasjon

  • er sulten på resultater og personlig utvikling

  • lærer raskt og aktivt oppsøker ny kunnskap

  • tar initiativ og skaper fremdrift på egen hånd

  • tåler at ikke alt fungerer på første forsøk

  • liker ansvar og ønsker å påvirke, ikke bare utføre

  • er komfortabel med å kontakte nye kunder på eget initiativ

  • arbeider strukturert med pipeline og oppfølging

  • raskt setter deg inn i nye digitale verktøy

  • ønsker å bli målt på faktiske resultater

Relevant erfaring kan være B2B-salg, forretningsutvikling, teknisk salg eller andre kommersielle roller.

Erfaring fra industri, industriell automasjon, robotikk, systemintegrasjon eller teknisk løsningssalg er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav.

Du må kunne kommunisere flytende på norsk eller svensk, både muntlig og skriftlig.


Hva du får igjen

RoboConnect er fortsatt tidlig. For den rette personen betyr det en mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor mye fortsatt kan påvirkes.

Du får mulighet til å:

  • få stort ansvar tidlig

  • påvirke hvordan salget og den kommersielle modellen bygges

  • arbeide tett med founder og være nær viktige beslutninger

  • lære på tvers av salg, forretningsutvikling, produkt, AI, industri og selskapsbygging

  • bygge dokumenterbare resultater fra et svært tidlig stadium

  • vokse inn i et større kommersielt ansvar dersom RoboConnect vokser

For kandidaten som skaper resultater og tar et stadig større ansvar, vil det være mulig å opparbeide eierandel i RoboConnect etter forhåndsavtalte milepæler.


Praktisk om rollen

Omfang: 50–100 %, minimum 50 %.

Vi ser etter en person som kan prioritere RoboConnect høyt og legge betydelig tid og energi i rollen. Dette passer derfor ikke som et lite sideprosjekt med noen få timer tilgjengelig i uken.

Arbeidssted er fleksibelt/remote i Norge eller Sverige. Det er ikke nødvendig å bo i Molde. Rollen innebærer hovedsakelig kontakt med norske industribedrifter gjennom telefon, digitale møter og fysisk kundekontakt. Deltakelse på relevante messer og konferanser og noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes.

Kompensasjon Lønnen er i første fase 100 % resultatbasert uten grunnlønn, med provisjon knyttet til inntekter du selv bidrar til å skape. For kandidaten som skaper resultater og tar økende ansvar, vil det også være mulig å opparbeide eierandel i RoboConnect etter forhåndsavtalte milepæler.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. With a background in research, data analysis and complex problem structuring, combined with further training in programming, databases and AI, I founded RoboConnect to bridge the gap between industrial process knowledge and automation delivery.

title: Renholdsleder / Housekeeping Manager
description:
Vil du lede teamet som sørger for at kvalitet oppleves i hver detalj?

Renhold hos oss handler om kvalitet, omtanke og stolthet i møte med gjestene.

Nå søker vi en engasjert og strukturert renholdsleder som vil lede og utvikle en av hotellets viktigste avdelinger.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Har erfaring fra hotell, housekeeping eller renhold

  • Har ledererfaring eller et sterkt ønske om å utvikle deg som leder

  • Er strukturert, løsningsorientert og god til å planlegge

  • Har høye krav til kvalitet og øye for detaljer

  • Er tydelig, trygg og positiv i møte med medarbeidere

  • Skaper engasjement og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Trives med ansvar og motiveres av å oppnå resultater gjennom andre

  • Behersker norsk eller et skandinavisk språk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Har gode digitale ferdigheter

Det er en fordel dersom du har

  • Erfaring fra hotellbransjen

  • Erfaring med turnus- og bemanningsplanlegging

  • Fagbrev innen renhold eller annen relevant utdanning

  • Kjennskap til HMS-arbeid og kvalitetssystemer

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Daglig ledelse av renholdsavdelingen

  • Planlegging av bemanning og arbeidsfordeling

  • Oppfølging, opplæring og utvikling av medarbeidere

  • Sikre høy kvalitet på hotellrom, fellesarealer, møterom og øvrige gjesteområder

  • Kvalitetskontroller og inspeksjoner

  • Ansvar for bestilling og lagerstyring av renholdsartikler og utstyr

  • Oppfølging av HMS, rutiner og internkontroll

  • Tett samarbeid med resepsjon, restaurant, teknisk avdeling og øvrige ledere

  • Bidra til utvikling av effektive arbeidsmetoder og god ressursutnyttelse

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oppfølging av ansatte

Vi tilbyr

  • En sentral lederrolle ved et av Norges mest tradisjonsrike hotell

  • Mulighet til å påvirke og videreutvikle egen avdeling

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og engasjerte kolleger

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Personalfordeler ved hotellet

  • En arbeidsplass med høye ambisjoner, sterke verdier og fokus på mennesker

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sundvolden Hotel er et av Norges eldste hotell, med historie tilbake til 1648. Beliggende ved Tyrifjorden, kun en kort kjøretur fra Oslo, kombinerer vi moderne hotell- og konferansedrift med stolte tradisjoner og ekte vertskap. Hvert år ønsker vi titusenvis av gjester velkommen til kurs, konferanser, selskaper, restaurantopplevelser og hotellopphold. Hos oss blir du en del av et engasjert team som hver dag jobber for å skape opplevelser som gjør at vi blir elsket av våre gjester og beundret av våre konkurrenter!

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow (2 years) at the Department of Clinical Dentistry
description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPostdoctoral Research Fellow position

At the Faculty of Medicine, Department of Clinical Dentistry, a full-time temporary position as postdoctoral research fellow is available for a period of two (2) years. The position can be extended for one (1) additional year, and it is part of the project ”TuniScaff”, financed by The Research Council of Norway, RCN.


About the project/work tasks:

The position is allocated to tasks aimed at validating an innovative, 3D-bioprintedand tissue-specific scaffold for bone regeneration. Novel synthetic polymer scaffolds will be fabricated and functionalized with ultra-pure nanocellulose, bioresorbable ceramics, and/or mesenchymal stem cells to provide complementary regenerative functions.

The specific objectives of the project are to:

  • Fabricate and validate 3D-bioprinted polymer scaffolds with appropriate structural and physicochemical properties for bone regeneration
  • Develop, characterize, and validate a biodegradable ultra-pure nanocellulose for incorporation into tissue-engineered bone constructs
  • Evaluate the in vitro safety and regenerative potential of the developed materials, with particular emphasis on osteogenic and angiogenic responses
  • Evaluate the in vivo safety and regenerative efficacy of the developed materials, with particular emphasis on bone formation and vascularization

Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a Norwegian PhD or an equivalent degree within regenerative medicine and dentistry or have the doctoral thesis submitted prior to the application deadline. It is a condition of employment that the PhD has been awarded at the latest within 5 months after the closing date for applications
  • Experience from relevant research projects will be considered as positive and favoured 
  • Applicants with experience in 3D printing, bioprinting and culturing of mesenchymal stem cells is highly preferable
  • Experience in material characterization, computational engineering, programming and computer aided design will be prioritized
  • Work independently and in a structured manner, and have the ability to cooperate with others

  • The applicant must be fluent in oral and written English

    The applicant’s personal suitability for the position is a significant factor in the evaluation.


About the position of postdoctoral research fellow:

The position of postdoctoral research fellow is a fixed-term appointment with the primary objective of qualifying the appointee for work in top academic positions. You cannot be employed as a postdoctoral fellow for more than one fixed term period at the same institution. 

The employee may be assigned required duties in the form of teaching and similar work at the department.


We can offer:
  • Exciting development opportunities as part of your role in a strong professional environment
  • Salary NOK 690 000 (code 1352) in the state salary scale. For applicants with a degree in Medicine or Dentistry, salary NOK 700 000. For applicants with a medical specialization, salary NOK 725 000 (Applicants with specialist training must include a certificate of specialist approval from the Norwegian Directorate of Health).
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Your application must include:
  • the position 
  • Transcripts and diplomas (applicants with education from other countries than Norway must enclose witnessed diplomas in both the original language and authorized translations) and documentation of submitted doctoral thesis
  • Complete list of publications 
  • Publications (in PDF) it is important that each of the scholarly works on which the committee should place special emphasis, is attached in its entirety
  • Two references (name and contact information)

General information:

For further information please contact Professor Kamal Mustafa, e-mail: kamal.mustafa@uib.no or phone: +47 55 58 60 97. 

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. University of Bergen therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and age.

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds, or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favorable consideration. We ensure that at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups is invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity.

title: Miljøterapeut
description:
Noen ganger havner familier med barn og ungdom i situasjoner der hverdagen floker seg, og foreldreskapet ikke fungerer optimalt. Da trengs det trygge voksne som kan gå inn med støtte, veiledning og samtaler for å snu en negativ utvikling før barnevernet må involveres ytterligere.

I Humana omsorg og assistanse tror vi på at alle har rett til et godt liv. Ja, alle. Som tiltaksperson hos oss blir du en helt avgjørende brikke i dette samfunnsoppdraget. Dette er en oppdragsbasert stilling der de fleste oppdragene foregår på ettermiddager eller i helger. Det betyr at du får en fleksibel og selvstendig arbeidshverdag som enkelt kan kombineres med en annen jobb.

Vi søker nå etter miljøterapeuter/miljøarbeider med erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge til Tromsø.

Hva går jobben ut på?

I denne rollen møter du familier fra alle lag av befolkningen, alle med unike historier og utfordringer. Din oppgave blir å møte de unge og foreldrene deres gjennom målrettede samtaler, tilsyn og veiledning. Du bidrar til å gi familiene verktøy til å håndtere konflikter og finne bedre mestringsstrategier i en utfordrende hverdag. Vi kan love deg meningsfylte og varierte oppdrag – både faglig og menneskelig.

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som møter mennesker med engasjement, ansvar og glede. Du har utdanning som barnevernspedagog, sosionom, eller annen relevant bakgrunn innen helse- og omsorg.

Du har solid erfaring med konfliktløsning og arbeid rettet mot barn, unge og familier. Har du i tillegg sertifisering eller erfaring med metodikk som COS eller TBO, er det midt i blinken for oss. Det viktigste er at du har et genuint ønske om å se at arbeidet ditt faktisk bedrer livssituasjonen til dem du møter.

Hvorfor bli en del av vårt lag?

Når du tar på deg oppdrag for Humana omsorg og assistanse, blir du en del av en av Norges største private aktører innen omsorg og assistanse. Vi tilbyr:

  • Tryggheten ved å være tilknyttet en stor organisasjon med tariffavtale, gjennomarbeidede HMS-rutiner og egen intern HR-avdeling.

  • Et romslig arbeidsmiljø som verdsetter nytenking, og hvor du kan bruke kompetansen din helt målrettet.

  • Tilgang til et omfattende fordelsprogram.

Vil du vite mer om stillingen?

Ta gjerne kontakt med oss for en uformell prat! Du kan kontakte Anna Duedahl på telefon 948 48 327.

title: Research Fellow – gene editing and cell-based therapy
description:
About the position 

We invite applications for a 6‑month position in our project on cell-based therapy for inherited bleeding disorders. 

The position is part of an ongoing project funded by the Norwegian Research Council and affiliated with the Institute of Clinical Medicine, Division of Cancer Medicine, University of Oslo, with daily work based at Oslo University Hospital, Rikshospitalet. 

The research group has long-standing expertise in basic, translational and clinical research on blood coagulation factors and their role in disease. 


More about the position 

The project focuses on inherited factor VII (FVII) deficiency, a rare but serious bleeding disorder caused by mutations in the F7 gene, leading to markedly reduced FVII activity, and applies advanced technologies such as  CRISPR-based gene editing, induced pluripotent stem cells and liver organoids to rescue the FVII expression in patient-derived cells.

The position will support continued experimental work and data analysis within in vivo pre-clinical studies, which form an important foundation for future cell-based therapies in patients with FVII deficiency. 

The research fellow is expected to contribute actively to experimental design, execution and troubleshooting, as well as to the interpretation and reporting of results. 


Qualifications 

Qualification requirements

  • MSc (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline (e.g. medicine, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology or similar). 
  • Demonstrated ability to design, plan and execute in vitro and in vivo experiments. 
  • Formal accreditation for work with animal models (e.g. FELASA C or equivalent) AND experience with mouse surgery and xenotransplant. 
  • Experience with stem cell work and stem cell-derived 3D hepatic organoid differentiation. 
  • Proficiency in English, both written and oral. 

Persoonal skills

  • We are looking for a candidate who is: 
  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic about translational research 
  • Organized, structured and able to work independently 
  • Flexible 
  • A team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • An exciting research environment with opportunities for academic development. 
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 

  • Salary in position as researcher, position code 1108  in salary range NOK 565 000 to 595 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

     

    Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates

  • Contact information for 2-3 references

     

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

  • Maria Eugenia Chollet Dugarte – e‑mail: m.e.c.dugarte@ous-research.no

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. title: Wychowawca (K/M)
description:
Zakres obowiązków: - Wychowawca sprawuje opiekę nad maksymalnie 14 dziećmi w wieku od 10 do 18 lat. Bezpośrednio odpowiada za
około 2 lub 3 dzieci – wobec nich pełni rolę niejako rodzicielską.
- Praca wychowawcy jest pracą celową – skupia się na znalezieniu stałych rozwiązań dla dziecka. Może pracować nad
tym aby (jeśli to możliwe) dziecko wróciło do swojej rodziny biologicznej, rodziny spokrewnionej bądź rodziny
zastępczej niespokrewnionej lub adopcyjnej. Jeśli dziecko nie ma szans na powyższe rozwiązania, wychowawca
w swoich działaniach skupia się na jak najlepszym przygotowaniu go do usamodzielnienia.
- W placówkach w zasadzie nie ma pracowników obsługi, co oznacza że wychowankowie sami robią zakupy i inne
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: - wykształcenie wyższe (min. studia I stopnia- licencjat):
a) na kierunku pedagogika, pedagogika specjalna, psychologia, praca socjalna, nauki o rodzinie lub na innym
kierunku, którego program obejmuje resocjalizację, pracę socjalną, pedagogikę opiekuńczo-wychowawczą, albo
b) na dowolnym kierunku, uzupełnione studiami podyplomowymi w zakresie psychologii, pedagogiki, nauk
o rodzinie lub resocjalizac

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Comfortable handling sensitive content professionally and consistently
Previous experience in content moderation, social media, or customer support is a plus
Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
Empathetic, professional, and resilient under pressure
Team player with a proactive and adaptable attitude

The Offer
Full-time, on-site position in Lisbon
Flights to Lisbon covered
Option to live in one of Teleperformance’s fully equipped, shared apartments, located 20–60 minutes from the workplace
Guidance and support throughout the relocation process
Paid professional training and structured onboarding
Health insurance and meal allowances from day one
Career growth and development opportunities in an international, multicultural environment

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

Garantir a manutenção de espaços limpos, higienizados e organizados, assegurando simultaneamente um acompanhamento próximo e humanizado dos utentes, contribuindo para o seu bem-estar, segurança, dignidade e autonomia.

title: OPERADOR DE MÁQUINAS DE COSTURA
description:
Profissional com experiência na área da confeção e costura, com capacidade para executar diferentes tipos de trabalhos de acordo com moldes, fichas técnicas e especificações definidas.

Possui conhecimentos e experiência na utilização de máquinas de ponto corrido e corte e cose (overloque), realizando a confeção, montagem e acabamento de peças de vestuário e outros artigos têxteis. Tem conhecimentos de corte de tecidos, preparação das peças, montagem, costura e acabamentos.

É capaz de executar operações de costura em ponto corrido, bem como trabalhos de corte e cose, assegurando a correta união e acabamento das diferentes partes das peças. Demonstra facilidade na adaptação a diferentes tipos de tecidos, modelos e métodos de confeção.

É responsável pela preparação dos materiais, corte dos tecidos, montagem das peças, execução das costuras e respetivos acabamentos, bem como pela verificação da qualidade do produto final e correção de eventuais defeitos.

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

title: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms (Informatiker/in)
description:
Together, we make the difference

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for IT/OT Security Platforms, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

What part will you play?

- You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).- You develop and operate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.- You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.- You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.- You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.- You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.- You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.- You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

What you bring to the table

- You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.- You possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3+ years of experience).- Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.- Proven hands-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2+ years of experience).- You have experience with AI-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics-driven operational improvements. - You bring hands-on experience in OpenZiti Development (optional) and API Integration (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1+ years of experience).- You have a solid understanding of OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine-to-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.- You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (at least 1+ year of experience).- You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.- You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. title: MUNCITOR NECALIFICAT LA ASAMBLAREA, MONTAREA PIESELOR

description: Servește și consiliază clienții, prezintă produsele și oferă informații privind sortimentele, ingredientele și prețurile. title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.

•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
