Du bygger broar genom relationer, samarbete och förtroende. Du äger genom att fatta beslut med företagets bästa i åtanke, sätta tydliga mål och hålla dig själv och andra ansvariga för att uppnå resultat. Du visar vägen med vision och syfte, och utvecklar potential genom att maximera individuella styrkor för att hjälpa andra att nå sin fulla potential.

Bonuspoäng för:

    

Erfarenhet från utbildning inom gastronomi och restaurang, formell utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet från kök.

    

Flexibel och pålitlig med entusiasm kring mat och kundservice.

    

Bekväm med multitasking och självständigt beslutsfattande.

    

Bra på att vända utmaningar till möjligheter, växla mellan flera arbetsuppgifter samtidigt och hålla hög standard på arbetet, även när det dyker upp utmaningar och svårigheter.

    

Det är meriterande med erfarenhet från namnkunniga restauranger med liknande koncept och storlek.

    

Inom Strawberry värdesätter vi mångfald. Olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och idéer skapar en unik och inspirerande arbetsmiljö.

title: President Machining, Sandvik Group
description:
We are looking for an exceptional business leader to join us as President of business area Machining at Sandvik. As President, you lead one of the world's most respected industrial businesses and play a pivotal role in delivering Sandvik's Advancing to 2030 strategy through growth, innovation, digitalization and operational excellence.

‍Business area Machining is the global leading manufacturer of tools and tooling systems for advanced industrial metal cutting, as well as metal powder. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 44 billion with about 18,700 employees. Our portfolio includes market leading brands like Sandvik Coromant, Seco, Walter and Dormer Pramet. Together, these businesses combine industry-leading technology, deep application expertise and strong customer partnerships to help manufacturers improve productivity, efficiency and sustainability.

About the job

With overall responsibility for the business, you set the direction and lead the execution of business area Machining's strategy and performance agenda. Machining consists of a portfolio of leading divisions and businesses, each with its own market position, strategy and profit and loss responsibility. A key part of your role is to foster and strengthen Sandvik's decentralized model, empowering division presidents and leadership teams to drive performance, innovation and customer success while ensuring alignment with the overall strategic direction of business area Machining and Sandvik Group.

You are accountable for sustainable growth, profitability, innovation and customer success across the portfolio. Through strong leadership, disciplined execution and active portfolio management, you identify new growth opportunities, strengthen market positions and ensure that business area Machining remains at the forefront of manufacturing transformation.

As a member of Sandvik Group Executive Management, you work closely with colleagues across the Group to ensure long-term value creation for customers, shareholders and society. You report to the President and CEO of Sandvik Group.

Job responsibilities

    Drive profitable growth and strengthen market leadership across the portfolio.
    Accelerate digitalization, AI adoption and innovation initiatives.
    Develop and support strong division leadership teams with accountability for strategy execution and business performance.
    Foster an entrepreneurial and decentralized culture where decisions are made close to customers and markets.
    Deliver operational excellence and cost competitiveness while advancing sustainability and responsible business practices.
    Identify and execute acquisitions and other opportunities that support long-term growth and value creation.

Location

The position is based in Stockholm. International travel is an integral part of the position.

Your profile

You are a proven global business leader with a strong track record of delivering growth, transformation and financial performance in complex international environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational excellence and are comfortable leading through change in a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by technology, automation, AI and sustainability.

You bring:

    Extensive senior leadership experience with full P&L responsibility.
    Success in driving business growth, transformation and strategy execution.
    Experience from industrial, manufacturing and/or technology-intensive businesses.
    Strong commercial acumen and customer orientation, combined with a strong understanding of advanced technologies.
    Experience leading large, global and decentralized organizations through empowered leadership teams.
    Strong ability to set the strategic direction and inspire, develop and lead high-performing leaders and teams.
    Strong ability to simplify complexity.
    Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

It’s also meriting if you have prior experience engaging with boards of directors, investors, media and other external stakeholders.

Your leadership

You’re an authentic and inspiring leader who creates clarity, accountability and engagement. You believe that the best results are achieved through empowered teams, strong local ownership and clear accountability. You lead in accordance with Sandvik's core values of Winning Together, Curiosity, Responsibility and Customer Focus, building a culture where people, innovation and business performance thrive, along with maintaining the highest standards in safety, sustainability and business ethics.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  

Application & Contact information

In this recruitment, Sandvik Group is cooperating with Alumni Global. Please use the application link provided to send us your application (CV only required). Apply as soon as possible and no later than September 27th, 2026.

For questions about this position, please contact Karin Hagelborn, Partner and Consultant at Alumni Global.

Sandvik is a global, industrial technology group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. title: Project Leader Academy
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Project Leader Academy



Drive the future of learning and competence development across Northern Europe



Join us as we accelerate the transformation. Together.







Do you thrive on turning ideas into reality? Are you passionate about learning, development, and creating solutions that make a real business impact? As Project Leader Academy for Northern Europe, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering innovative training solutions that support our customers, employees, and business growth.



This is an exciting opportunity to combine project leadership, stakeholder management, and training development in a dynamic international environment where your work will directly contribute to building competence and accelerating performance.







Join our team



The Regional Academy team is responsible for developing and delivering training solutions that support Epiroc's customers and employees across Northern Europe. We work closely with colleagues from Sales, Service, Product Divisions, Product Specialists, and trainers to ensure that the right competence is available to meet current and future business needs.



As Project Leader Academy , you will be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team dedicated to continuous learning and development. Together, we identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions, and create value through knowledge and competence.







Your mission



In this role, you will drive Academy development initiatives and training projects from identified need through implementation and operational handover. You will translate business priorities, customer needs, competence gaps, and new technologies into scalable and commercially viable training solutions.







Your responsibilities include:




    Developing and implementing new and improved training solutions based on customer and business needs.
    Leading complex customer training projects involving multiple stakeholders, products, sites, or countries.
    Coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring clear project scope, ownership, timelines, and expected outcomes.
    Driving project execution, managing risks, and ensuring successful implementation and business value realization.
    Collaborating with trainers, product specialists, product divisions, sales, and service teams to create sustainable learning solutions.
    Identifying opportunities to standardize and scale successful training concepts across the region.



Safety is a fundamental priority in all activities and an integral part of every project and initiative.







Location and other



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden.



We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.



Occasional travel is required.







Why Epiroc?



By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.







Application and contact information



We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than September 24 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.







We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.







Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.







We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries.





Profile description:

Your profile



You are a proactive and structured professional who enjoys driving initiatives forward and bringing people together around a common goal. With strong communication and stakeholder management skills, you can navigate complex environments and create engagement across functions and countries.







To succeed in this role, you likely have:




    Experience leading projects involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration.
    A strong ability to plan, coordinate, and drive initiatives from concept to implementation.
    Experience within training, learning and development, competence management, or a related field.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
    A business-oriented mindset with the ability to identify value-creating and scalable solutions.
    Fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.







Experience from the mining, construction, industrial, or technical sectors is considered an advantage.

title: Cloud Workspace Engineer
description:
HAYPP GROUP

We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.

Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.



THE ROLE

At Haypp Group, we’re evolving our IT environment to be smarter, faster, and more secure across multiple cloud platforms. We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer with strong IAM knowledge to help us build, manage, and improve secure cloud solutions across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.

This role is ideal for someone who combines solid cloud engineering experience with a strong understanding of Identity and Access Management, federation, and cloud security. You will play a key role in strengthening our multicloud environment, improving secure access across platforms, and helping us build scalable and future-ready ways of working.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

As a Cloud Engineer at Haypp Group, you will work hands-on with our cloud platforms and identity landscape. You will:

    Design, build, and maintain secure cloud solutions across Azure, AWS, and GCP
    Strengthen our IAM and identity provider strategy, especially around integrating Entra ID with AWS and GCP for SSO, MFA, and unified access
    Implement and improve identity federation, access governance, and role-based / least-privilege access models across cloud platforms
    Manage and improve access for users, groups, applications, and workloads across internal and third-party services
    Drive cloud and IT projects that improve scalability, compliance, resilience, and security
    Automate repetitive tasks and cloud workflows using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or similar
    Partner with internal stakeholders to integrate new SaaS applications and cloud services with secure authentication and access controls
    Maintain and improve documentation, operational routines, troubleshooting guides, and disaster recovery playbooks
    Monitor cloud environments, support audits, and help implement best practices for security, compliance, and operational excellence

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We’re looking for someone with strong hands-on cloud engineering experience and a clear understanding of IAM in modern cloud environments. We believe you have experience with:

    Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform, ideally with solid exposure to at least two of them
    IAM, SSO, MFA, and federation across cloud platforms
    Entra ID / Azure AD, AWS IAM, and ideally Google Cloud IAM
    Identity and authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect
    Integrating cloud platforms and SaaS applications with central identity providers
    Scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, and operational improvements
    Working with cloud security principles such as least privilege, conditional access, and Zero Trust
    Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

    Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools
    Workload identity and service-to-service authentication
    IT service management and asset management in multicloud environments
    Compliance or security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, NIS2, or DORA
    Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SharePoint, or similar workplace platforms
    Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, GCP, or Microsoft 365

Examples of projects you may work on:

    Integrating Entra ID with AWS and GCP to create a more seamless and secure access model
    Improving SSO and MFA across business-critical internal and third-party applications
    Migrating legacy systems and services into a more modern, cloud-first setup
    Rolling out stronger Zero Trust principles across our cloud environment
    Automating user lifecycle, access provisioning, and compliance reporting
    Supporting secure onboarding of new SaaS tools and business applications
    Improving disaster recovery and cloud resilience across multiple platforms

YOU WILL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

We’re looking for someone who:

    Takes ownership and enjoys solving real business and technical challenges
    Has a strong quality and security mindset
    Is proactive and enjoys improving processes through automation
    Likes collaborating across teams and building trust with stakeholders
    Is curious and keeps up with modern cloud, IAM, and security practices
    Can balance hands-on delivery with long-term thinking

WHAT WE OFFER

We are a value driven company with our values We team up, Innovation Drives Us, Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy and Going the Extra Mile at the heartbeat of everything that we do. With us you can always expect to get help from people who want to achieve things together and to be able to speak your mind in every social constellation you are part of. We highly value all ideas no matter where they come from, and we are not afraid to try new things out. We are also welcoming, inclusive and everyone at Haypp Group has a voice. In addition, we seize opportunities by putting in hands-on, hard work and celebrating when we reach our goals. With us, you should always feel safe, appreciated and valued but at the same time challenged and excited.

SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY!

If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, let us know you’re interested by submitting your application!

Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and marital status. We want to offer you great recruitment experience, and if there is anything we can do to make you more comfortable in the process with us, please let us know.

title: Project Leader to AFRYs Nordic Real Estate & Workplace department
description:
Company Description

AFRY is a leading European company with a global reach in engineering, design and advisory services. We are dedicated experts in infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalization, creating sustainable solutions for future generations. Together, we accelerate the transition towards a more sustainable society.

AFRY is consistently ranked among Sweden's most attractive employers for engineers. With us, you will contribute to pioneering and sustainable innovations within infrastructure, energy and industry. We offer a dynamic, varied and developing work environment where no two days are the same.

Our passionate employees are the foundation of AFRY's creative culture, where ideas, collaboration and innovation are encouraged through an open, inclusive and prestige-free way of working.

Job Description

The Project Leader is responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering workplace and real estate projects across the Nordic region, including lease-related matters, change initiatives and workplace transformation projects.

The role works closely with Real Estate, business stakeholders and external partners across the Nordic countries, ensuring delivery in line with scope, timeline and budget. Projects may be delivered in countries other than where the Project Leader is based.

    Project Management & delivery

    Lead and execute workplace and real estate projects end-to-end (e.g. relocations, rebuilds, consolidations)
    Define project scope, timelines, budgets and deliverables
    Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards
    Identify and manage risks, dependencies and critical path

    Lease negotiation & regulatory processes

    Support and lead lease negotiations in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
    Manage matters related to rent reviews, lease extensions and terminations
    Represent or support cases in the Rent Tribunal when required
    Ensure compliance with legal and contractual obligations

    Change Management & implementation

    Drive change management initiatives linked to workplace transformation
    Ensure successful adoption of new ways of working, workplace concepts and policies
    Develop and execute communication and engagement plans for stakeholders
    Support business leaders through transition phases

    Stakeholder management

    Act as a credible and trusted advisor towards business stakeholders
    Manage expectations in a complex organization with multiple stakeholders and opinions
    Facilitate decision-making through structured dialogue and clear communication
    Build strong relationships across functions, regions and seniority levels

    Workplace expertise & advisory

    Knowledge within workplace strategy, portfolio management and workplace design principles
    Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of workplace and portfolio strategies
    Ensure projects align with defined workplace principles and long-term portfolio direction
    Translate project learnings into actionable insights to strengthen future strategy development

    Strategic Development & Governance

    Contribute to the development of future workplace, portfolio and governance frameworks
    Support the establishment of common standards, processes and decision-making structures across regions
    Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous development of Real Estate & Workplace practices
    Provide expert input to strategic initiatives, business cases and portfolio decisions

    Governance, reporting & communication

    Ensure projects follow internal governance, approval processes and policies
    Track and manage project budgets, forecasts and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle
    Provide structured reporting on progress, risks and financials
    Prepare decision material for senior stakeholders when required

Qualifications

    At least 7-10 years of experience within workplace, corporate real estate, facilities management, or related disciplines, including responsibility for complex projects and strategic advisory.
    Project management within workplace, real estate or similar field
    Understanding of workplace and real estate portfolio strategy, with ability to contribute to strategic development
    Experience in lease negotiations and understanding of tenancy law / rent tribunal processes
    Experience leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, locations and business functions.
    Experience of delivering projects across the Nordic countries, including projects outside the employee’s country of residence, is considered an advantage.
    Strong stakeholder management in complex organizations
    Experience within change management and workplace transformation
    Financial understanding related to projects and leases

Additional Information

This is an internal role within AFRY, working closely with business stakeholders and support functions to develop and deliver workplace and real estate solutions for AFRY's own operations rather than external clients.

Mindset & behaviors

    High credibility and strong communication skills
    Structured, solution-oriented and accountable
    Comfortable operating in large and complex organizations
    Proactive team player with collaborative approach
    Ability to navigate ambiguity and multiple opinions

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Delivery Lead  GenAI Platforms & Governance
description:
Generative AI is evolving at exceptional speed — and scaling it across a global organization takes more than great technology. It requires the right platforms, governance and foundations to make innovation possible.

At Husqvarna Group, we are looking for a Delivery Lead – GenAI Platforms & Governance who wants to help shape how Generative AI is enabled and scaled across our global organization. You will play a key role in building the secure, scalable and cost-efficient foundation behind our growing GenAI ecosystem, including the platforms and AI-powered developer capabilities that are changing how our software teams work.

About The Team

You will join Enterprise AI & Automation, part of GIS – Digital Business Transformation, where we work to enable and scale the use of AI and automation across Husqvarna Group.

Our work spans both internally developed AI solutions and third-party Generative AI technologies. Our GenAI ecosystem includes solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Claude Code and Synthesia.

As the use of Generative AI grows across Husqvarna Group, our focus is on ensuring that these technologies are adopted responsibly, managed effectively and create real business value across the organization.

You will work closely with the other GenAI Delivery Lead, as well as stakeholders across business, technology, security and transformation.

About The Role

As Delivery Lead – GenAI Platforms & Governance, you will take technical and operational ownership of Husqvarna Group’s portfolio of third-party Generative AI platforms.

You will manage the lifecycle of our GenAI services, from onboarding and configuration to optimization and retirement, and help establish scalable service offerings and operational processes.

A key part of the role is connecting GenAI platforms with the wider enterprise IT landscape. You will work with areas such as IAM, SSO, ServiceNow and Enterprise Architecture to establish secure and efficient processes for access, provisioning, integrations and license management.

Software development and AI-powered developer tooling will also be an important part of your scope. You will work closely with development teams to understand their technical requirements and help drive the enablement of tools and capabilities such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and emerging AI development solutions. This may include areas such as model configuration, integrations, deployment approaches and feature enablement.

Together with Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy and Compliance, you will help establish the guardrails and technical controls needed for responsible GenAI use. This includes areas such as connectors, data access, model permissions and usage policies.

You will monitor usage, token consumption and license utilization to identify opportunities for optimization and cost efficiency. You will also work with technology vendors, follow emerging capabilities and provide technical input into licensing strategy, platform investments and future roadmap decisions.

About You

You are a technically curious and pragmatic leader who enjoys working where technology, governance and business needs meet.

You understand enterprise IT environments and bring a solid technical foundation, ideally with hands-on experience from software development or closely related technical roles. You don't need to be a hands-on developer today, but you need to understand how developers work, speak their language and be comfortable driving technical discussions around AI-powered development tools, platforms and emerging capabilities.

You have a strong interest in Generative AI and enjoy keeping up with a technology landscape that is developing at exceptional speed. You know how to create structure, influence without formal authority and turn emerging technology into reliable enterprise services.

Your Skills And Background

    8+ years of professional experience within IT, preferably including enterprise platforms, technical service ownership, platform management or similar environments.
    Strong understanding of the Generative AI ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar enterprise GenAI solutions.
    A solid technical background with hands-on experience from software development, engineering or closely related technical environments.
    Strong understanding of software development environments, developer workflows and AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or similar technologies.
    Experience owning or managing enterprise technology platforms or IT services.
    Good understanding of IT governance, security and access management in complex enterprise environments.
    Experience with IAM, SSO, provisioning, integrations and related enterprise IT processes.
    Experience with ITSM and service management workflows; ServiceNow experience is highly valuable.
    Understanding of usage and cost optimization, including license management, FinOps principles and token consumption.
    Experience collaborating across functions such as Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, Legal, Compliance and Procurement.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to drive progress across teams without formal authority.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience administering or governing enterprise GenAI platforms is highly valued, but strong platform and service management experience from adjacent technology areas combined with solid GenAI knowledge is also relevant.

Location

This position will be based at one of our sites in Sweden: Huskvarna, Stockholm, or Jonsered.

Your application

We look forward to receiving your application! Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the final application date 20 September.

For questions specifically related to the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Partner Victoria Kjellgren at victoria.kjellgren@husqvarnagroup.com.

title: Quality Associate
description:
Job Scope

High level purpose of function.

A Quality Associate is responsible for confirming key quality attributes of intermediate products and processes as well as identifying and responding to non-conformity issues in production. Ensures quality along all production steps and product outcomes to create a stable process environment during production. Works closely with production staff, quality technicians and engineers. A Quality Associate is responsible for ensuring that production processes and products meet internal and customers’ quality specifications and defines problems and follows-up on improvements.  

Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

    Ensure that control checks are completed according to the control plan in the defined time.  

    Ensure robust start of production and coordinate quality handover between shifts.  

    Ensure 5S in control and measurement areas and participate in improving 5S methodology and actions together with the production team.  

    Ensure documentation and record of product and process quality data and utilize these to improve processes.  

    Adhere to Quality Assurance principles.

    Operate various analytical equipment such as a Karl Fischer, measurement by ruler or micrometer, microscopes, instrumental analysis etc.

    Conduct ample registration for at-line/off-line analysis.

    Provide training to the operation team.  

    Ensure conformity of cleanliness requirements in area of responsibility.  

    Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    High school education or relevant higher education (e.g., industrial program at a gymnasium level.

    2+ years previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).

    Experience from quality control and assurance on the manufacturing shop floor is a plus.

    Experience identifying requirements and clearly documenting specifications.

    Basic Microsoft office skills (Excel, powerpoint, etc).

Specific skills & Knowledge

    Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.

    Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.

    High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  

    This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform work in controlled environments, including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.

You will shape how an agentic AI platform is deployed and adapted for a European cloud and enterprise environment in a global automotive R&D organization. The platform is shared across international engineering teams, and your focus will be to make sure it runs securely, compliantly, and reliably in the EU while staying aligned with a broader platform roadmap. You will work at the intersection of AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, enterprise integration, and cross-border collaboration. This is an excellent opportunity if you want real influence over reference architecture, platform patterns, and how AI services are adopted at scale.

Job Description

    You will own the EU reference architecture for the agent runtime, model gateway, connector and tooling framework, and SDK layer.
    You will adapt shared platform components for EU deployment and compliance needs.
    You will define and maintain Architecture Decision Records where EU requirements differ from the shared platform direction.
    You will represent EU needs in joint architecture reviews, with focus on compatibility, roadmap alignment, and breaking changes.
    You will deploy and operate platform services in approved EU cloud environments together with Cloud/DevOps and IT teams.
    You will drive the technical side of operating-level agreements, including provisioning, IAM, networking, and incident escalation.
    You will ensure alignment with EU requirements around data residency, retention, and cross-border data transfer.
    You will integrate platform services with enterprise systems such as identity providers, internal APIs, and document or data platforms.
    You will define secure connector patterns for big data and knowledge services, including vector search, enterprise search, and knowledge graph capabilities.
    You will support application teams with reusable patterns, SDKs, architecture reviews, and hands-on guidance on platform integration.

Requirements

    5+ years in software, cloud, or platform architecture.
    2+ years hands-on experience with LLM/agent platforms, RAG, or production AI services.
    Strong Python and/or TypeScript skills.
    Solid API and distributed systems design experience.
    Cloud-native engineering experience: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, observability.
    Working knowledge of IAM, networking, secrets management, secure API design.
    Practical understanding of LLM/agent concepts: inference, tool calling, embeddings/vector search, evaluation, guardrails.
    You are comfortable working as a technical bridge across distributed, cross-cultural engineering teams.

Nice to have

    Experience with GDPR-aware architecture and EU data-residency requirements.
    Familiarity with EU AI Act implications, including risk classification, logging, and audit.
    Experience from automotive, mobility, or manufacturing enterprises.
    Familiarity with LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Terraform, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent tools.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: LEAD DEVELOPER LOYALTY
description:

title: Rehabilitation medicine specialist with work-life balance in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a rehabilitation medicine specialist looking for a rewarding and development-oriented opportunity in Sweden?

Join a multidisciplinary rehabilitation department that combines inpatient care with specialized outpatient teams, all in a region known for its natural beauty and calm lifestyle.

About the role

As a rehabilitation medicine specialist, you will be responsible for the medical coordination and overall rehabilitation plans for patients with neurological injuries, spinal cord injuries, acquired brain injuries, or chronic pain.

You will work closely with other physicians and healthcare professionals in both inpatient and outpatient settings. The department includes specialized teams focused on brain injury, spinal cord rehabilitation, and pain management with a strong focus on returning to work and daily functioning.

You will also contribute to clinical development, referral assessments, and serve as a mentor for junior doctors.

Why this opportunity?

    A highly interdisciplinary environment with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, nurses, psychologists, and social workers
    Well-structured routines and openness to new ideas
    A mix of inpatient care (12 beds + 2 day slots) and outpatient rehabilitation teams
    A collaborative atmosphere where your expertise is valued and supported
    A workweek with no on-call duties

Requirements

    Holds an EU-recognized specialist certification in rehabilitation medicine
    Minimum 2–3 years of post-specialist experience working independently
    Experience with at least one of the following: acquired brain injury, spinal cord injury, or pain rehabilitation
    Strong team mindset, ability to take initiative and contribute to interdisciplinary collaboration
    Interest in mentoring and supervising junior doctors
    Willingness to learn Swedish (language course provided)

Why central Sweden?

This opportunity is based in a peaceful region in central Sweden, surrounded by nature, lakes, and forests, ideal for those seeking a calm and balanced lifestyle. The area offers excellent public services, short commutes, and year-round access to outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and kayaking. The supportive community and high quality of life make it an excellent place to settle long-term.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
    Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
    Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Are you ready to contribute to long-term rehabilitation care in a setting that values quality, teamwork, and meaningful recovery?

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Project Manager – Digital Transformation & Cloud Migration
description:
Project Manager – Digital Transformation & Cloud Migration

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden

Working method: Partial Remote

Job type: Consultant

Reference: UH-2026-421

Scope: 50%

Start date: 12 October 2026

End date: 30 June 2027

About the Assignment

We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager to lead a large-scale digital transformation and cloud migration initiative within a complex organization.

The assignment involves coordinating the transition of user mailboxes from an on-premises Microsoft Exchange environment to Exchange Online. A pilot implementation has already been completed successfully, and the technical migration process is validated and ready for broader implementation.

A key part of the assignment is ensuring that Microsoft Purview is appropriately configured to support information security, classification and governance. The project manager will work with internal stakeholders to establish and implement information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is understood and adopted across the organization.

The technical migration will be delivered by specialized infrastructure and identity teams. The Project Manager will act as the central coordination function, ensuring that business areas, users and technical teams are aligned and prepared for the migration.

The role requires excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, a structured approach and the ability to drive change across a complex organization with multiple stakeholders and varying levels of technical maturity.

Key Responsibilities

    Establish and continuously maintain the project plan, timeline, milestones and delivery structure.
    Coordinate migration priorities based on organizational readiness, size and business criticality.
    Manage and maintain the project backlog and coordinate upcoming deliveries with relevant teams.
    Identify, assess and manage project risks, particularly those involving integrations, sensitive operations and limited service windows.
    Provide regular status reporting to relevant stakeholders.
    Develop and maintain a communication plan, FAQ documentation and supporting materials.
    Plan and coordinate training and educational activities for different target groups.
    Support the establishment of information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is effectively communicated and adopted.
    Coordinate business readiness activities ahead of migration.
    Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
    Coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders throughout the migration.
    Ensure that the migration is executed according to an agreed and well-communicated plan.

Required Qualifications

    Very good Swedish, both spoken and written.
    Minimum 5 years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
    Minimum 3 years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
    Experience working on similar assignments within the public sector.
    Experience working at the interface between business operations and technical IT organizations.
    Experience developing training and communication materials for non-technical users.
    Project management certification such as PPS, PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

    10+ years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
    5+ years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
    Experience managing several business units or organizations with different levels of digital maturity.
    Ability to adapt project methods, communication and priorities to different stakeholder needs.
    PPS certification and practical experience working according to the PPS project model.
    Experience with Microsoft Purview and/or information classification.
    Experience with email migration from on-premises Exchange to Exchange Online in larger organizations.
    Experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory environments is advantageous.
    Experience coordinating technical migration teams and business stakeholders.

Personal Profile

We are looking for a Project Manager who is:

    Structured and highly organized.
    Proactive and comfortable working independently.
    Strong in stakeholder management and communication.
    Comfortable translating technical concepts into clear business language.
    Experienced in managing change in complex organizations.
    Able to coordinate multiple teams, workstreams and priorities.
    Focused on delivering according to agreed timelines and milestones.

Key Skills

IT Project Management | Digital Transformation | Change Management | Cloud Migration | Exchange Online | Microsoft Purview | Information Classification | Stakeholder Management | User Training | Public Sector | Technical Coordination | Microsoft Entra ID

Scope: 50%

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden – partial remote

Start: 12 October 2026

End: 30 June 2027

Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV, availability, current location and expected rate.

title: Business Coordinator/Events Coordinator
description:
Join Compass Group and help deliver exceptional client experiences

Compass Group is seeking a highly organised and customer-focused Customer Engagement Coordinator to join a dynamic and fast-paced team supporting a world-class client environment.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, coordinating complex activities and delivering outstanding experiences for customers and stakeholders. You will play a central role in planning and managing executive-level customer engagements, events and facility usage, working with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to ensure every experience runs seamlessly from start to finish.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy managing multiple priorities, and take pride in delivering exceptional experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have:

    Experience coordinating events, programmes, customer experiences or executive engagements.

    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Experience working with senior stakeholders and professional client environments.

What will make you successful?

Successful candidates typically demonstrate:

    Sound judgement and decision making.
    Flexibility and adaptability.

The position is a fixed-term appointment from October 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027, with the possibility of permanent employment. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

title: Service & Commissioning Engineer
description:
Företagsbeskrivning:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Arbetsbeskrivning:

Vill du arbeta nära den senaste tekniken, lösa komplexa utmaningar och vara den person som kunder litar på när avancerade testsystem ska fungera på topp? Då kan du vara den Service Engineer vi söker.

Hos AVL List Nordiska arbetar vi i framkant inom Instrumentation & Test Systems på den nordiska marknaden. Vi är ett team på 30 personer i Göteborg och Stockholm – och nu behöver vi en Service Engineer till vårt team i Göteborg.

Hos oss får du en roll där du kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och kundkontakt, samtidigt som du får stora möjligheter att utvecklas i en internationell miljö.

Som Service Engineer ansvarar du för att säkerställa att våra kunders emissionsmätsystem och instrument fungerar med högsta möjliga tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Du arbetar nära våra kunder och blir en viktig teknisk partner som bidrar med både service, support och specialistkunskap. Rollen innebär stor variation där du växlar mellan planerade serviceinsatser, felsökning, teknisk rådgivning och utvecklande kunduppdrag.

I det dagliga arbetet utför du service, underhåll, kalibrering och driftsättning av emissionsmätningsinstrument samt säkerställer att utrustningen uppfyller gällande kvalitets- och säkerhetskrav. Du stödjer även kunderna inom mätning och analys av avgasreningssystem och hjälper dem att optimera sina processer och tekniska lösningar. Genom att analysera problem, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå lösningar bidrar du till att skapa långsiktigt värde för kunden.

Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor i teambaserade uppdrag där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt är avgörande för framgång. Dokumentation, rapportering och uppföljning är en naturlig del av rollen, liksom ett kontinuerligt arbete med att utveckla och förbättra våra arbetssätt, processer och tjänster.

Tjänsten innebär resor till kunder i Sverige och, i vissa fall, internationellt. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i varierande miljöer, lära känna olika verksamheter och utvecklas inom avancerad mätteknik och ny teknologi.

Profilbeskrivning:

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:


    Minst 2 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom service, underhåll, mätteknik, teknisk support eller liknande område.
    God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med teknisk utrustning, instrument eller mätsystem.
    God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika IT- och affärssystem.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
    B-körkort.

Meriterande:


    Erfarenhet av installation, driftsättning (commissioning), service och underhåll av mätutrustning, testsystem, precisionsutrustning eller liknande tekniska produkter.
    Erfarenhet av lagkrav, regelverk och certifieringsprocesser kopplade till avgasreningssystem (Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems).
    Erfarenhet av fältservice och arbete i kundnära tekniska miljöer.
    Kunskap om och erfarenhet av emissionsmätningssystem och relaterad utrustning.
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom fordonsindustrin, motorutveckling eller närliggande tekniska områden.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i internationella projekt eller kundmiljöer.

Som person:

Du är en serviceinriktad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, samtidigt som du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och prioriteringar. Med ett lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt tar du dig an tekniska utmaningar på ett metodiskt sätt och drivs av att hitta effektiva lösningar för både kunder och verksamhet. Samtidigt är du en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och att bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång.

Vi erbjuder:

På AVL blir du en del av ett globalt teknikföretag som ligger i framkant av utveckling, simulering och testning inom mobilitetens framtid. Som världens största oberoende aktör inom området, med över 12 000 medarbetare internationellt, driver vi innovation för en grönare, säkrare och bättre värld av mobilitet.

Vårt fokus sträcker sig över hela värdekedjan – från tidiga idé- och konceptfaser till industrialisering och serieproduktion. Vi arbetar med avancerad teknik inom elektrifiering, mjukvara, autonom körning, digitalisering och energieffektiva drivlinor, och hjälper våra kunder att forma framtidens mobilitetslösningar.

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där du kan växa, påverka och vara med och driva teknikutvecklingen framåt – som gör verklig skillnad för framtidens mobilitet!

Intresserad?

I denna rekryteringsprocess tillämpar vi löpande urval. Det innebär att rekryteringsprocessen kan gå snabbt och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan!

title: Global Trade Compliance Lead | Volvo Cars
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Trade Compliance, Anti-Corruption & Human Rights team is part of Compliance & Ethics within Group Legal and Corporate Affairs. The team defines Volvo Cars’ corporate compliance requirements within key risk areas, including Trade Sanctions and Export Controls, as part of the broader Compliance & Ethics framework.



We operate in a fast-changing regulatory environment and translate complex trade compliance requirements into clear, practical and risk-based guidance for the business.







About the role



This is a global corporate risk lead role within Compliance & Ethics, responsible for defining and maintaining Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance requirements, with a primary focus on trade sanctions and export controls. The role is based at Volvo Cars headquarters in Gothenburg.



In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert for Trade Compliance. You will set the substantive direction for the risk area, promote consistent application of corporate requirements across regions and functions, and support the business in navigating complex regulatory requirements and important business decisions.



You will play a central role in shaping how Volvo Cars identifies, governs and manages Trade Compliance risks globally, ensuring that regulatory developments, enforcement trends and business priorities are translated into practical requirements, risk-area methodology, guidance, controls, training and management reporting.





     What you'll do  

You will work closely with business and functional stakeholders, regional Compliance & Ethics colleagues and other colleagues working with Trade Compliance globally to drive alignment and ensure that requirements are understood, embedded and applied consistently across regions. The role also requires close coordination with adjacent compliance areas such as anti-corruption, human rights, competition law and broader third-party risk management where risk topics overlap.



Your responsibilities will include:




    Act as the Global Corporate Risk Lead for Trade Compliance and a key Compliance & Ethics contact for trade sanctions and export controls, in close collaboration with other Trade Compliance colleagues globally.
    Define, maintain and continuously improve Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance framework, requirements, methodology, guidance and tools.
    Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement trends and industry practice, and translate them into practical business requirements and guidance.
    Set risk-area priorities and substantive direction, and provide input to Compliance & Ethics planning, reporting and continuous improvement.
    Provide expert advice and specialist compliance input to business functions and leadership.
    Lead or support risk assessments, controls, mitigation plans, incidents, investigations and complex compliance matters with Trade Compliance expertise.
    Lead coordination and alignment across global Trade Compliance colleagues, regional Compliance & Ethics teams and relevant business functions.
    Provide subject-matter input to authority interactions, industry forums, regulatory consultations and external engagements in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

    



   Profile description: What you'll bring  

Required qualifications




    University degree in Law, Business, International Trade, Engineering, or a related field.
    At least 10 years of relevant experience in trade compliance, export controls and sanctions, preferably in a global corporate, legal, regulatory or advisory environment.
    Strong working knowledge of EU and U.S. export control and sanctions laws and regulations.
    Demonstrated experience handling complex, cross-border trade compliance matters involving multiple jurisdictions.
    Proven ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance.
    Experience defining or applying compliance requirements, risk methodology, governance, and controls in a corporate environment.
    Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.



Preferred qualifications




    Experience in a multinational organization with complex products, technologies, supply chains and market-access considerations.
    Experience using digital tools, analytics or AI-enabled solutions to support compliance risk management or process improvement.
    Professional certification, such as Swedish Certified Export Control Manager or equivalent.



Who you are




    You demonstrate strong integrity, independence and sound professional judgment, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to compliance.
    You bring an analytical, risk-based mindset and are comfortable navigating complex and evolving regulatory environments.
    You are a strong communicator and trusted partner, able to influence senior stakeholders and build trust across business, regional and functional teams.
    You are comfortable taking ownership, setting direction and managing competing priorities in a global, fast-paced environment.

  



We offer:

Why join us?



This role offers high visibility and the opportunity to shape Volvo Cars´global Trade Compliance agenda, influencing how export controls and trade sanctions are integrated into our products, technologies, supply chains and global operations.



You will join a collaborative, international environment where compliance is seen as an enabler of responsible, sustainable and resilient business.

title: AI Platform Engineer
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 3525

We are looking for an AI Platform Engineer to drive the development and adoption of AI-powered solutions that strengthen our ability to detect and investigate financial crime. The role is permanent and can be based in Helsinki, Tallinn, Poland or Stockholm.

About our team

Meet the Data and Platform Team. Our role is to improve how we detect and investigate financial crime with the help of AI and machine learning to keep our customers, Nordea and society safe. Our team is about 25 people working out of Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen as a part of the Group Financial Crime Prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services to all of the bank.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions for the AI Platform spanning predictive, generative and agentic workflows.
    Secure that applications are compliant in accordance with rules and regulations.
    Define production readiness and operational governance.
    Lead technical working groups and cross-team synchronization.
    Translate strategic direction into tactical technical guidance for the teams.
    Application risk management – manage risks and QRAs.
    Application access management – access rules and requirements.
    Application cost management – ensure cost efficient applications.
    Application incident management – secure proper communication and reporting.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you are:

    Ambitious and enjoy bringing ideas, exploring their potential, and presenting the results. You're passionate about ensuring production excellence in machine learning operations, ensuring both the bank’s and society's safety.
    Collaborative and thrive in cross-functional environments, comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology. You communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, and you’re comfortable driving work forward independently.

Your background and skills include:

    BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.
    5+ years of experience as a Cloud native expert in designing and building production grade applications and services on AWS and other cloud providers (Azure or GCP).
    Practical experience with Python development and managing complex environments with Terraform.
    Experience working with AI/ML platforms such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore and Data platforms such as S3, AWS Glue, Lake Formation.
    Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across multiple domains, including expectations management.

It would be ideal if you also:

    Experience with agile methodologies and product development lifecycle. 
    Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, and data science teams.
    Have professional experience from working in regulated industries, i.e. Banking, Government, etc.

What we offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application as soon as possible as we start with interviews on ongoing basis. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Tiago Vieira, tiago.vieira@nordea.com.

A Background Check will be performed for the person selected for this position, including internal applicants.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Global Distribution Coordinator
description:
Company Description

Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Sobi encourages you to change that statistic and apply. Rarely do candidates meet 100% of the qualifications. We look forward to your application!

At Sobi, the work we do every day redefines the standards of care and transform the lives of people living with rare diseases.

As a diverse team of entrepreneurial people, we are passionate about our growth journey towards becoming a global leader, making a difference for rare disease patients, moving quickly and always challenging the status quo.

We are committed to an inclusive, sustainable and flexible workplace that fosters growth and development.

Job Description

In the role as Global Distribution Coordinator, you will work closely with Sobi affiliates, logistics service providers, and internal stakeholders to deliver seamless service and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and is passionate about delivering outstanding results in a highly regulated, patient-focused industry.

This position will be based in Stockholm, reporting directly to the Global Distribution Manager.



Key Responsibilities

    Customer Order administration incl. inter alia order taking, batch reservation, pick and pack ordering, shipment booking and monitoring, invoicing, crediting, returns and customer qualification.
    Month-end financial reporting in terms of Stock and Sales reconciliation of Sobi Consignment stock points and provide support to Sobi affiliates to complete the process with their stock points.
    Master Data management including pricing in operational ERP systems.
    Distribution network development and management including geographical expansions and new product/partner introductions. Mainly Finished Goods, but Drug Substance and Drug Product when applicable.
    Management of Sobi Logistic Service Providers (LSPs), through Business Review Meetings (BRMs) and performance monitoring (if applicable).
    Responsible for all interface transactions between Sobi HQ and Sobi affiliates LSP in IFS.
    Serial Number management in accordance with EU FMD; including Serial Number Alerts management, leading roles in Serialization Core Team activities and projects (incl. new product and/ or partner introduction)
    Process Continues Improvement

Qualifications

About you

You are a structured and analytical professional who enjoys working both independently and collaboratively. You take ownership of your work, show initiative when challenges arise, and have a strong sense of accountability. Your attention to detail, communication skills, and customer-centric mindset make you a trusted partner across functions and regions.



    You are a team player, structured, thorough, and professional and have a genuine customer service mindset.
    You appreciate and value working towards several different contact interfaces internal as well as external.
    You are independent and do not hesitate to take initiative when processes are not working efficiently.
    You have good cooperation and communication skills, ability to prioritize and have a burning interest in solving problems and delivering results.
    You have strong time management skills; able to plan short/ repetitive, mid-, and long-term due dates.
    You have a technology-driven mindset and are curious about how automation, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions can improve ways of working.
    You are system-oriented, comfortable working with operational platforms, and motivated by finding smarter, more efficient solutions to recurring tasks and process challenges.



Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

Additional Information

How to apply

We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.

Why Join Us?

We are differentiating ourselves through the passion of our people, the innovative products we bring to life, and the responsible business we operate.

To ensure that more patients benefit from our therapies now and in the future, and to align with the company’s ambitions for growth, we have five core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.  

Our mission and purpose get us excited to come to work every day, but there are a few more reasons to join our team:

    Opportunities for professional growth
    Competitive compensation for your work
    Diversity and Inclusion
    A flexible workplace that supports work-life balance



About Sobi

Sobi is a global biopharma company unlocking the potential of breakthrough innovations, transforming everyday life for people living with rare diseases.

We are dedicated to capturing the scientific opportunities of our time. With our early roots in Sweden, we started as pioneers in Haemophilia. Today we are an innovate leader within rare diseases with a global reach.



    We are bringing brilliant ideas to life in rare disease areas with high unmet patient needs.
    We are experts on identifying breakthrough innovations, unlocking new therapies and levelling up global access to new treatments.
    Our global operational network and passionate team serve as the foundation for our success.

Sobi has approximately 2,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia and Australia. In 2025, revenue amounted to SEK 28 billion. Sobi’s share (STO:SOBI) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

title: Psychiatry specialists for a permanent position in Hälsingland
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

We are currently looking for specialists in psychiatry to join a well-functioning psychiatric service in central Sweden.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work in a stable, supportive environment while still having the possibility to influence and develop the way care is delivered.

About the role

In inpatient care, the focus is on patients requiring 24/7 treatment, including acute conditions. You will be involved in assessment, treatment planning, medication, and discharge planning together with the team.

description:

How you’ll make an impact

    Execute and deploy the global Digital Transformer Monitoring portfolio across the EUC HUB, ensuring consistent implementation and operational adoption.
    Support the integration of digital transformer monitoring solutions while adapting deployments to local standards and requirements.
    Provide Level 2 technical support for digital products, troubleshooting issues and recommending optimal technical solutions.

    Share market insights, regional requirements, industry standards, and technology trends with product management and R&D teams.
    Support customer projects, pilot implementations, technical proposals, and detailed workshops focused on digital transformer strategies.

Your background

    Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent proven practical experience, with at least 2 years of experience in transformer engineering, control design, commissioning, or a similar technical role.
    Strong knowledge of transformer monitoring solutions, including DGA, bushing monitoring, partial discharge monitoring, TMS, alarm annunciators, oil dryers, and eDevices.
    Good understanding of transformer technologies (types, characteristics, main components, behavior, diagnostic methods, common issues), diagnostics, and industry standards such as IEC 60076-7; knowledge of IEEE C57.91 is an advantage.
    Ability to interpret and verify electrical control schematics, with basic knowledge of PLCs and software programming.

    Fluent in technical English, with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in international and multicultural environments.

title: Lead Qualification Specialist (part-time)
description:

● You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.
